53/// @file
54/// @brief The UI document interpreter: `Interpreter::mount` turns a loaded `Document` into reactive state and a view
55/// tree, mounts it through `Mounted` on any `IViewBackend`, and runs its queries, mutations, relations and
56/// commands. Model calls go through a `Dispatcher` (the bridge's model-free seams in an application, a
57/// scripted fake in a test); what only the application can do goes through an `InterpreterHost`; what
58/// screens share — the query cache, the principal's permissions, the formatting facts — is a `Session`.
59
60namespace morph::ui {

66/// @brief How one model call is sent.
67struct CallOptions {
68 /// @brief Ask the server to evaluate the action's body instead of executing it (spec 5 §7, `ui-evaluate`).
69 bool evaluate = false;
70 /// @brief The mutation declares `"offline": "queue"`: a dispatcher with an offline queue holds a call that cannot
71 /// reach the server and settles the completion when the replay settles.
72 bool queueOffline = false;
73};

75/// @brief What a channel can say about the instance it is bound to.
76struct ChannelFacts {
77 /// @brief The instance's id on the server; `0` while the bind has not settled.
78 std::uint64_t instanceId = 0;
79 /// @brief The instance's primary key; empty for one with none.
80 std::string primary;
81};

83/// @brief One bound model alias: the instance a document's alias names, and the calls made through it.
84class ModelChannel {
85public:
86 ModelChannel() = default;
87 ModelChannel(ModelChannel const&) = delete;
88 ModelChannel& operator=(ModelChannel const&) = delete;
89 ModelChannel(ModelChannel&&) = delete;
90 ModelChannel& operator=(ModelChannel&&) = delete;
91 virtual ~ModelChannel() = default;

93 /// @brief Sends one action.
94 /// @param actionId The action's registered type id.
95 /// @param bodyJson The action's JSON body.
96 /// @param options How to send it.
97 /// @return The reply's JSON text, delivered on the runtime's owner.
98 [[nodiscard]] virtual async::Completion<std::string> execute(std::string const& actionId,
99 std::string const& bodyJson, CallOptions options) = 0;
100
101 /// @brief The instance it is bound to, as far as it knows.
102 /// @return The facts; an empty set for a channel with no instance of its own to report.
103 [[nodiscard]] virtual ChannelFacts facts() const { return {}; }
104};

106/// @brief The interpreter's view of the bridge: binds a model by its type id, privately or to a shared instance.
107class Dispatcher {
108public:
109 Dispatcher() = default;
110 Dispatcher(Dispatcher const&) = delete;
111 Dispatcher& operator=(Dispatcher const&) = delete;
112 Dispatcher(Dispatcher&&) = delete;
113 Dispatcher& operator=(Dispatcher&&) = delete;
114 virtual ~Dispatcher() = default;

116 /// @brief Binds a model.
117 /// @param typeId The model's registered type id.
118 /// @param sharing Private, or shared.
119 /// @param instanceKey For a shared binding, the instance key; empty for the model's shared singleton.
120 /// @return The bound channel. The caller holds it as long as it makes calls through it.
121 [[nodiscard]] virtual std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> bind(std::string const& typeId, bridge::BindSharing sharing,
122 std::string const& instanceKey) = 0;
123};

125/// @brief Evaluates an action body without running it: the model's type id, the action id and the JSON body in, the
126/// query's value out (spec 5 §7). `ui::evaluatorOver` builds one over the UI service's `ui-evaluate`.
127using Evaluator = std::function<async::Completion<std::string>(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId,
128 std::string const& bodyJson)>;
129
130/// @brief A `Dispatcher` over the bridge's model-free seams: `bindByType`, `executeRaw` and the string-keyed
131/// `attach`, through `RawHandler`.
132///
133/// An evaluation goes through the `Evaluator` it was given, since that envelope belongs to the UI service, not the
134/// bridge; without one it is refused with a `std::runtime_error`. It has no offline queue of its own: `queueOffline`
135/// is ignored unless a `QueueingDispatcher` wraps it. A shared binding without a key is bound unattached, which the
136/// bridge refuses at the first call; the interpreter never binds one, since a `"shared"` alias is a stateless model's
137/// and binds privately.
138class BridgeDispatcher final : public Dispatcher {
139public:
140 /// @brief Dispatches through @p bridge, and evaluates through @p evaluator.
141 /// @param bridge The bridge. Borrowed: it must outlive every channel.
142 /// @param cbExec The executor replies are delivered on: the runtime's owner. Borrowed.
143 /// @param evaluator What answers an `evaluate` query; empty to refuse them.
144 BridgeDispatcher(bridge::Bridge& bridge MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, exec::IExecutor* cbExec MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND,
145 Evaluator evaluator = {})
146 : _bridge{&bridge}, _cbExec{cbExec}, _evaluator{std::move(evaluator)} {}
147
148 /// @brief Binds through a `RawHandler`.
149 /// @param typeId The model's registered type id.
150 /// @param sharing Private, or shared.
151 /// @param instanceKey For a shared binding, the key to attach to; empty to stay unattached.
152 /// @return The channel; destroying it deregisters the binding.
153 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> bind(std::string const& typeId, bridge::BindSharing sharing,
154 std::string const& instanceKey) override {
155 return std::make_shared<Channel>(*_bridge, _cbExec, _evaluator, typeId, sharing, instanceKey);
156 }
157
158private:
159 class Channel final : public ModelChannel {
160 public:
161 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): the type id, then the key, as `bind` takes them.
162 Channel(bridge::Bridge& bridge, exec::IExecutor* cbExec, Evaluator evaluator, std::string const& typeId,
163 bridge::BindSharing sharing, std::string const& instanceKey)
164 : _cbExec{cbExec},
165 _evaluator{std::move(evaluator)},
166 _typeId{typeId},
167 _handler{bridge, cbExec, typeId, sharing, instanceKey} {}
168
169 [[nodiscard]] async::Completion<std::string> execute(std::string const& actionId, std::string const& bodyJson,
170 CallOptions options) override {
171 if (options.evaluate) {
172 if (_evaluator) {
173 return _evaluator(_typeId, actionId, bodyJson);
174 }
175 auto [refused, promise] = async::Completion<std::string>::makeSettleable(_cbExec);
176 promise.reject(std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error{"evaluate needs the UI service"}));
177 return std::move(refused);
178 }
179 return _handler.execute(actionId, bodyJson);
180 }
181
182 [[nodiscard]] ChannelFacts facts() const override {
183 return ChannelFacts{.instanceId = _handler.instanceId(), .primary = _handler.primary()};
184 }
185
186 private:
187 exec::IExecutor* _cbExec;
188 Evaluator _evaluator;
189 std::string _typeId;
190 bridge::RawHandler _handler;
191 };
192
193 bridge::Bridge* _bridge;
194 exec::IExecutor* _cbExec;
195 Evaluator _evaluator;
196};

239/// @brief The inline cap a session has unless it is given another: 1 MiB.
240inline constexpr std::size_t kDefaultInlineFileBytes = std::size_t{1024} * 1024;

242/// @brief The largest inline cap a session takes: base64 grows bytes by 4/3, and 64 KiB of an envelope are left for
243/// the rest of the body, so the encoded file still fits `wire::kMaxEnvelopeBytes`.
244inline constexpr std::size_t kMaxInlineFileBytes = (wire::kMaxEnvelopeBytes - (std::size_t{64} * 1024)) * 3 / 4;

441/// @brief What a `Session` is built with.
442struct SessionOptions {
443 /// @brief Timers for `debounce`, `refreshEvery` and the cache's eviction. Without one, `debounce` fetches at once,
444 /// `refreshEvery` never ticks and unused entries are kept. Borrowed.
445 reactive::Scheduler* scheduler = nullptr;
446 /// @brief The clock `staleTime` is measured on; empty uses `std::chrono::steady_clock`.
447 std::function<std::chrono::milliseconds()> clock;
448 /// @brief How long an entry no mounted query uses is kept (spec 5 §5: five minutes).
449 std::chrono::milliseconds keepUnused{std::chrono::minutes{5}};
450 /// @brief The catalog: `stateless` decides an alias's default instance; an action's `secretFields` are never
451 /// cached or kept in `result`.
452 Catalog catalog;
453 /// @brief Maps a failed call to its error kind (`denied`, `offline`, `timeout`, …); empty uses the default,
454 /// which knows the bridge's own failures and calls everything else `error`.
455 std::function<std::string(std::exception_ptr const&)> classify;
456 /// @brief Development mode: whether this session's screens record what the inspector reads. Off by default.
457 DevelopmentTools developmentTools = DevelopmentTools::Off;
458 /// @brief Sends the cache's watch changes to the server. Empty: the session still counts what its cache holds,
459 /// and sends nothing, which is right for a local source, whose replies carry every change it sees.
460 Watcher watcher;
461 /// @brief The most bytes a document moves inline in one file (`download` from bytes, `upload` into bytes, a
462 /// field component writing a base64 member); 1 to `kMaxInlineFileBytes`.
463 std::size_t maxInlineFileBytes = kDefaultInlineFileBytes;
464};

468/// @brief The text of a failure.
469/// @param error The failure.
470/// @return `what()`, or `unknown error`.
471[[nodiscard]] inline std::string failureText(std::exception_ptr const& error) {
472 try {
473 std::rethrow_exception(error);
474 } catch (std::exception const& failure) {
475 return failure.what();
476 } catch (...) {
477 return "unknown error";
478 }
479}

481/// @brief The default error kinds: the bridge's own failures, and `error` for the rest.
482/// @param error The failure.
483/// @return The kind.
484[[nodiscard]] inline std::string defaultErrorKind(std::exception_ptr const& error) {
485 try {
486 std::rethrow_exception(error);
487 } catch (backend::DisconnectedError const&) {
488 return "offline";
489 } catch (backend::TimeoutError const&) {
490 return "timeout";
491 } catch (backend::ClientTimeoutError const&) {
492 return "timeout";
493 } catch (backend::BackendChangedError const&) {
494 return "backendChanged";
495 } catch (...) {
496 return "error";
497 }
498}

500/// @brief A value's JSON text, with record fields in name order: a cache key's canonical body.
501/// @param value The value.
502/// @return The text.
503[[nodiscard]] inline std::string canonicalJson(Value const& value) {
504 return glz::write_json(valueToJson(value)).value_or(std::string{});
505}

507/// @brief A value with the field at @p path replaced, creating records along the way.
508/// @param base The value written into.
509/// @param path The field path.
510/// @param value The new value at the path.
511/// @return The new value.
512// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per path segment
513[[nodiscard]] inline Value withPath(Value const& base, std::span<std::string const> path, Value value) {
514 if (path.empty()) {
515 return value;
516 }
517 ValueRecord fields;
518 if (ValueRecord const* const record = base.asRecord()) {
519 fields = *record;
520 }
521 Value const inner = base.field(path.front()) != nullptr ? *base.field(path.front()) : Value{};
522 fields.insert_or_assign(path.front(), withPath(inner, path.subspan(1), std::move(value)));
523 return Value{std::move(fields)};
524}
525
526/// @brief A row's identity for `patch` and `optimistic`: its `id` field.
527/// @param row The row.
528/// @return The `id` field, or `null`.
529[[nodiscard]] inline Value rowId(Value const& row) {
530 Value const* const found = row.field("id");
531 return found == nullptr ? Value{} : *found;
532}
533
534/// @brief Writes @p with over a row: the fields of a record over a record's, otherwise the whole row.
535/// @param row The row.
536/// @param with The new content.
537/// @return The new row.
538[[nodiscard]] inline Value mergeRow(Value const& row, Value const& with) {
539 ValueRecord const* const fields = row.asRecord();
540 ValueRecord const* const over = with.asRecord();
541 if (fields == nullptr || over == nullptr) {
542 return with;
543 }
544 ValueRecord merged = *fields;
545 for (auto const& [name, field] : *over) {
546 merged.insert_or_assign(name, field);
547 }
548 return Value{std::move(merged)};
549}

551/// @brief Why a patch left a query's value as it was.
552enum class PatchMiss : std::uint8_t {
553 NoList, ///< The value, or its `at` member, is not a list: the patch can never apply, and is reported.
554 NoRow, ///< No row's `id` equals the key: the row is not loaded, which is not a fault.
555};
556
557/// @brief Replaces the row whose `id` equals @p key in a query's list of rows.
558/// @param value The query's value: the list itself, or a record holding it in member @p listMember.
559/// @param listMember The record member holding the list; empty when @p value is the list.
560/// @param key The row's id.
561/// @param with The new content, merged over the row.
562/// @return The new value, or why it is unchanged.
563// NOLINTBEGIN(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): a list, a key and a row are distinct roles of one type.
564[[nodiscard]] inline std::expected<Value, PatchMiss> patchRows(Value const& value, std::string_view listMember,
565 Value const& key, Value const& with) {
566 // NOLINTEND(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters)
567 ValueRecord const* const record = listMember.empty() ? nullptr : value.asRecord();
568 if (!listMember.empty() && (record == nullptr || !record->contains(listMember))) {
569 return std::unexpected(PatchMiss::NoList);
570 }
571 Value const* const rows = record == nullptr ? &value : &record->find(listMember)->second;
572 ValueList const* const items = rows->asList();
573 if (items == nullptr) {
574 return std::unexpected(PatchMiss::NoList);
575 }
576 if (key.isNull()) {
577 return std::unexpected(PatchMiss::NoRow);
578 }
579 ValueList out = *items;
580 bool found = false;
581 for (Value& row : out) {
582 if (rowId(row) == key) {
583 row = mergeRow(row, with);
584 found = true;
585 }
586 }
587 if (!found) {
588 return std::unexpected(PatchMiss::NoRow);
589 }
590 if (record == nullptr) {
591 return Value{std::move(out)};
592 }
593 ValueRecord patched = *record;
594 patched.insert_or_assign(std::string{listMember}, Value{std::move(out)});
595 return Value{std::move(patched)};
596}
597
598/// @brief What a patch that found no list reports.
599/// @param query The query it patches.
600/// @param listMember The record member it names; empty when none.
601/// @return The diagnostic's reason.
602[[nodiscard]] inline std::string patchMissReason(std::string_view query, std::string_view listMember) {
603 if (listMember.empty()) {
604 return "the value of `" + std::string{query} +
605 "` is not a list, so the patch changes nothing; `at` names the record member that holds the list";
606 }
607 return "the value of `" + std::string{query} + "` has no list at `" + std::string{listMember} +
608 "`, so the patch changes nothing";
609}
610
611/// @brief Removes the named fields from a record, and from each record of a list.
612/// @param value The value.
613/// @param fields The field names.
614/// @return The value without them.
615// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested list or record of the value.
616[[nodiscard]] inline Value withoutFields(Value const& value, std::vector<std::string> const& fields) {
617 if (fields.empty()) {
618 return value;
619 }
620 if (ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord()) {
621 ValueRecord kept = *record;
622 for (std::string const& field : fields) {
623 kept.erase(field);
624 }
625 return Value{std::move(kept)};
626 }
627 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
628 ValueList kept;
629 kept.reserve(items->size());
630 for (Value const& item : *items) {
631 kept.push_back(withoutFields(item, fields));
632 }
633 return Value{std::move(kept)};
634 }
635 return value;
636}
637
638/// @brief The members of a catalog record path: `"header.rows"` is `header`, then `rows`; `""` is none.
639/// @param path The path.
640/// @return Its members in order.
641[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::string> pathMembers(std::string_view path) {
642 std::vector<std::string> members;
643 for (auto const part : std::views::split(path, '.')) {
644 if (!part.empty()) {
645 members.emplace_back(part.begin(), part.end());
646 }
647 }
648 return members;
649}
650
651/// @brief The rows of a keyed record that a value holds at a path.
652///
653/// A list on the way is looked through, as the result walker looks through a `std::vector`. At the path's end a
654/// record with the key field is a row, and a record without it is a map whose values are the rows.
655/// @param value The value.
656/// @param path The members still to follow.
657/// @param keyField The record's key field.
658/// @param out Where the rows go.
659// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per path member or nested list.
660inline void keyedRowsAt(Value const& value, std::span<std::string const> path, std::string_view keyField,
661 std::vector<Value const*>& out) {
662 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
663 for (Value const& item : *items) {
664 keyedRowsAt(item, path, keyField, out);
665 }
666 return;
667 }
668 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
669 if (record == nullptr) {
670 return;
671 }
672 if (!path.empty()) {
673 if (auto const found = record->find(path.front()); found != record->end()) {
674 keyedRowsAt(found->second, path.subspan(1), keyField, out);
675 }
676 return;
677 }
678 if (record->contains(keyField)) {
679 out.push_back(&value);
680 return;
681 }
682 for (auto const& [name, item] : *record) {
683 static_cast<void>(name);
684 if (ValueRecord const* const row = item.asRecord(); row != nullptr && row->contains(keyField)) {
685 out.push_back(&item);
686 }
687 }
688}
689
690/// @brief New rows by the canonical text of their key.
691using RowsByKey = std::map<std::string, Value const*, std::less<>>;
692
693/// @brief Merges new rows over the rows with the same key that a value holds at a path.
694/// @param value The value.
695/// @param path The members still to follow.
696/// @param keyField The record's key field.
697/// @param rows The new rows.
698/// @return The new value, or nothing when no row matched.
699// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per path member or nested list.
700[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Value> patchKeyedRows(Value const& value, std::span<std::string const> path,
701 std::string_view keyField, RowsByKey const& rows) {
702 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
703 ValueList out = *items;
704 bool changed = false;
705 for (Value& item : out) {
706 if (auto patched = patchKeyedRows(item, path, keyField, rows)) {
707 item = std::move(*patched);
708 changed = true;
709 }
710 }
711 return changed ? std::optional<Value>{Value{std::move(out)}} : std::nullopt;
712 }
713 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
714 if (record == nullptr) {
715 return std::nullopt;
716 }
717 if (!path.empty()) {
718 auto const found = record->find(path.front());
719 if (found == record->end()) {
720 return std::nullopt;
721 }
722 auto patched = patchKeyedRows(found->second, path.subspan(1), keyField, rows);
723 if (!patched) {
724 return std::nullopt;
725 }
726 ValueRecord out = *record;
727 out.insert_or_assign(path.front(), std::move(*patched));
728 return Value{std::move(out)};
729 }
730 if (auto const key = record->find(keyField); key != record->end()) {
731 auto const row = rows.find(canonicalJson(key->second));
732 return row == rows.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Value>{mergeRow(value, *row->second)};
733 }
734 ValueRecord out = *record;
735 bool changed = false;
736 for (auto& [name, item] : out) {
737 static_cast<void>(name);
738 if (ValueRecord const* const row = item.asRecord(); row != nullptr && row->contains(keyField)) {
739 if (auto patched = patchKeyedRows(item, {}, keyField, rows)) {
740 item = std::move(*patched);
741 changed = true;
742 }
743 }
744 }
745 return changed ? std::optional<Value>{Value{std::move(out)}} : std::nullopt;
746}
747
748/// @brief One optimistic write still waiting for its reply.
749struct OptimisticLayer {
750 /// @brief The run that made it.
751 std::uint64_t run = 0;
752 /// @brief The record member holding the list; empty when the value is the list.
753 std::string at;
754 /// @brief The row's id.
755 Value key;
756 /// @brief What was written.
757 Value with;
758};
759
760/// @brief One entry of the session's query cache (spec 5 §5): one request in flight, one value, one error.
761struct CacheEntry {
762 /// @brief An empty entry.
763 /// @param runtime The runtime its signals belong to.
764 explicit CacheEntry(reactive::Runtime& runtime)
765 : value{runtime}, hasValue{runtime, false}, error{runtime}, errorKind{runtime}, pending{runtime, false} {}
766
767 /// @brief The cache key: model type, instance, action and canonical body.
768 std::string key;
769 /// @brief The model type.
770 std::string typeId;
771 /// @brief The action.
772 std::string action;
773 /// @brief The body's JSON text.
774 std::string body;
775 /// @brief Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
776 bool evaluate = false;
777 /// @brief The value shown: the confirmed value with the optimistic layers over it.
778 reactive::Signal<Value> value;
779 /// @brief Whether a reply has been applied.
780 reactive::Signal<bool> hasValue;
781 /// @brief The last failure's text; empty when none.
782 reactive::Signal<std::string> error;
783 /// @brief The last failure's kind; empty when none.
784 reactive::Signal<std::string> errorKind;
785 /// @brief Whether a request is in flight.
786 reactive::Signal<bool> pending;
787 /// @brief The value the server last confirmed.
788 Value confirmed;
789 /// @brief The optimistic writes still waiting, oldest first.
790 std::vector<OptimisticLayer> layers;
791 /// @brief The generation of the request in flight; a reply of an older one is dropped.
792 std::uint64_t generation = 0;
793 /// @brief When the last reply was applied.
794 std::optional<std::chrono::milliseconds> fetchedAt;
795 /// @brief Marked stale by a `refetch`, a backend switch or a change.
796 bool stale = false;
797 /// @brief Marked stale while a fetch was in flight: that fetch may have read before the change, so when it
798 /// settles the entry stays stale and fetches once more.
799 bool refetchAfter = false;
800 /// @brief The mounted queries using it.
801 int users = 0;
802 /// @brief The eviction timer, while no query uses it.
803 reactive::TimerHandle evict;
804 /// @brief The fields never cached.
805 std::vector<std::string> secretFields;
806 /// @brief The alias's instance token the entry was read through.
807 std::string instanceToken;
808 /// @brief The records the entry's action returns, with the key field and paths of each; empty for an
809 /// `evaluate` entry, which holds none.
810 std::vector<ActionRecordInfo> records;
811
812 /// @brief The catalog entry of a record the entry holds.
813 /// @param record The record's wire name.
814 /// @return It, or `nullptr` when the entry does not hold the record.
815 [[nodiscard]] ActionRecordInfo const* holding(std::string_view record) const {
816 auto const found = std::ranges::find(records, record, &ActionRecordInfo::record);
817 return found == records.end() ? nullptr : &*found;
818 }
819};
820
821/// @brief The rows of a keyed record a value holds, at each of the record's paths.
822/// @param value The value.
823/// @param paths The record's paths.
824/// @param keyField The record's key field.
825/// @return The rows.
826[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<Value const*> keyedRowsOf(Value const& value, std::vector<std::string> const& paths,
827 std::string_view keyField) {
828 std::vector<Value const*> rows;
829 for (std::string const& path : paths) {
830 std::vector<std::string> const members = pathMembers(path);
831 keyedRowsAt(value, members, keyField, rows);
832 }
833 return rows;
834}
835
836/// @brief Merges new rows into a value at each of the record's paths.
837/// @param value The value.
838/// @param paths The record's paths.
839/// @param keyField The record's key field.
840/// @param rows The new rows by key.
841/// @return The new value, or nothing when no row matched.
842[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Value> patchHeldRows(Value const& value, std::vector<std::string> const& paths,
843 std::string_view keyField, RowsByKey const& rows) {
844 std::optional<Value> patched;
845 for (std::string const& path : paths) {
846 std::vector<std::string> const members = pathMembers(path);
847 auto next = patched ? patchKeyedRows(*patched, members, keyField, rows)
848 : patchKeyedRows(value, members, keyField, rows);
849 if (next) {
850 patched = std::move(next);
851 }
852 }
853 return patched;
854}
855
856/// @brief The entries one change marks stale, each once, in the order they were found.
857struct Marks {
858 /// @brief The entries.
859 std::vector<CacheEntry*> entries;
860
861 /// @brief Adds an entry, unless it is already there.
862 /// @param entry The entry.
863 void add(CacheEntry& entry) {
864 if (std::ranges::find(entries, &entry) == entries.end()) {
865 entries.push_back(&entry);
866 }
867 }
868};

876/// @brief How a mutation's reply was used.
877enum class ReplyUse : std::uint8_t {
878 Applied, ///< The reply is the latest: its values may patch the cache.
879 Discarded, ///< A newer run's reply was applied first, so its values are older and only mark.
880};

882/// @brief What running a host command (`host/1`) did.
883struct HostCommandResult {
884 /// @brief The outcome.
885 enum class Kind : std::uint8_t {
886 Ran, ///< The command ran.
887 Missing, ///< The client has no such command; nothing ran.
888 Refused, ///< The command exists and did not run: its arguments, or a connection that is not verified.
889 };
890 /// @brief The outcome.
891 Kind kind = Kind::Ran;
892 /// @brief Why it was refused; empty otherwise.
893 std::string reason;
894};

896/// @brief The client's host commands, as a session runs them (spec 6 §14).
897struct HostCommands {
898 /// @brief The commands the client can run now; `{"can": "host:name"}` is true for these.
899 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> available;
900 /// @brief Runs a command with its evaluated `args` (`null` when the document gives none).
901 std::function<HostCommandResult(std::string const& name, Value const& args)> run;
902};

904/// @brief What screens of one client session share (spec 5 §5, §12b): the query cache, the mounted queries, the
905/// principal's permitted actions, the formatting facts and the client's `env`, `session` and `host` values.
906///
907/// It belongs to the runtime's owner, outlives every screen mounted on it, and is cleared by `signOut` and on a
908/// principal change.
909class Session {
910public:
911 /// @brief An empty session.
912 /// @param runtime The runtime. Borrowed.
913 /// @param options Timers, clock, catalog and the inline cap.
914 /// @throws std::invalid_argument when `maxInlineFileBytes` is 0 or above `kMaxInlineFileBytes`.
915 explicit Session(reactive::Runtime& runtime MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, SessionOptions options = {})
916 : _runtime{&runtime},
917 _options{checkedOptions(std::move(options))},
918 _permitted{runtime},
919 _format{runtime, std::make_shared<FormatContext const>()},
920 _env{runtime, ValueRecord{{"locale", Value{FormatContext{}.locale}}}},
921 _sessionValues{runtime},
922 _hostValues{runtime},
923 _hostCommandNames{runtime} {}
924
925 Session(Session const&) = delete;
926 Session& operator=(Session const&) = delete;
927 Session(Session&&) = delete;
928 Session& operator=(Session&&) = delete;
929 ~Session() = default;
930
931 /// @brief The runtime.
932 /// @return It.
933 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return *_runtime; }
934
935 /// @brief The options.
936 /// @return They.
937 [[nodiscard]] SessionOptions const& options() const noexcept { return _options; }
938
939 /// @brief Sets the action ids the principal may run, as the catalog reply lists them; `{"can": ...}` follows them.
940 /// @param permitted The ids.
941 void setPermitted(std::set<std::string, std::less<>> permitted) { _permitted.set(std::move(permitted)); }
942
943 /// @brief Whether the principal may run an action, or the client can run a host command now. A tracked read.
944 ///
945 /// A `host:` name is answered from the client's own commands (`setHostCommands`), never from the server's
946 /// permitted set: the two have different owners, and a catalog refresh must not drop the client's commands.
947 /// @param action The action id, or `host:<command>`.
948 /// @return Whether it is permitted.
949 [[nodiscard]] bool can(std::string_view action) const {
950 static constexpr std::string_view kHostPrefix = "host:";
951 if (action.starts_with(kHostPrefix)) {
952 return _hostCommandNames.get().contains(action.substr(kHostPrefix.size()));
953 }
954 return _permitted.get().contains(action);
955 }
956
957 /// @brief Replaces the formatting facts; every `t` and display function re-evaluates. `{"env": "locale"}` follows
958 /// the facts' locale.
959 /// @param format The facts.
960 void setFormatting(FormatContext format) {
961 // One batch, so an effect never sees the new `env.locale` beside the old facts, and runs once.
962 _runtime->batch([this, &format] {
963 setEnvironmentValue("locale", Value{format.locale});
964 _format.set(std::make_shared<FormatContext const>(std::move(format)));
965 });
966 }
967
968 /// @brief The formatting facts. A tracked read.
969 /// @return They.
970 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formatting() const { return *_format.get(); }
971
972 /// @brief The formatting facts, read without tracking: what a value set once at mount reads.
973 /// @return They.
974 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formattingNow() const { return *_format.peek(); }
975
976 /// @brief Sets the patterns every date and every date and time is written and read in, keeping the other
977 /// formatting facts; an empty one keeps ISO.
978 /// @param date The date pattern, such as `dd-MMM-yyyy`.
979 /// @param dateTime The date-and-time pattern, such as `dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm`.
980 void setDatePatterns(std::string date, std::string dateTime) {
981 FormatContext next = *_format.peek();
982 next.datePattern = std::move(date);
983 next.dateTimePattern = std::move(dateTime);
984 setFormatting(std::move(next));
985 }
986
987 /// @brief Changes the active locale, keeping the other formatting facts.
988 /// @param locale The BCP 47 locale.
989 void setLocale(std::string locale) {
990 FormatContext next = *_format.peek();
991 next.locale = std::move(locale);
992 setFormatting(std::move(next));
993 }
994
995 /// @brief Replaces the message catalogue, keeping the other formatting facts; every `t` re-resolves.
996 /// @param translations The provider, such as `MessageCatalogues::provider()`; empty shows every fallback.
997 void setTranslations(render::TranslationProvider translations) {
998 FormatContext next = *_format.peek();
999 next.translations = std::move(translations);
1000 setFormatting(std::move(next));
1001 }
1002
1003 /// @brief Sets the `env` values (`widthClass`, `platform`, `online`, `backend`). `locale` is the formatting
1004 /// facts' locale and is always present: a `locale` in @p values is replaced by it.
1005 /// @param values The values.
1006 void setEnvironment(ValueRecord values) {
1007 values.insert_or_assign("locale", Value{_format.peek()->locale});
1008 _env.set(std::move(values));
1009 }
1010
1011 /// @brief Sets one `env` value and keeps the others, so a client that learns its width class does not drop the
1012 /// `backend` a switch set, nor a switch the width class.
1013 /// @param name The value's name, such as `widthClass`.
1014 /// @param value The value.
1015 void setEnvironmentValue(std::string const& name, Value value) {
1016 ValueRecord env = _env.peek();
1017 env.insert_or_assign(name, std::move(value));
1018 _env.set(std::move(env));
1019 }
1020
1021 /// @brief Sets the `session` values (`principal`, `userName`, …).
1022 /// @param values The values.
1023 void setSessionValues(ValueRecord values) { _sessionValues.set(std::move(values)); }
1024
1025 /// @brief Sets the `host` values the application registered.
1026 /// @param values The values.
1027 void setHostValues(ValueRecord values) { _hostValues.set(std::move(values)); }
1028
1029 /// @brief Sets the client's host commands: the names `{"can": "host:name"}` answers for, and what runs them. A
1030 /// session without a runner asks `InterpreterHost::hostCommand`.
1031 /// @param commands The names and the runner.
1032 void setHostCommands(HostCommands commands) {
1033 _hostCommandRunner = std::move(commands.run);
1034 _hostCommandNames.set(std::move(commands.available));
1035 }
1036
1037 /// @brief What runs host commands.
1038 /// @return It; empty when the application set none.
1039 [[nodiscard]] std::function<HostCommandResult(std::string const&, Value const&)> const& hostCommandRunner()
1040 const noexcept {
1041 return _hostCommandRunner;
1042 }
1043
1044 /// @brief Reads `env`, `session` or `host`. A tracked read.
1045 /// @param form `Env`, `Session` or `Host`.
1046 /// @param name The name.
1047 /// @return The value, or `null`.
1048 [[nodiscard]] Value client(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const {
1049 ValueRecord const& values = [&]() -> ValueRecord const& {
1050 if (form == ExprKind::Env) {
1051 return _env.get();
1052 }
1053 return form == ExprKind::Session ? _sessionValues.get() : _hostValues.get();
1054 }();
1055 auto const found = values.find(name);
1056 return found == values.end() ? Value{} : found->second;
1057 }
1058
1059 /// @brief The app document's scope, which `{"ref": "app.name"}` reads and `{"set": "app.name"}` writes; set by
1060 /// `Interpreter::mountApp` for as long as the `AppRoot` lives.
1061 /// @return It, or `nullptr` when no app document is mounted.
1062 [[nodiscard]] detail::RtScope const* appScope() const noexcept { return _appScope; }
1063
1064 /// @brief Installs or clears the app document's scope. Called by `AppRoot`, nothing else.
1065 /// @param scope The scope, or `nullptr`.
1066 void setAppScope(detail::RtScope const* scope) noexcept { _appScope = scope; }
1067
1068 /// @brief Drops every cache entry: `signOut` and a principal change (spec 5 §5, "Isolation").
1069 void clear() {
1070 _runtime->batch([this] {
1071 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
1072 static_cast<void>(key);
1073 ++entry->generation;
1074 entry->evict.cancel();
1075 countTopics(*entry, -1);
1076 }
1077 _entries.clear();
1078 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : _mounted) {
1079 detachQuery(*query);
1080 }
1081 });
1082 }
1083
1084 /// @brief Carries out a committed backend switch (spec 6 §9), in one batch: every mounted screen's
1085 /// `onBackendChange` runs first, then every entry is marked stale and the mounted queries refetch, and
1086 /// `{"env": "backend"}` becomes @p backend. A query on a private alias therefore never fetches before its
1087 /// screen has recovered from the switch.
1088 /// @param backend The backend now in use.
1089 void backendChanged(std::string const& backend);
1090
1091 /// @brief Registers a mounted screen or app document, whose `onBackendChange` a backend switch runs.
1092 /// @param screen It. Borrowed until `detachScreen`.
1093 void attachScreen(detail::ScreenCore& screen) { _screens.push_back(&screen); }
1094
1095 /// @brief Forgets a screen or app document.
1096 /// @param screen It.
1097 void detachScreen(detail::ScreenCore& screen) { std::erase(_screens, &screen); }
1098
1099 /// @brief Starts a query's request before its screen mounts, so the screen mounts on a warm cache.
1100 /// @param channel The alias's channel.
1101 /// @param token The alias's instance token (`Screen::instanceToken`).
1102 /// @param typeId The model type.
1103 /// @param action The action.
1104 /// @param body The body.
1105 void prefetch(std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const& channel, std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
1106 std::string const& action, Value const& body) {
1107 auto entry = acquire(token, typeId, action, false, body);
1108 if (!entry->pending.peek() && (!entry->hasValue.peek() || entry->stale)) {
1109 fetch(entry, channel);
1110 }
1111 release(entry);
1112 }

1114 /// @brief The number of entries in the cache.
1115 /// @return It.
1116 [[nodiscard]] std::size_t cacheSize() const noexcept { return _entries.size(); }
1117
1118 /// @brief A fresh instance token for a private alias: what the cache key holds for its instance.
1119 /// @return It, unique in the session.
1120 [[nodiscard]] std::string privateToken() { return "private#" + std::to_string(++_privateTokens); }
1121
1122 /// @brief Whether the newest write to a document source was made by a user event (spec 5 §6, `source: "user"`).
1123 /// @return It.
1124 [[nodiscard]] bool lastWriteByUser() const noexcept { return _lastWriteUser; }
1125
1126 /// @brief Records a write to a document source.
1127 void noteWrite() noexcept { _lastWriteUser = _userDepth > 0; }
1128
1129 /// @brief Runs @p body as a user event: what it writes counts as the user's.
1130 /// @param body The body.
1131 void asUser(std::function<void()> const& body) {
1132 ++_userDepth;
1133 try {
1134 body();
1135 } catch (...) {
1136 --_userDepth;
1137 throw;
1138 }
1139 --_userDepth;
1140 }
1141
1142 /// @brief The cache key of a query.
1143 /// @param token The alias's instance token.
1144 /// @param typeId The model type.
1145 /// @param action The action.
1146 /// @param evaluate Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
1147 /// @param body The canonical body.
1148 /// @return The key.
1149 [[nodiscard]] static std::string cacheKey(std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
1150 std::string const& action, bool evaluate, std::string const& body) {
1151 return typeId + '\x1f' + token + '\x1f' + (evaluate ? "evaluate:" : "") + action + '\x1f' + body;
1152 }
1153
1154 /// @brief Finds or makes an entry and counts one more user.
1155 /// @param token The alias's instance token.
1156 /// @param typeId The model type.
1157 /// @param action The action.
1158 /// @param evaluate Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
1159 /// @param body The body.
1160 /// @return The entry.
1161 std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> acquire(std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
1162 std::string const& action, bool evaluate, Value const& body) {
1163 std::string const text = detail::canonicalJson(body);
1164 std::string key = cacheKey(token, typeId, action, evaluate, text);
1165 auto found = _entries.find(key);
1166 if (found == _entries.end()) {
1167 auto entry = std::make_shared<detail::CacheEntry>(*_runtime);
1168 entry->key = key;
1169 entry->typeId = typeId;
1170 entry->action = action;
1171 entry->body = text;
1172 entry->evaluate = evaluate;
1173 entry->instanceToken = token;
1174 if (_options.catalog.action) {
1175 if (auto const info = _options.catalog.action(action)) {
1176 entry->secretFields = info->secretFields;
1177 if (!evaluate) {
1178 entry->records = info->records;
1179 }
1180 }
1181 }
1182 countTopics(*entry, +1);
1183 found = _entries.emplace(std::move(key), std::move(entry)).first;
1184 }
1185 ++found->second->users;
1186 found->second->evict.cancel();
1187 return found->second;
1188 }
1189
1190 /// @brief Counts one user less; an entry nobody uses is dropped after `keepUnused`.
1191 /// @param entry The entry.
1192 void release(std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const& entry) {
1193 if (--entry->users > 0 || _options.scheduler == nullptr) {
1194 return;
1195 }
1196 std::weak_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const weak = entry;
1197 entry->evict = _options.scheduler->after(_options.keepUnused, [this, weak] {
1198 auto const held = weak.lock();
1199 if (held && held->users == 0) {
1200 countTopics(*held, -1);
1201 _entries.erase(held->key);
1202 flushWatches();
1203 }
1204 });
1205 }
1206
1207 /// @brief Sends an entry's request under a new generation; a reply of an older generation is dropped.
1208 /// @param entry The entry.
1209 /// @param channel The channel to send it through; `nullptr` fails the request at once.
1210 void fetch(std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const& entry, std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const& channel) {
1211 // The watch goes out before the read, on the same connection, so a change committed after the read is
1212 // seen as an event.
1213 flushWatches();
1214 std::uint64_t const generation = ++entry->generation;
1215 if (channel == nullptr) {
1216 settleFailure(*entry, "the model alias has no instance", "error");
1217 return;
1218 }
1219 entry->pending.set(true);
1220 std::weak_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const weak = entry;
1221 try {
1222 auto completion = channel->execute(entry->action, entry->body, CallOptions{.evaluate = entry->evaluate});
1223 completion
1224 .then([this, weak, generation](std::string const& reply) {
1225 auto const held = weak.lock();
1226 if (held && held->generation == generation) {
1227 settleReply(*held, reply);
1228 }
1229 })
1230 .onError([this, weak, generation](std::exception_ptr const& error) {
1231 auto const held = weak.lock();
1232 if (held && held->generation == generation) {
1233 settleFailure(*held, detail::failureText(error), classify(error));
1234 }
1235 });
1236 } catch (...) {
1237 std::exception_ptr const error = std::current_exception();
1238 settleFailure(*entry, detail::failureText(error), classify(error));
1239 }
1240 }
1241
1242 /// @brief Writes an entry's confirmed value and re-applies its optimistic layers over it.
1243 /// @param entry The entry.
1244 /// @param confirmed The confirmed value.
1245 void confirm(detail::CacheEntry& entry, Value const& confirmed) {
1246 entry.confirmed = detail::withoutFields(confirmed, entry.secretFields);
1247 showLayers(entry);
1248 }
1249
1250 /// @brief Recomputes what an entry shows from its confirmed value and its layers.
1251 /// @param entry The entry.
1252 void showLayers(detail::CacheEntry& entry) {
1253 Value shown = entry.confirmed;
1254 for (detail::OptimisticLayer const& layer : entry.layers) {
1255 if (auto patched = detail::patchRows(shown, layer.at, layer.key, layer.with)) {
1256 shown = std::move(*patched);
1257 }
1258 }
1259 noteWrite();
1260 entry.value.set(std::move(shown));
1261 }

1263 /// @brief The error kind of a failure.
1264 /// @param error The failure.
1265 /// @return The kind.
1266 [[nodiscard]] std::string classify(std::exception_ptr const& error) const {
1267 return _options.classify ? _options.classify(error) : detail::defaultErrorKind(error);

1270 /// @brief The clock.
1271 /// @return Now.
1272 [[nodiscard]] std::chrono::milliseconds now() const {
1273 if (_options.clock) {
1274 return _options.clock();
1275 }
1276 return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
1277 std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch());
1278 }

1280 /// @brief Registers a mounted query, which a reconnect and a backend switch refetch.
1281 /// @param query The query.
1282 void attachQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { _mounted.push_back(&query); }
1283
1284 /// @brief Unregisters a mounted query.
1285 /// @param query The query.
1286 void forgetQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { std::erase(_mounted, &query); }

1288 /// @brief A call of @p actionId on a model of @p typeId succeeded: applies the action's effects to the cache
1289 /// (spec 8 §9).
1290 ///
1291 /// `updates R` merges the reply's rows of `R` into each entry holding `R`, matched by the record's key field at
1292 /// the entry's paths, with no fetch; an entry whose fetch is in flight also fetches once more, since that fetch
1293 /// may have read before the write. `changes R` marks each entry holding `R` stale. `changesInstance` marks each
1294 /// entry read through the same instance. A marked entry refetches through a mounted query that uses it. A
1295 /// discarded reply only marks: its `updates` act as `changes`.
1296 /// @param typeId The model type.
1297 /// @param actionId The action.
1298 /// @param reply The reply's value.
1299 /// @param use Whether the reply was applied or discarded.
1300 /// @param instanceToken The instance token of the alias the call went through.
1301 void actionSucceeded(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply, ReplyUse use,
1302 std::string const& instanceToken);
1303
1304 /// @brief The connection to the server was made again (spec 8 §7, "Reconnect"): sends the whole watch set with
1305 /// `replace: true`, then marks every entry but an `evaluate` one stale. A mounted entry refetches, and one
1306 /// whose fetch is in flight fetches once more when that fetch settles, so a change missed while the
1307 /// connection was down is read again.
1308 void reconnected();
1309
1310 /// @brief The topics the cache holds now: every record an entry holds, and the keyed shared instance of every
1311 /// entry whose action holds no record. What `reconnected` sends.
1312 /// @return The topics, records and instances each in name order; `replace` is false.
1313 [[nodiscard]] wire::WatchBody watchSet() const;
1314
1315 /// @brief Applies a server event to the cache (spec 8 §9).
1316 ///
1317 /// A `changes` event marks the entries it names stale, and a `resync` sends the whole watch set again, as
1318 /// `reconnected` does, and marks every entry but an `evaluate` one;
1319 /// each marked entry refetches through a mounted query that uses it, and one no query uses refetches when a
1320 /// query mounts on it. An event of another topic, or a payload that cannot be read, is ignored.
1321 /// @param event The event.
1322 void deliverEvent(wire::EventBody const& event);
1323
1324 /// @brief Applies a `changes` event's payload to the cache, in one reactive batch.
1325 ///
1326 /// A record change with keys marks each entry holding the record whose value has a row with one of the keys,
1327 /// and an entry holding it keyless; a record change without keys marks every entry holding the record. An
1328 /// instance change marks every entry read through that instance: the keyed shared one its primary key names,
1329 /// or, with no primary key, the connection's own private ones of that model type.
1330 /// @param changes The payload.
1331 void applyChanges(wire::ChangesBody const& changes);
1332
1333 /// @brief Marks an entry stale. While its fetch is in flight, the entry also refetches once that fetch settles,
1334 /// because the fetch may have read before the change.
1335 /// @param entry The entry.
1336 static void markStale(detail::CacheEntry& entry) {
1337 entry.stale = true;
1338 if (entry.pending.peek()) {
1339 entry.refetchAfter = true;
1340 }
1341 }
1342
1343private:
1344 // A cap of 0 moves nothing inline, and one above the largest would not fit an envelope once encoded.
1345 [[nodiscard]] static SessionOptions checkedOptions(SessionOptions options) {
1346 if (options.maxInlineFileBytes == 0 || options.maxInlineFileBytes > kMaxInlineFileBytes) {
1347 throw std::invalid_argument{"morph::ui::Session: maxInlineFileBytes is " +
1348 std::to_string(options.maxInlineFileBytes) + "; it is 1 to " +
1349 std::to_string(kMaxInlineFileBytes) + " (kMaxInlineFileBytes)"};
1350 }
1351 return options;
1352 }
1353
1354 void settleReply(detail::CacheEntry& entry, std::string const& reply) {
1355 auto json = parseJson(reply);
1356 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
1357 if (!value) {
1358 settleFailure(entry, "the reply is not a document value: " + value.error(), "error");
1359 return;
1360 }
1361 _runtime->batch([&] {
1362 confirm(entry, *value);
1363 entry.hasValue.set(true);
1364 entry.error.set({});
1365 entry.errorKind.set({});
1366 entry.pending.set(false);
1367 entry.fetchedAt = now();
1368 entry.stale = entry.refetchAfter;
1369 if (entry.refetchAfter) {
1370 entry.refetchAfter = false;
1371 refetchMounted(entry);
1372 }
1373 });
1374 }
1375
1376 /// @brief Refetches an entry through the mounted queries that use it; one fetch even when several do.
1377 /// @param entry The entry.
1378 void refetchMounted(detail::CacheEntry const& entry);
1379
1380 /// @brief Applies a reply's effects to the cache, for `actionSucceeded`.
1381 /// @param typeId The model type.
1382 /// @param actionId The action.
1383 /// @param reply The reply's value.
1384 /// @param use Whether the reply was applied or discarded.
1385 /// @param instanceToken The instance token of the alias the call went through.
1386 void applyReplyEffects(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply, ReplyUse use,
1387 std::string const& instanceToken);
1388
1389 /// @brief Counts an entry's topics in or out, queueing a `watch` for a count that leaves zero and an `unwatch`
1390 /// for one that returns to it.
1391 /// @param entry The entry.
1392 /// @param delta `+1` when the entry is made, `-1` when it is dropped.
1393 void countTopics(detail::CacheEntry const& entry, int delta);
1394
1395 /// @brief Sends the queued watch changes, at most one `watch` and one `unwatch`; drops them when there is no
1396 /// watcher.
1397 void flushWatches();
1398
1399 /// @brief Sends one watch request, ignoring its reply: a refused topic simply sends no events.
1400 /// @param kind The kind, `watch` or `unwatch`.
1401 /// @param body The body.
1402 void sendWatch(std::string_view kind, wire::WatchBody const& body) const;
1403
1404 /// @brief Marks every entry but an `evaluate` one stale and refetches the mounted ones, in one batch.
1405 void markAllStale();
1406
1407 /// @brief Marks each entry of @p marks stale and refetches it through a mounted query that uses it.
1408 /// @param marks The entries.
1409 void markAndRefetch(detail::Marks const& marks);
1410
1411 /// @brief Applies one `updates` or `changes` effect of a reply: patches the entries holding the record, or marks
1412 /// them.
1413 /// @param effect The effect.
1414 /// @param record The record it names.
1415 /// @param info The action's catalog entry, for the records its reply holds.
1416 /// @param reply The reply's value.
1417 /// @param use Whether the reply was applied or discarded.
1418 /// @param marks Where entries to mark go.
1419 void applyRecordEffect(ActionEffect const& effect, std::string const& record, ActionInfo const& info,
1420 Value const& reply, ReplyUse use, detail::Marks& marks);
1421
1422 /// @brief Finds the entries a `changes` event's record change names.
1423 /// @param change The change.
1424 /// @param marks Where they go.
1425 void markRecordChange(effects::RecordChange const& change, detail::Marks& marks);
1426
1427 /// @brief Finds the entries a `changes` event's instance change names.
1428 /// @param instance The instance.
1429 /// @param marks Where they go.
1430 void markInstanceChange(wire::InstanceTopic const& instance, detail::Marks& marks);
1431
1432 void settleFailure(detail::CacheEntry& entry, std::string text, std::string kind) {
1433 _runtime->batch([&] {
1434 noteWrite();
1435 entry.error.set(std::move(text));
1436 entry.errorKind.set(std::move(kind));
1437 entry.pending.set(false);
1438 });
1439 }
1440
1441 static void detachQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query);
1442
1443 reactive::Runtime* _runtime;
1444 SessionOptions _options;
1445 reactive::Signal<std::set<std::string, std::less<>>> _permitted;
1446 std::map<std::string, int, std::less<>> _recordRefs;
1447 std::map<std::pair<std::string, std::string>, int> _instanceRefs;
1448 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _watchRecords;
1449 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _unwatchRecords;
1450 std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> _watchInstances;
1451 std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> _unwatchInstances;
1452 reactive::Signal<std::shared_ptr<FormatContext const>> _format;
1453 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _env;
1454 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _sessionValues;
1455 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _hostValues;
1456 detail::RtScope const* _appScope = nullptr;
1457 std::vector<detail::ScreenCore*> _screens;
1458 reactive::Signal<std::set<std::string, std::less<>>> _hostCommandNames;
1459 std::function<HostCommandResult(std::string const&, Value const&)> _hostCommandRunner;
1460 std::map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry>, std::less<>> _entries;
1461 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> _mounted;
1462 int _userDepth = 0;
1463 bool _lastWriteUser = false;
1464 std::uint64_t _privateTokens = 0;
1465};

1646 /// @brief A table's last activated key.

1677/// @brief One check at run time.
1678struct CheckRuntime {
1679 /// @brief The declaration.

1681 /// @brief Whether `assert` is `false`.

1683 /// @brief The message, as text.
1684 reactive::Computed<std::string>* message = nullptr;
1685 /// @brief The elements it targets.
1686 std::vector<ElementState*> targets;
1687
1688 CheckRuntime() = default;
1689 CheckRuntime(CheckRuntime const&) = delete;
1690 CheckRuntime& operator=(CheckRuntime const&) = delete;
1691 CheckRuntime(CheckRuntime&&) = delete;
1692 CheckRuntime& operator=(CheckRuntime&&) = delete;
1693
1694 /// @brief Leaves its targets.
1695 ~CheckRuntime() {
1696 for (ElementState* const target : targets) {
1697 std::erase(target->checks, this);
1698 target->checksVersion.set(target->checksVersion.peek() + 1);
1699 }
1700 }
1701};

1733/// @brief One document scope at run time: the screen, a dialog's or drawer's content, a switch case or a row.
1734///
1735/// It lives while anything that reads it does: the view nodes lowered in it hold it by `shared_ptr`, a reply or
1736/// a timer holds it weakly. It belongs to a `ScreenCore`, which outlives it.
1737class RtScope : public std::enable_shared_from_this<RtScope> {
1738public:
1739 /// @brief An empty scope.
1740 /// @param screen The screen.
1741 /// @param enclosing The enclosing scope; `nullptr` for the screen and a component fallback.
1742 /// @param current The row of a row scope; `nullptr` otherwise.
1743 /// @param depth The reactive scope depth of what it owns.
1744 RtScope(ScreenCore& screen, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> enclosing, reactive::Signal<Value> const* current,
1745 std::size_t depth);
1746
1747 RtScope(RtScope const&) = delete;
1748 RtScope& operator=(RtScope const&) = delete;
1749 RtScope(RtScope&&) = delete;
1750 RtScope& operator=(RtScope&&) = delete;
1751
1752 /// @brief Releases what it owns, and tells the dialog it belongs to.
1753 ~RtScope();
1754
1755 /// @brief Resolves a name, innermost scope first.
1756 /// @param name The name.
1757 /// @return The declaration, or `nullptr`.
1758 [[nodiscard]] NameRef const* find(std::string_view name) const {
1759 for (RtScope const* scope = this; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent.get()) {
1760 auto const found = scope->names.find(name);
1761 if (found != scope->names.end()) {
1762 return &found->second;
1763 }
1764 }
1765 return nullptr;
1766 }
1767
1768 /// @brief The innermost row, from this scope outwards.
1769 /// @return The row signal, or `nullptr`.
1770 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Signal<Value> const* innermostRow() const {
1771 for (RtScope const* scope = this; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent.get()) {
1772 if (scope->row != nullptr) {
1773 return scope->row;
1774 }
1775 }
1776 return nullptr;
1777 }
1778
1779 /// @brief The innermost scope that decides when errors show and is submitted: a dialog's, or the screen's.
1780 /// @return The scope.
1781 [[nodiscard]] RtScope const& policyScope() const {
1782 RtScope const* scope = this;
1783 while (scope->submitted == nullptr && scope->parent != nullptr) {
1784 scope = scope->parent.get();
1785 }
1786 return *scope;
1787 }
1788
1789 /// @brief Whether every element of the scope is valid and no blocking check of it fails. A tracked read.
1790 /// @return It.
1791 [[nodiscard]] bool ready() const;
1792
1793 /// @brief The screen.
1794 ScreenCore& core;
1795 /// @brief The enclosing scope.
1796 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> parent;
1797 /// @brief The row of a row scope.
1798 reactive::Signal<Value> const* row = nullptr;
1799 /// @brief The canonical key of a row scope's row; empty for any other scope.
1800 std::string rowKey;
1801 /// @brief For a component fallback's scope, the focus key of the `custom` node it is lowered for, so one
1802 /// fallback lowered for two uses keys its elements apart; empty for any other scope.
1803 std::string usePrefix;
1804 /// @brief The dialog or drawer whose content it is.
1805 ElementState* owner = nullptr;
1806 /// @brief `touched`, `submit` or `always`, for a scope that decides it.
1807 std::string showErrors;
1808 /// @brief `submitted` of a scope that decides when errors show.
1809 reactive::Signal<bool>* submitted = nullptr;
1810 /// @brief Its names.
1811 std::map<std::string, NameRef, std::less<>> names;
1812 /// @brief Its state.
1813 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<StateSlot>> states;
1814 /// @brief Its elements, in document order.
1815 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ElementState>> elements;
1816 /// @brief Its transfers.
1817 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<TransferState>> transfers;
1818 /// @brief Its model aliases.
1819 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ModelAlias>> models;
1820 /// @brief Its queries.
1821 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<QueryRuntime>> queries;
1822 /// @brief Its mutations.
1823 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<MutationRuntime>> mutations;
1824 /// @brief Its checks.
1825 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<CheckRuntime>> checks;
1826 /// @brief The reactive nodes it owns; declared last, so they go first.
1827 reactive::Scope nodes;
1828};

1830/// @brief The `Environment` the evaluator reads through: a scope chain and the names bound at one place.
1831class ScopeEnv final : public Environment {
1832public:
1833 /// @brief Reads @p scope.
1834 /// @param scope The scope.
1835 /// @param bindings The names bound here; may be `nullptr`.
1836 /// @param row A row to read instead of the scope's (a table's `key`, evaluated before its row scope exists).
1837 ScopeEnv(RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings, Value const* row = nullptr)
1838 : _scope{&scope}, _bindings{bindings}, _row{row} {}
1839
1840 /// @brief Reads a name: a binding, then the scope chain.
1841 /// @param head The name.
1842 /// @param path The path after it.
1843 /// @return The value.
1844 [[nodiscard]] Value ref(std::string_view head, std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
1845
1846 /// @brief Reads the innermost row.
1847 /// @param path The path.
1848 /// @return The value.
1849 [[nodiscard]] Value row(std::span<std::string const> path) const override {
1850 if (_row != nullptr) {
1851 return walk(*_row, path);
1852 }
1853 reactive::Signal<Value> const* const current = _scope->innermostRow();
1854 return current == nullptr ? Value{} : walk(current->get(), path);
1855 }
1856
1857 /// @brief Reads a query or mutation form.
1858 /// @param form The form.
1859 /// @param name The query or mutation.
1860 /// @return The value.
1861 [[nodiscard]] Value control(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const override;
1862
1863 /// @brief Reads a customization choice.
1864 /// @param point The point.
1865 /// @param path The path.
1866 /// @return The value.
1867 [[nodiscard]] Value pref(std::string_view point, std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
1868
1869 /// @brief Reads `env`, `session` or `host`.
1870 /// @param form The form.
1871 /// @param name The name.
1872 /// @return The value.
1873 [[nodiscard]] Value client(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const override;
1874
1875 /// @brief The session's formatting facts.
1876 /// @return They.
1877 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formatting() const override;
1878
1879 /// @brief Reports to the screen's diagnostics.
1880 /// @param path The expression's path.
1881 /// @param reason What went wrong.
1882 void report(std::string_view path, std::string_view reason) const override;
1883
1884private:
1885 RtScope const* _scope;
1886 Bindings const* _bindings;
1887 Value const* _row;
1888};

1890/// @brief Evaluates an expression in a scope.
1891/// @param scope The scope.
1892/// @param bindings The names bound here; may be `nullptr`.
1893/// @param expr The expression; `nullptr` evaluates to `null`.
1894/// @return The value.
1895[[nodiscard]] inline Value evalIn(RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings, ExprPtr const& expr) {
1896 if (!expr) {
1897 return Value{};
1898 }
1899 ScopeEnv const env{scope, bindings};
1900 return evaluate(*expr, env);
1901}
1902
1903/// @brief Whether a value counts as given for `required`: not `null`, not an empty string or list.
1904/// @param value The value.
1905/// @return It.
1906[[nodiscard]] inline bool engaged(Value const& value) {
1907 if (value.isNull()) {
1908 return false;
1909 }
1910 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1911 return !text->empty();
1912 }
1913 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
1914 return !items->empty();
1915 }
1916 return true;
1917}
1918
1919/// @brief A value as text for a widget: a string as itself, a number in the locale, a timestamp in ISO 8601,
1920/// `null` as nothing, anything else as JSON.
1921/// @param value The value.
1922/// @param format The formatting facts.
1923/// @return The text.
1924[[nodiscard]] inline std::string textOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
1925 if (value.isNull()) {
1926 return {};
1927 }
1928 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1929 return *text;
1930 }
1931 if (bool const* const flag = value.asBool()) {
1932 return *flag ? "true" : "false";
1933 }
1934 // A number that cannot be rounded at its own places shows as its exact JSON rather than as a clamped value.
1935 if (Quantity const* const quantity = value.asQuantity()) {
1936 auto number = formatNumber(value, format.numeric);
1937 return number ? *number + " " + unitDisplay(quantity->unit, format.units) : canonicalJson(value);
1938 }
1939 if (auto number = formatNumber(value, format.numeric)) {
1940 return *std::move(number);
1941 }
1942 if (time::DateTime const* const instant = value.asTimestamp()) {
1943 return instant->toIso8601();
1944 }
1945 return canonicalJson(value);
1946}
1947
1948/// @brief A value as a view key: an `int` or a string as itself, anything else as its JSON text.
1949/// @param value The value.
1950/// @return The key.
1951[[nodiscard]] inline Key keyOf(Value const& value) {
1952 if (std::int64_t const* const number = value.asInt()) {
1953 return Key{*number};
1954 }
1955 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1956 return Key{*text};
1957 }
1958 return Key{canonicalJson(value)};
1959}
1960
1961/// @brief A view key as a value.
1962/// @param key The key.
1963/// @return An `int` or a string.
1964[[nodiscard]] inline Value valueOfKey(Key const& key) {
1965 if (std::int64_t const* const number = std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&key)) {
1966 return Value{*number};
1967 }
1968 return Value{std::get<std::string>(key)};
1969}
1970
1971/// @brief A list of strings out of a value: a string, a list of strings, or nothing.
1972/// @param value The value.
1973/// @return The strings.
1974[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::string> stringsOf(Value const& value) {
1975 std::vector<std::string> out;
1976 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1977 out.push_back(*text);
1978 } else if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
1979 for (Value const& item : *items) {
1980 if (std::string const* const element = item.asString()) {
1981 out.push_back(*element);
1982 }
1983 }
1984 }
1985 return out;
1986}
1987
1988/// @brief A list of strings as a value.
1989/// @param texts The strings.
1990/// @return The list.
1991[[nodiscard]] inline Value listOfStrings(std::vector<std::string> const& texts) {
1992 ValueList items;
1993 items.reserve(texts.size());
1994 for (std::string const& text : texts) {
1995 items.emplace_back(text);
1996 }
1997 return Value{std::move(items)};
1998}

2000/// @brief A query at run time (spec 5 §5): a key over the scope, an entry of the session's cache, latest wins.
2001class QueryRuntime {
2002public:
2003 /// @brief A query of @p scope, not yet started.
2004 /// @param decl The declaration.
2005 /// @param scope The scope.
2006 /// @param alias The model alias it goes through.
2007 QueryRuntime(QueryDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias);
2008
2009 QueryRuntime(QueryRuntime const&) = delete;
2010 QueryRuntime& operator=(QueryRuntime const&) = delete;
2011 QueryRuntime(QueryRuntime&&) = delete;
2012 QueryRuntime& operator=(QueryRuntime&&) = delete;
2013
2014 /// @brief Stops its timers and releases its entry.
2015 ~QueryRuntime();
2016
2017 /// @brief Starts it: makes its key and the Effect that follows it, and its refresh timer.
2018 void start();
2019
2020 /// @brief The value: the entry's, kept from the previous key while the new one has none. A tracked read.
2021 /// @return It.
2022 [[nodiscard]] Value value() const;
2023
2024 /// @brief Whether a request is in flight or waiting out its debounce. A tracked read.
2025 /// @return It.
2026 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const;
2027
2028 /// @brief The failure's text, `null` when none. A tracked read.
2029 /// @return It.
2030 [[nodiscard]] Value error() const;
2031
2032 /// @brief The failure's kind, `null` when none. A tracked read.
2033 /// @return It.
2034 [[nodiscard]] Value errorKind() const;
2035
2036 /// @brief Whether the query has a value or a failure for its current key, or is idle. A tracked read, for a
2037 /// boundary.
2038 /// @return It.
2039 [[nodiscard]] bool settled() const;
2040
2041 /// @brief Refetches the current key now, ending a debounce wait.
2042 void refetch();
2043
2044 /// @brief Fetches the key its body has now, inside the batch that changed the body: switches to that key's entry
2045 /// when it differs from the current one, and fetches the current one otherwise. A backend switch uses it,
2046 /// so a body `onBackendChange` changed is fetched once, with what the recovery set, and the old key is
2047 /// not fetched first.
2048 void refetchCurrent();
2049
2050 /// @brief Marks its entry stale and refetches it.
2051 void invalidate() {
2052 if (auto const& current = _entry.peek()) {
2053 current->stale = true;
2054 }
2055 refetch();
2056 }
2057
2058 /// @brief Forgets its entry without releasing it: the session dropped the cache.
2059 void detach() {
2060 _entry.set(nullptr);
2061 _carried.set(Value{});
2062 _target = {};
2063 }
2064
2065 /// @brief The current entry. A tracked read.
2066 /// @return It, or `nullptr` while idle.
2067 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry> const& entry() const { return _entry.get(); }
2068
2069 /// @brief The declaration.
2070 /// @return It.
2071 [[nodiscard]] QueryDecl const& decl() const noexcept { return *_decl; }
2072
2073 /// @brief The model type.
2074 /// @return It.
2075 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& typeId() const noexcept { return _typeId; }
2076
2077 /// @brief The channel its alias is bound to now.
2078 /// @return It, or `nullptr` while the alias is unbound.
2079 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channel() const;
2080
2081private:
2082 /// @brief What a key evaluates to: the cache entry it names and the body, or idle.
2083 struct Target {
2084 bool idle = true;
2085 std::string token;
2086 Value body;
2087 std::string bodyText;
2088 bool operator==(Target const& other) const {
2089 return idle == other.idle && token == other.token && bodyText == other.bodyText;
2090 }
2091 };
2092
2093 void switchTo(Target const& target);
2094
2095 QueryDecl const* _decl;
2096 std::string _typeId;
2097 RtScope* _scope;
2098 ModelAlias* _alias;
2099 reactive::Signal<std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry>> _entry;
2100 reactive::Signal<Value> _carried;
2101 reactive::Signal<bool> _waiting;
2102 Target _target;
2103 Target _pendingTarget;
2104 // The query's key, owned by its scope's nodes; set once `start` made it.
2105 reactive::Computed<Target> const* _key = nullptr;
2106 reactive::TimerHandle _debounce;
2107 reactive::TimerHandle _refresh;
2108 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
2109};

2111/// @brief One run of a mutation, as a command sees it: whether it succeeded, and the reply.
2112using RunDone = std::function<void(bool succeeded, Value const& reply)>;

2114/// @brief A mutation at run time (spec 5 §5): concurrency, optimistic writes and the reply's effects.
2115class MutationRuntime {
2116public:
2117 /// @brief A mutation of @p scope.
2118 /// @param decl The declaration.
2119 /// @param scope The scope.
2120 /// @param alias The model alias it goes through.
2121 MutationRuntime(MutationDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias);
2122
2123 MutationRuntime(MutationRuntime const&) = delete;
2124 MutationRuntime& operator=(MutationRuntime const&) = delete;
2125 MutationRuntime(MutationRuntime&&) = delete;
2126 MutationRuntime& operator=(MutationRuntime&&) = delete;
2127
2128 /// @brief Drops the replies still to come.
2129 ~MutationRuntime();
2130
2131 /// @brief Runs it, queues the run or refuses it, as its concurrency says.
2132 /// @param body The body.
2133 /// @param bindings The names bound where the run was started, for `onSuccess` and `onError`.
2134 /// @param done Called once the run settles, or at once when it is refused.
2135 void run(Value body, std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings, RunDone done);
2136
2137 /// @brief Whether a run is in flight or queued. A tracked read.
2138 /// @return It.
2139 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const { return _inFlight.get() > 0; }
2140
2141 /// @brief The last applied result. A tracked read.
2142 /// @return It.
2143 [[nodiscard]] Value result() const { return _result.get(); }
2144
2145 /// @brief The last applied failure's text, or `null`. A tracked read.
2146 /// @return It.
2147 [[nodiscard]] Value error() const { return _error.get(); }
2148
2149 /// @brief The last applied failure's kind, or `null`. A tracked read.
2150 /// @return It.
2151 [[nodiscard]] Value errorKind() const { return _errorKind.get(); }
2152
2153 /// @brief The declaration.
2154 /// @return It.
2155 [[nodiscard]] MutationDecl const& decl() const noexcept { return *_decl; }
2156
2157 /// @brief The model type.
2158 /// @return It.
2159 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& typeId() const noexcept { return _typeId; }
2160
2161private:
2162 struct Run {
2163 std::uint64_t id = 0;
2164 Value body;
2165 std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
2166 RunDone done;
2167 std::string serialKey;
2168 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry>> layered;
2169 };
2170
2171 void send(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run);
2172 void settle(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run, std::optional<Value> reply, std::exception_ptr const& error);
2173 void next(std::string const& serialKey);
2174 void applyOptimistic(Run& run);
2175 void dropLayers(Run& run);
2176
2177 MutationDecl const* _decl;
2178 RtScope* _scope;
2179 ModelAlias* _alias;
2180 std::string _typeId;
2181 ScreenCore* _core;
2182 reactive::Signal<int> _inFlight;
2183 reactive::Signal<Value> _result;
2184 reactive::Signal<Value> _error;
2185 reactive::Signal<Value> _errorKind;
2186 std::uint64_t _runs = 0;
2187 std::uint64_t _latest = 0;
2188 std::map<std::string, std::deque<std::shared_ptr<Run>>, std::less<>> _queues;
2189 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _busy;
2190 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
2191};

2331/// @brief Collects the `onClick` lists of menu entries, submenus included.
2332/// @param entries The entries.
2333/// @param lists Where they go, in document order.
2334// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): a submenu is a menu one level down.
2335inline void menuCommandLists(std::span<DocNodePtr const> entries, std::vector<Commands const*>& lists) {
2336 for (DocNodePtr const& entry : entries) {
2337 if (Commands const* const commands = entry->event("onClick")) {
2338 lists.push_back(commands);
2339 }
2340 menuCommandLists(entry->partList("items"), lists);
2341 }

2344/// @brief Collects the command lists of a screen's head: its actions', its menu entries' and its tools'.
2345/// @param doc The screen's document.
2346/// @param lists Where they go, in document order.
2347inline void headCommandLists(Document const& doc, std::vector<Commands const*>& lists) {
2348 for (DocNodePtr const& action : doc.actions) {
2349 if (Commands const* const commands = action->event("onClick")) {
2350 lists.push_back(commands);
2351 }
2352 }
2353 menuCommandLists(doc.menu, lists);
2354 for (DocNodePtr const& tool : doc.tools) {
2355 for (std::string_view const key : {"onChange", "onSubmit", "onChoose"}) {
2356 if (Commands const* const commands = tool->event(key)) {
2357 lists.push_back(commands);
2358 }
2359 }
2360 }
2361}

2363/// @brief A kind's key spec, from the kind table.
2364/// @param kind The kind spec.
2365/// @param key The key.
2366/// @return The spec, or `nullptr` when the kind has no such key of its own.
2367[[nodiscard]] inline KeySpec const* keySpec(KindSpec const& kind, std::string_view key) {
2368 for (KeySpec const& spec : kind.keys) {
2369 if (spec.key == key) {
2370 return &spec;
2371 }
2372 }
2373 return nullptr;
2374}
2375
2376/// @brief Whether a node kind keeps per-element state even without an id: the inputs, dialogs, tables and the forms
2377/// engine's screens.
2378/// @param kind The kind.
2379/// @return It.
2380[[nodiscard]] inline bool statefulKind(std::string_view kind) {
2381 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 12> kStateful = {
2382 "textInput", "checkbox", "select", "dateTimeInput", "slider", "filePicker",
2383 "dialog", "drawer", "table", "form", "collection", "wizard"};
2384 return listed(kStateful, kind);
2385}

2387/// @brief How many command lists the inspector's log keeps.
2388inline constexpr std::size_t kCommandLogSize = 256;
2389
2390/// @brief How often, in lowered nodes, the inspector's node list drops the nodes whose scope is gone.
2391inline constexpr std::size_t kPruneLoweredAt = 256;
2392
2393/// @brief The key a command is written with.
2394/// @param kind The command's kind.
2395/// @return Its key, such as `refetch`.
2396[[nodiscard]] inline std::string commandKey(CommandKind kind) {
2397 switch (kind) {
2398 case CommandKind::Set:
2399 return "set";
2400 case CommandKind::Reset:
2401 return "reset";
2402 case CommandKind::Run:
2403 return "run";
2404 case CommandKind::Refetch:
2405 return "refetch";
2406 case CommandKind::Open:
2407 return "open";
2408 case CommandKind::Close:
2409 return "close";
2410 case CommandKind::Navigate:
2411 return "navigate";
2412 case CommandKind::Return:
2413 return "return";
2414 case CommandKind::Focus:
2415 return "focus";
2416 case CommandKind::Host:
2417 return "host";
2418 case CommandKind::SwitchBackend:
2419 return "switchBackend";
2420 case CommandKind::ResetPrefs:
2421 return "resetPrefs";
2422 case CommandKind::SetLocale:
2423 return "setLocale";
2424 case CommandKind::Notify:
2425 return "notify";
2426 case CommandKind::Seq:
2427 return "seq";
2428 case CommandKind::All:
2429 return "all";
2430 case CommandKind::If:
2431 return "if";
2432 case CommandKind::CancelClose:
2433 return "cancelClose";
2434 case CommandKind::Retry:
2435 return "retry";
2436 case CommandKind::SignIn:
2437 return "signIn";
2438 case CommandKind::SignOut:
2439 return "signOut";
2440 case CommandKind::Upload:
2441 return "upload";
2442 case CommandKind::Download:
2443 return "download";
2444 default:
2445 return "unknown";
2446 }
2447}

2485/// @brief One mounted screen's interpreter: its document, diagnostics, slots and preferences, and the code that
2486/// declares scopes, lowers nodes and runs commands.
2487class ScreenCore {
2488public:
2489 /// @brief The core of a screen about to mount.
2490 /// @param doc The document.
2491 /// @param owner The session.
2492 /// @param calls The dispatcher.
2493 /// @param options The interpreter's options.
2494 /// @param mount The mount's options.
2495 ScreenCore(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc, Session& owner, Dispatcher& calls,
2496 InterpreterOptions const& options, MountOptions const& mount)
2497 : session{owner},
2498 dispatcher{calls},
2499 host{options.host},
2500 onDiagnostic{options.diagnostics},
2501 borrowed{mount.borrowed},
2502 depth{mount.depth},
2503 prefs{session.runtime()},
2504 submitted{session.runtime(), false},
2505 pendingWork{session.runtime(), 0},
2506 recording{owner.options().developmentTools == DevelopmentTools::On},
2507 _doc{std::move(doc)} {
2508 ValueRecord defaults;
2509 for (auto const& [name, point] : _doc->customize) {
2510 defaults.insert_or_assign(name, point.defaultValue);
2511 }
2512 prefDefaults = defaults;
2513 prefs.set(std::move(defaults));
2514 session.attachScreen(*this);
2515 }
2516
2517 ScreenCore(ScreenCore const&) = delete;
2518 ScreenCore& operator=(ScreenCore const&) = delete;
2519 ScreenCore(ScreenCore&&) = delete;
2520 ScreenCore& operator=(ScreenCore&&) = delete;
2521 /// @brief Takes the screen off the session, so a later backend switch does not run its `onBackendChange`.
2522 ~ScreenCore() { session.detachScreen(*this); }
2523
2524 /// @brief Runs a lifecycle list in the document's own scope, as a screen's or app document's own command list.
2525 /// @param key The lifecycle key, such as `onBackendChange`.
2526 void runLifecycleOf(std::string_view key) {
2527 auto const found = _doc->lifecycle.find(key);
2528 auto const scope = rootScope.lock();
2529 if (found == _doc->lifecycle.end() || !scope) {
2530 return;
2531 }
2532 CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = scope,
2533 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(),
2534 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
2535 .boundary = nullptr};
2536 runList(found->second, ctx, {});
2537 }
2538
2539 /// @brief The document.
2540 /// @return It.
2541 [[nodiscard]] Document const& doc() const noexcept { return *_doc; }
2542
2543 /// @brief The runtime.
2544 /// @return It.
2545 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return session.runtime(); }
2546
2547 /// @brief Reports a diagnostic once per path.
2548 /// @param path Where.
2549 /// @param reason What.
2550 void report(std::string_view path, std::string_view reason) {
2551 if (inspecting) {
2552 return;
2553 }
2554 std::string key = std::string{path} + '\x1f' + std::string{reason};
2555 if (!reported.insert(std::move(key)).second) {
2556 return;
2557 }
2558 Refusal const refusal{.document = _doc->id, .path = std::string{path}, .reason = std::string{reason}};
2559 diagnostics.push_back(refusal);
2560 if (onDiagnostic) {
2561 onDiagnostic(refusal);
2562 }
2563 }
2564
2565 /// @brief The next slot id: the interpreter numbers every bound property of the document.
2566 /// @return It.
2567 [[nodiscard]] SlotId nextSlot() noexcept { return _slots++; }
