2569 // --- Declaring a scope -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2570
2571 /// @brief Declares a scope's names and starts its reactive parts.
2572 /// @param scope The scope.
2573 /// @param decl Its declarations; `nullptr` when it declares none.
2574 /// @param content The nodes whose elements belong to it.
2575 /// @param commands The command lists whose transfers belong to it.
2576 void declare(RtScope& scope, ScopeDecl const* decl, std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content,
2577 std::vector<Commands const*> const& commands);
2578
2579 /// @brief Makes a state's signal from its init, once.
2580 /// @param scope The scope that declares it.
2581 /// @param slot The state.
2582 void initState(RtScope const& scope, StateSlot& slot) const {
2583 if (slot.value || slot.initializing) {
2584 return;
2585 }
2586 if (std::optional<Value> keptValue = keptState(scope, *slot.decl)) {
2587 slot.value = std::make_unique<reactive::Signal<Value>>(runtime(), std::move(*keptValue));
2588 return;
2589 }
2590 slot.initializing = true;
2591 Value init = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, slot.decl->init); });
2592 slot.value = std::make_unique<reactive::Signal<Value>>(runtime(), std::move(init));
2593 slot.initializing = false;
2594 }
2595
2596 /// @brief Reads an element value. A tracked read.
2597 /// @param element The element.
2598 /// @param name The value's name.
2599 /// @return The value.
2600 [[nodiscard]] Value elementValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) const;
2601 /// @brief Whether @p element is a group with an element inside it the user touched: a group has no value of its
2602 /// own to touch, so its errors show under the `touched` policy once any of its inputs is.
2603 /// @param element The element.
2604 /// @return True when it is such a group.
2605 [[nodiscard]] static bool touchedWithin(ElementState const& element);
2606
2607 /// @brief The current value of an input, checkbox or select: what `required` tests.
2608 /// @param element The element.
2609 /// @return The value.
2610 [[nodiscard]] Value inputValue(ElementState const& element) const;
2611
2612 // --- Commands ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2613
2614 /// @brief Runs a command list: each command in order in one batch; done when every command in it is.
2615 /// @param commands The list.
2616 /// @param ctx Where it runs.
2617 /// @param done Called once, with whether every command succeeded; may be empty.
2618 void runList(Commands const& commands, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done);
2619
2620 /// @brief Runs one command.
2621 /// @param command The command.
2622 /// @param ctx Where it runs.
2623 /// @param done Called once, with whether it succeeded.
2624 void runOne(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done);
2625
2626 /// @brief Runs a command list for an event of the user's.
2627 /// @param commands The list; `nullptr` runs nothing.
2628 /// @param ctx Where it was lowered.
2629 /// @param event The event's payload.
2630 void runEvent(Commands const* commands, LowerCtx const& ctx, Value event) {
2631 if (commands == nullptr || commands->empty()) {
2632 return;
2633 }
2634 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings);
2635 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "event", .read = [event = std::move(event)] { return event; }});
2636 CommandCtx const command{.scope = ctx.scope,
2637 .bindings = std::move(bindings),
2638 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
2639 .boundary = ctx.boundary};
2640 session.asUser([&] { runtime().batch([&] { runList(*commands, command, {}); }); });
2641 }

2643 /// @brief Lowers a list of `actionButton` parts into reactive models: label, icon, enabled and visible bound in
2644 /// @p ctx's scope, and a run function that runs the part's `onClick` there as a user event.

2646 /// @param ctx The scope the list belongs to.
2647 /// @return The models, in the parts' order.
2648 [[nodiscard]] ActionModels lowerActionParts(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx);

2660 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<HeadToolModel> lowerHeadTools(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2661
2662 /// @brief An overlay's actions as the action bar its footer shows: a button per action, test id
2663 /// `action_<id>`, shown and enabled as the action is.

2666 [[nodiscard]] static Node actionBarOf(ActionModels actions);

2668 /// @brief Lowers a screen head's `headBadge` parts, bound in @p ctx's scope.

2676 /// @brief Lowers a document node to a view node.
2677 /// @param node The node.
2678 /// @param ctx Where.
2679 /// @return The view node.
2680 [[nodiscard]] Node lower(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);

2682 /// @brief Lowers a node list into one node: the node itself, or a column of them.
2683 /// @param nodes The nodes.
2684 /// @param ctx Where.
2685 /// @param gap The spacing step between the nodes of a list of several; a single node is lowered unwrapped.
2686 /// @return The node.

2688 [[nodiscard]] Node lowerAll(std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes, LowerCtx const& ctx, int gap = 0);

2690 /// @brief The size request of one child of a holder.
2691 /// @param node The child.
2692 /// @param own The names the holder's own scope declares.
2693 /// @param ctx Where the holder is lowered.
2694 /// @return The child's hints; content size where its sizing reads a name in @p own.
2695 [[nodiscard]] LayoutHints nodeHints(DocNode const& node, std::set<std::string, std::less<>> const& own,
2696 LowerCtx const& ctx);

2698 /// @brief Reports each child of an overlay's or a case's content that sizes itself by a share, once at @p path,
2699 /// and
2700 /// makes it fill the holder instead.
2701 /// @param children The content, lowered.
2702 /// @param path Where the report points.
2703 void fillHolder(std::vector<Node>& children, std::string const& path);
2704 /// @brief The size request of a holder of @p content: the largest stretch of its children on each axis.
2705 ///
2706 /// A literal sizing is read as written and a computed one is evaluated once in the enclosing scope. A computed
2707 /// sizing that reads a name the holder's own scope declares cannot be evaluated before the holder mounts; it is
2708 /// reported and counts as content.
2709 /// @param content The holder's document children.
2710 /// @param decl The declarations of the holder's own scope; `nullptr` for none.
2711 /// @param ctx Where the holder is lowered.
2712 /// @return The hints; bounds and `alignSelf` stay unset, because they belong to a child.
2713 [[nodiscard]] LayoutHints holderHints(std::span<DocNode const* const> content, ScopeDecl const* decl,
2714 LowerCtx const& ctx);

2716 // NOLINTBEGIN(cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes): the screen's shared state, which its
2717 // scopes and runtimes read and write directly.
2718 /// @brief The session.
2719 Session& session;
2720 /// @brief The dispatcher.
2721 Dispatcher& dispatcher;
2722 /// @brief The host; may be `nullptr`.
2723 InterpreterHost* host;
2724 /// @brief The diagnostic callback.
2725 std::function<void(Refusal const&)> onDiagnostic;
2726 /// @brief Moves focus to a mounted element by its id; empty until the screen is mounted, and again once it is
2727 /// unmounting.
2728 std::function<bool(std::string_view)> focusElement;
2729 /// @brief The models the opener lends.
2730 std::map<std::string, BorrowedModel, std::less<>> borrowed;
2731 /// @brief The screen scope's reactive depth.
2732 std::size_t depth;
2733 /// @brief The diagnostics reported, in order.
2734 std::vector<Refusal> diagnostics;
2735 /// @brief The paths and reasons already reported.
2736 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> reported;
2737 /// @brief The customization choices, by point.
2738 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> prefs;
2739 /// @brief The points' defaults.
2740 ValueRecord prefDefaults;
2741 /// @brief The screen's `submitted`.
2742 reactive::Signal<bool> submitted;
2743 /// @brief The open dialogs and drawers, the mutation runs and the transfers in flight, across every scope of the
2744 /// screen: what a close waits for (spec 6 §3).
2745 reactive::Signal<int> pendingWork;
2746 /// @brief Whether this screen records what the inspector reads: its session's `developmentTools`, read once.
2747 bool const recording;
2748
2749 /// @brief Counts pending work in or out.
2750 /// @param delta What started (positive) or ended (negative).
2751 void addPending(int delta) { pendingWork.set(pendingWork.peek() + delta); }
2752 /// @brief The document's own scope, once mounted.
2753 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> rootScope;
2754 /// @brief A state of the screen this one replaces: its declared type's name and its value.
2755 struct KeptState {
2756 /// @brief The declared type's name.
2757 std::string type;
2758 /// @brief The value.
2759 Value value;
2760 };
2761 /// @brief The states of the own scope of the screen this one replaces, by name (`MountOptions::keepStateOf`).
2762 std::map<std::string, KeptState, std::less<>> keptStates;
2763 /// @brief A node as it was lowered, which the inspector lists while its scope lives.
2764 struct LoweredNode {
2765 /// @brief The node.
2766 DocNode const* node = nullptr;
2767 /// @brief The scope it was lowered in.
2768 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> scope;
2769 /// @brief The names bound where it was lowered.
2770 std::weak_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
2771 };
2772 /// @brief Every node lowered, in lowering order; an entry whose scope is gone is pruned as more are added.
2773 std::vector<LoweredNode> loweredNodes;
2774 /// @brief The screen's live scopes, in creation order.
2775 std::vector<RtScope*> scopes;
2776 /// @brief The latest command lists run, oldest first, at most `kCommandLogSize`.
2777 std::deque<CommandLogEntry> commandLog;
2778 /// @brief Set while the inspector evaluates, so that an expression error it meets is not reported.
2779 bool inspecting = false;
2780 // NOLINTEND(cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes)
2781
2782 /// @brief The value a state of the screen's own scope keeps from the screen it replaces: that screen's value of
2783 /// the state of the same name, when its declared type is the same and admits it.
2784 /// @param scope The scope that declares the state.
2785 /// @param decl The declaration.
2786 /// @return The value, or nothing for a state that starts from its init.
2787 [[nodiscard]] std::optional<Value> keptState(RtScope const& scope, StateDecl const& decl) const {
2788 if (keptStates.empty() || rootScope.lock().get() != &scope) {
2789 return std::nullopt;
2790 }
2791 auto const found = keptStates.find(decl.name);
2792 if (found == keptStates.end() || found->second.type != decl.type.name() ||
2793 !decl.type.admits(found->second.value)) {
2794 return std::nullopt;
2795 }
2796 return found->second.value;
2797 }

2936 /// @brief A bound property: a constant for a literal, a numbered slot otherwise.
2937 template <typename T, typename Convert>
2938 Prop<T> bindProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr, T fallback, Convert convert) {
2939 if (!expr) {
2940 return Prop<T>{std::move(fallback)};
2941 }
2942 if (expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
2943 return Prop<T>{convert(expr->literal, session.formatting())};
2944 }
2945 return Prop<T>{ui::slot(
2946 nextSlot(), [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr, convert, session = &session]() -> T {
2947 return convert(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr), session->formatting());
2948 })};
2949 }
2950
2951 /// @brief A text's role: a literal one as the loader checked it; a computed one evaluated in its slot, where a
2952 /// name of no role is reported once for its path and drawn `Normal`.
2953 Prop<TextRole> roleProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr);
2954 /// A key-value item: its caption, its value or spans, and its tone, each problem reported once at @p path.
2955 KeyValueItem keyValueItemOf(Value const& item, std::string const& path);
2956 /// A text's or a banner's `spans`, reported once at its path when it drops a run.
2957 Prop<std::vector<TextSpan>> spansProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr);
2958
2959 /// @brief A node's surface: the name of a theme surface, or empty for the default. A computed one is evaluated in
2960 /// its slot; `null` is no surface, and any other value that is not a string is reported for the node's
2961 /// `surface` path and drawn as no surface.
2962 Prop<std::string> surfaceOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2963
2964 /// @brief A property read through @p read, as a numbered slot.
2965 template <typename T, typename Read>
2966 Prop<T> slotProp(Read read) {
2967 return Prop<T>{ui::slot(nextSlot(), std::move(read))};
2968 }
2969
2970 /// @brief Evaluates an expression once, untracked: a property the view tree sets once.
2971 [[nodiscard]] Value once(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr) const {
2972 return runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), expr); });
2973 }
2974
2975 /// @brief Keeps a command list in the inspector's log.
2976 void logList(Commands const& commands) {
2977 CommandLogEntry entry{.event = {}, .commands = {}, .batch = runtime().core()->currentBatch()};
2978 std::string_view const first = commands.front().path;
2979 entry.event = std::string{first.substr(0, first.rfind('/') == std::string_view::npos ? 0 : first.rfind('/'))};
2980 for (Command const& command : commands) {
2981 entry.commands.push_back(
2982 LoggedCommand{.kind = commandKey(command.kind), .target = command.target, .path = command.path});
2983 }
2984 if (commandLog.size() == kCommandLogSize) {
2985 commandLog.pop_front();
2986 }
2987 commandLog.push_back(std::move(entry));
2988 }

2991 SlotId _slots = 1;
2992 /// @brief Expires with the screen, so a reply that arrives after it is gone reports nothing.
2993 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
2994};

3118/// @brief A mounted screen: its scopes, its view mounted through `Mounted`, and what its host asks of it.
3119///
3120/// Neither copyable nor movable. It belongs to the runtime's owner; the runtime, the session, the dispatcher and
3121/// the backend outlive it. Destroying it runs `onUnmount`, unmounts the view and releases every scope.
3122class Screen {
3123public:
3124 Screen(Screen const&) = delete;
3125 Screen& operator=(Screen const&) = delete;
3126 Screen(Screen&&) = delete;
3127 Screen& operator=(Screen&&) = delete;
3128
3129 /// @brief Runs `onUnmount`, then unmounts.
3130 ~Screen() {
3131 try {
3132 if (Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList("onUnmount")) {
3133 runCommands(*commands);
3134 }
3135 } catch (...) { // NOLINT(bugprone-empty-catch): a destructor has no one to report to.
3136 }
3137 _core->focusElement = {};
3138 _mounted.reset();
3139 _headActions.clear();
3140 _headStatus.clear();
3141 _headMenu.clear();
3142 _headTools.clear();
3143 _scope.reset();
3144 }
3145
3146 /// @brief The root widget.
3147 /// @return It, valid as long as the screen.
3148 [[nodiscard]] Widget& root() const {
3149 if (!_mounted) {
3150 throw std::logic_error{"the screen is not mounted"};
3151 }
3152 return _mounted->root();
3153 }
3154
3155 /// @brief The document's id.
3156 /// @return It.
3157 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& id() const noexcept { return _core->doc().id; }
3158
3159 /// @brief Evaluates an expression in the screen's scope: what a host reads (`title`, `identity`), and what a
3160 /// test inspects.
3161 /// @param expression The expression's JSON.
3162 /// @return The value; `null` for an expression that does not parse.
3163 [[nodiscard]] Value read(Json const& expression) const {
3164 auto parsed = parseExpression(expression);
3165 if (!parsed) {
3166 return Value{};
3167 }
3168 return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, *parsed);
3169 }

3171 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `title`.
3172 /// @return It, or `null`.
3173 [[nodiscard]] Value title() const { return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().title); }
3174
3175 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `identity`.
3176 /// @return It, or `null`.
3177 [[nodiscard]] Value identity() const { return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().identity); }

3179 /// @brief One model alias of the screen's own scope, with an instance.
3180 struct BoundAlias {
3181 /// @brief Its declaration.
3182 ModelDecl const* decl = nullptr;
3183 /// @brief The instance it is bound to.
3184 ChannelFacts facts;
3185 };
3186
3187 /// @brief The aliases of the screen's own scope that hold an instance now. One still binding is left out, and so
3188 /// is one of a nested scope, which is mounted per row or per opening and so names no one instance.
3189 /// @return Them, in declaration order.
3190 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<BoundAlias> boundAliases() const {
3191 std::vector<BoundAlias> bound;
3192 for (auto const& alias : _scope->models) {
3193 if (alias->channel == nullptr) {
3194 continue;
3195 }
3196 ChannelFacts facts = alias->channel->facts();
3197 if (facts.instanceId != 0) {
3198 bound.push_back(BoundAlias{.decl = alias->decl, .facts = std::move(facts)});
3199 }
3200 }
3201 return bound;
3202 }

3286 /// @brief Runs a head action's `onClick` as a user event in the screen scope, in one batch.
3287 /// @param actionId The action's id.
3288 /// @return Whether it ran: `false`, with a diagnostic, for an id the head does not hold, or holds hidden or
3289 /// disabled.
3290 bool runAction(std::string_view actionId) {
3291 auto const found = std::ranges::find(_headActions, actionId, &detail::ActionModel::id);
3292 if (found == _headActions.end()) {
3293 _core->report("/actions", "head action " + std::string{actionId} + " is unknown");
3294 return false;
3295 }
3296 auto const [visible, enabled] =
3297 runtime().untracked([&] { return std::pair{found->visible.evaluate(), found->enabled.evaluate()}; });
3298 if (!visible || !enabled) {
3299 _core->report(found->path, "head action " + found->id + (visible ? " is disabled" : " is hidden"));
3300 return false;
3301 }
3302 if (found->run) {
3303 found->run();
3304 }
3305 return true;
3306 }

3312 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<HeadMenuEntry> menu() const { return shownHeadMenu(_headMenu); }

3321 }

3323 /// @brief Runs a head menu entry's `onClick` as a user event in the screen scope, in one batch.
3324 /// @param entryId The entry's id.
3325 /// @return Whether it ran: `false`, with a diagnostic, for an id the menu does not hold, or holds hidden or
3326 /// disabled (the entry itself or a submenu it is in).
3327 bool chooseMenuEntry(std::string_view entryId) {
3328 FoundEntry const found = runtime().untracked([&] { return findHeadEntry(_headMenu, entryId, FoundEntry{}); });
3329 if (found.model == nullptr) {
3330 _core->report("/menu", "head menu entry " + std::string{entryId} + " is unknown");
3331 return false;
3332 }
3333 if (!found.visible || !found.enabled) {
3334 _core->report(found.model->path,
3335 "head menu entry " + found.model->id + (found.visible ? " is disabled" : " is hidden"));
3336 return false;
3337 }
3338 if (found.model->item.onSelect) {
3339 found.model->item.onSelect();
3340 }
3341 return true;
3342 }

3344 /// @brief The head's tools that are visible now, in order, each with its value and whether it is enabled. A
3345 /// tracked read.
3346 /// @return They; empty when the document declares no `tools`.
3347 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<HeadTool> tools() const {
3348 std::vector<HeadTool> shown;
3349 for (detail::HeadToolModel const& tool : _headTools) {
3350 if (!tool.visible.evaluate()) {
3351 continue;
3352 }
3353 bool const search = tool.kind == HeadToolKind::Search;
3354 shown.push_back(HeadTool{.id = tool.id,
3355 .kind = tool.kind,
3356 .label = tool.label.evaluate(),
3357 .value = search ? tool.value.evaluate() : std::string{},
3358 .placeholder = search ? tool.placeholder.evaluate() : std::string{},
3359 .options = search ? std::vector<SelectOption>{} : tool.options.evaluate(),
3360 .selected = search ? std::nullopt : tool.selected.evaluate(),
3361 .width = tool.width,
3362 .enabled = tool.enabled.evaluate()});
3363 }
3364 return shown;
3365 }

3367 /// @brief Reports a user's edit of a head tool: runs a search's `onChange` with `event` the text, or a select's
3368 /// `onChoose` with `event` the chosen key, as a user event in the screen scope, in one batch.
3369 /// @param toolId The tool's id.
3370 /// @param value A search's text, or a select's key.
3371 /// @return Whether it ran: `false`, with a diagnostic, for an id the head does not hold, or holds hidden or
3372 /// disabled, and for a search given anything but a string.
3373 bool editTool(std::string_view toolId, Value const& value) {
3374 detail::HeadToolModel const* const tool = usableTool(toolId);
3375 if (tool == nullptr) {
3376 return false;
3377 }
3378 if (tool->kind == HeadToolKind::Search && value.asString() == nullptr) {
3379 _core->report(tool->path, "head tool " + tool->id + " is a search, edited with text");
3380 return false;
3381 }
3382 tool->edit(value);
3383 return true;
3384 }

3386 /// @brief Reports a user's submit of a head search: runs its `onSubmit` with `event` its text, as a user event in
3387 /// the screen scope, in one batch.
3388 /// @param toolId The tool's id.
3389 /// @return Whether it ran: `false`, with a diagnostic, for an id the head does not hold, or holds hidden or
3390 /// disabled, and for a select.
3391 bool submitTool(std::string_view toolId) {
3392 detail::HeadToolModel const* const tool = usableTool(toolId);
3393 if (tool == nullptr) {
3394 return false;
3395 }
3396 if (tool->kind != HeadToolKind::Search) {
3397 _core->report(tool->path, "head tool " + tool->id + " is a select, which is not submitted");
3398 return false;
3399 }
3400 tool->submit(Value{runtime().untracked([&] { return tool->value.evaluate(); })});
3401 return true;
3402 }
3403
3404 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `dirty`.
3405 /// @return Whether it is `true`.
3406 [[nodiscard]] bool dirty() const {
3407 Value const value = detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().dirty);
3408 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
3409 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
3410 }
3411
3412 /// @brief Whether the screen has work a close waits for: an open dialog or drawer, a mutation run, or an upload or
3413 /// download in flight, in any of its scopes (spec 6 §3). A tracked read, so an Effect that reads it runs
3414 /// again when it changes.
3415 /// @return It.
3416 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const { return _core->pendingWork.get() > 0; }
3417
3418 /// @brief The reactive runtime the screen runs on.
3419 /// @return It.
3420 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return _core->runtime(); }
3421
3422 /// @brief Runs `onClose`, as the host does before it closes the screen.
3423 /// @return False when `onClose` ran `cancelClose`: the screen stays open.
3424 bool requestClose() {
3425 std::shared_ptr<bool const> const cancelled = beginClose();
3426 return cancelled == nullptr || !*cancelled;
3427 }
3428
3429 /// @brief Runs `onClose`, and hands back the flag its `cancelClose` sets.
3430 ///
3431 /// The flag is shared with every command list `onClose` starts, such as the `onResult` of a confirm dialog it
3432 /// opens, so it can still be set after this returns; a host reads it once the screen is no longer `pending()`.
3433 /// @return The flag, or `nullptr` when the document declares no `onClose`.
3434 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<bool const> beginClose() {
3435 Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList("onClose");
3436 if (commands == nullptr) {
3437 return nullptr;
3438 }
3439 return runCommandsFlag(*commands);
3440 }
3441
3442 /// @brief Whether the document declares a lifecycle command list.
3443 /// @param key The key: `onClose`, `onSave`, …
3444 /// @return It.
3445 [[nodiscard]] bool declares(std::string_view key) const { return lifecycleList(key) != nullptr; }
3446
3447 /// @brief Runs a lifecycle command list: `onSave`, `onBackendChange`, or any other the document declares.
3448 /// @param key The key.
3449 void runLifecycle(std::string_view key) {
3450 if (Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList(key)) {
3451 runCommands(*commands);
3452 }
3453 }
3454
3455 /// @brief The diagnostics reported so far, each path and reason once.
3456 /// @return They.
3457 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Refusal> const& diagnostics() const noexcept { return _core->diagnostics; }
3458
3459 /// @brief Sets the user's choice at a customization point, as the preferences store loaded or the user made
3460 /// it. A choice that does not fit the point is ignored (spec 5 §12b).
3461 /// @param point The point.
3462 /// @param value The choice.
3463 /// @return Whether it fits and was taken.
3464 bool setPreference(std::string const& point, Value value) {
3465 auto const found = _core->doc().customize.find(point);
3466 if (found == _core->doc().customize.end() || !fits(found->second, value)) {
3467 return false;
3468 }
3469 ValueRecord prefs = _core->prefs.peek();
3470 prefs.insert_or_assign(point, std::move(value));
3471 _core->prefs.set(std::move(prefs));
3472 return true;
3473 }
3474
3475 /// @brief The screen's document, whose `customize` block names the points a preferences store loads.
3476 /// @return It.
3477 [[nodiscard]] Document const& document() const noexcept { return _core->doc(); }
3478
3479 /// @brief What an alias of this screen lends to a screen it opens that borrows it.
3480 /// @param alias The alias.
3481 /// @return Its channel and token; an empty channel when it has none.
3482 [[nodiscard]] BorrowedModel lend(std::string_view alias) const;
3483
3484private:
3485 friend class Interpreter;
3486 friend class Inspector;
3487
3488 Screen() = default;
3489
3490 /// Evaluates a head expression of runs; a run the head cannot read is dropped and reported.
3491 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<TextSpan> headSpans(ExprPtr const& expr) const;
3492
3493 /// The view node the screen shows as its root: the view's root, or, while it is a `switch`, the case shown now
3494 /// (the default when none matches) if that holds exactly one node. Null for a case that declares a scope of its
3495 /// own, whose names are not the screen's, and for a shape that is no single node. A tracked read.
3496 [[nodiscard]] DocNode const* shownRoot() const;
3497
3498 /// The states of the screen's own scope that have a value, by name: what a screen that replaces it keeps.
3499 [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, detail::ScreenCore::KeptState, std::less<>> ownState() const {
3500 std::map<std::string, detail::ScreenCore::KeptState, std::less<>> states;
3501 for (auto const& slot : _scope->states) {
3502 if (slot->value) {
3503 states.insert_or_assign(
3504 slot->decl->name,
3505 detail::ScreenCore::KeptState{.type = slot->decl->type.name(), .value = slot->value->peek()});
3506 }
3507 }
3508 return states;
3509 }
3510
3511 [[nodiscard]] Commands const* lifecycleList(std::string_view key) const {
3512 auto const found = _core->doc().lifecycle.find(key);
3513 return found == _core->doc().lifecycle.end() ? nullptr : &found->second;
3514 }
3515
3516 /// Runs a command list as the screen's own (not a user's); returns whether it ran `cancelClose`.
3517 bool runCommands(Commands const& commands) { return *runCommandsFlag(commands); }
3518
3519 /// Runs a command list as the screen's own; returns the `cancelClose` flag it and what it starts share.
3520 std::shared_ptr<bool const> runCommandsFlag(Commands const& commands) {
3521 detail::CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = _scope,
3522 .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings>(),
3523 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
3524 .boundary = nullptr};
3525 _core->runtime().batch([&] { _core->runList(commands, ctx, {}); });
3526 return ctx.cancelClose;
3527 }
3528
3529 [[nodiscard]] static bool fits(CustomizePoint const& point, Value const& value) {
3530 if (point.kind == "choice") {
3531 std::string const* const text = value.asString();
3532 return text != nullptr && listed(std::span<std::string const>{point.options}, *text);
3533 }
3534 if (point.kind == "value") {
3535 return point.type.admits(value);
3536 }
3537 return true;
3538 }
3539
3540 [[nodiscard]] static bool listed(std::span<std::string const> options, std::string const& text) {
3541 return std::ranges::find(options, text) != options.end();
3542 }
3543
3544 // A head tool by id that is visible and enabled; null, with a diagnostic, for any other.
3545 [[nodiscard]] detail::HeadToolModel const* usableTool(std::string_view toolId) const {
3546 auto const found = std::ranges::find(_headTools, toolId, &detail::HeadToolModel::id);
3547 if (found == _headTools.end()) {
3548 _core->report("/tools", "head tool " + std::string{toolId} + " is unknown");
3549 return nullptr;
3550 }
3551 auto const [visible, enabled] =
3552 runtime().untracked([&] { return std::pair{found->visible.evaluate(), found->enabled.evaluate()}; });
3553 if (!visible || !enabled) {
3554 _core->report(found->path, "head tool " + found->id + (visible ? " is disabled" : " is hidden"));
3555 return nullptr;
3556 }
3557 return &*found;
3558 }
3559
3560 // A head menu entry by id, with whether it and every submenu it is in are visible and enabled.
3561 struct FoundEntry {
3562 detail::HeadMenuModel const* model = nullptr;
3563 bool visible = true;
3564 bool enabled = true;
3565 };
3566
3567 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): a submenu is a menu one level down.
3568 [[nodiscard]] static FoundEntry findHeadEntry(std::vector<detail::HeadMenuModel> const& level,
3569 std::string_view entryId, FoundEntry const& outer) {
3570 for (detail::HeadMenuModel const& model : level) {
3571 FoundEntry const here{.model = &model,
3572 .visible = outer.visible && model.item.visible.evaluate(),
3573 .enabled = outer.enabled && model.item.enabled.evaluate()};
3574 if (!model.id.empty() && model.id == entryId) {
3575 return here;
3576 }
3577 if (FoundEntry const inner = findHeadEntry(model.items, entryId, here); inner.model != nullptr) {
3578 return inner;
3579 }
3580 }
3581 return FoundEntry{};
3582 }
3583
3584 // One level of the head menu as it shows now: hidden entries left out, and a separator they leave first, last or
3585 // next to another with them.
3586 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): a submenu is a menu one level down.
3587 [[nodiscard]] static std::vector<HeadMenuEntry> shownHeadMenu(std::vector<detail::HeadMenuModel> const& level) {
3588 std::vector<HeadMenuEntry> shown;
3589 for (detail::HeadMenuModel const& model : level) {
3590 MenuItem const& item = model.item;
3591 if (item.separator) {
3592 if (!shown.empty() && !shown.back().separator) {
3593 shown.push_back(HeadMenuEntry{.separator = true});
3594 }
3595 continue;
3596 }
3597 if (!item.visible.evaluate()) {
3598 continue;
3599 }
3600 shown.push_back(HeadMenuEntry{.id = model.id,
3601 .label = item.label.evaluate(),
3602 .icon = item.icon,
3603 .keys = item.keys,
3604 .checked = item.checked.evaluate(),
3605 .enabled = item.enabled.evaluate(),
3606 .items = shownHeadMenu(model.items),
3607 .separator = false,
3608 .description = item.description.evaluate()});
3609 }
3610 if (!shown.empty() && shown.back().separator) {
3611 shown.pop_back();
3612 }
3613 return shown;
3614 }
3615
3616 std::unique_ptr<detail::ScreenCore> _core;
3617 std::shared_ptr<detail::RtScope> _scope;
3618 std::optional<Mounted> _mounted;
3619 // The head's parts, bound in the screen scope.
3620 std::vector<detail::BadgeModel> _headStatus;
3621 detail::ActionModels _headActions;
3622 std::vector<detail::HeadMenuModel> _headMenu;
3623 std::vector<detail::HeadToolModel> _headTools;
3624};
3625
3626/// @brief The app document mounted as the root scope every screen of the session shares (spec 6 §5).
3627///
3628/// Its state, lets, queries and mutations live once for the session. A screen reads them as `{"ref": "app.name"}`,
3629/// a binding on one updates, and `{"set": "app.name", …}` writes the app document's state. A query of the app
3630/// document runs once however many screens read it. Destroying the root runs its `onUnmount`, takes its scope off the
3631/// session and releases its model instances; a host does that before it clears the session on sign-out.
3632class AppRoot {
3633public:
3634 AppRoot(AppRoot const&) = delete;
3635 AppRoot& operator=(AppRoot const&) = delete;
3636 AppRoot(AppRoot&&) = delete;
3637 AppRoot& operator=(AppRoot&&) = delete;
3638
3639 /// @brief Runs `onUnmount`, takes the scope off the session, and releases everything.
3640 ~AppRoot() {
3641 try {
3642 if (auto const found = _core->doc().lifecycle.find("onUnmount"); found != _core->doc().lifecycle.end()) {
3643 runCommands(found->second);
3644 }
3645 } catch (...) { // NOLINT(bugprone-empty-catch): a destructor has no one to report to.
3646 }
3647 // The counts read the scope, so they go before it.
3648 _navigationBadges.reset();
3649 _navigation.clear();
3650 _core->session.setAppScope(nullptr);
3651 _scope.reset();
3652 }
3653
3654 /// @brief The app document's `navigation` badges that are visible now, in order, each with the screen whose
3655 /// navigator entry it goes on, and following the app state they read.
3656 /// @return They, valid as long as the root; empty when the document declares no `navigation`.
3657 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Computed<std::vector<NavigationBadge>> const& navigationBadges() const {
3658 return *_navigationBadges;
3659 }
3660
3661 /// @brief Where a shell shows who is signed in: the document's `principalPlacement`.
3662 /// @return The place; `Sidebar` when the document declares none.
3663 [[nodiscard]] PrincipalPlacement principalPlacement() const noexcept {
3664 return _core->doc().principalPlacement == "head" ? PrincipalPlacement::Head : PrincipalPlacement::Sidebar;
3665 }
3666
3667 /// @brief Evaluates an expression in the app document's scope.
3668 /// @param expression The expression's JSON.
3669 /// @return Its value; `null` for an expression that does not parse.
3670 [[nodiscard]] Value read(Json const& expression) const {
3671 auto parsed = parseExpression(expression);
3672 if (!parsed) {
3673 return Value{};
3674 }
3675 return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, *parsed);
3676 }
3677
3678 /// @brief The diagnostics reported so far.
3679 /// @return They.
3680 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Refusal> const& diagnostics() const noexcept { return _core->diagnostics; }
3681
3682private:
3683 friend class Interpreter;
3684
3685 AppRoot() = default;
3686
3687 void runCommands(Commands const& commands) {
3688 detail::CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = _scope,
3689 .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings>(),
3690 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
3691 .boundary = nullptr};
3692 _core->runtime().batch([&] { _core->runList(commands, ctx, {}); });
3693 }
3694
3695 // A navigation badge, lowered in the app scope, with the screen of its entry.
3696 struct PlacedBadge {
3697 std::string screen;
3698 detail::BadgeModel badge;
3699 };
3700
3701 std::unique_ptr<detail::ScreenCore> _core;
3702 std::shared_ptr<detail::RtScope> _scope;
3703 std::vector<PlacedBadge> _navigation;
3704 std::unique_ptr<reactive::Computed<std::vector<NavigationBadge>>> _navigationBadges;
3705};
3706
3707/// @brief Mounts UI documents (spec 5): one per client process or window, over a session and a dispatcher.
3708class Interpreter {
3709public:
3710 /// @brief An interpreter.
3711 /// @param session The session the screens share. Borrowed.
3712 /// @param dispatcher Where model calls go. Borrowed.
3713 /// @param options The host and the diagnostic callback.
3714 Interpreter(Session& session MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, Dispatcher& dispatcher MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND,
3715 InterpreterOptions options = {})
3716 : _session{&session}, _dispatcher{&dispatcher}, _options{std::move(options)} {}
3717
3718 /// @brief Mounts a screen.
3719 ///
3720 /// The document has loaded (`loadDocument`); what mounting adds is what only the opener knows: the params, and
3721 /// the models a `{"from": alias}` instance borrows. A param that is missing and not optional, a param of the
3722 /// wrong type, a borrowed model the opener did not lend and a document without a view are refused.
3723 /// @param doc The document.
3724 /// @param params The params, by name; names the document does not declare are ignored.
3725 /// @param backend The backend to mount on. Borrowed: it outlives the screen.
3726 /// @param options Where to mount, and the models lent.
3727 /// @return The screen, or the refusal.
3728 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::unique_ptr<Screen>, Refusal> mount(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc,
3729 ValueRecord const& params,
3730 IViewBackend& backend,
3731 MountOptions const& options = {});
3732
3733 /// @brief Mounts the app document as the session's root scope (spec 6 §5).
3734 ///
3735 /// Refused: a document whose id is not `app`, and a second app document while one is mounted on the session.
3736 /// @param doc The app document, loaded.
3737 /// @return The root, or the refusal. Keep it as long as the session's screens may read `app.*`.
3738 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::unique_ptr<AppRoot>, Refusal> mountApp(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc);
3739
3740private:
3741 Session* _session;
3742 Dispatcher* _dispatcher;
3743 InterpreterOptions _options;
3744};
3745
3746// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3747// Implementation
3748// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3749
3750inline void Session::backendChanged(std::string const& backend) {
3751 _runtime->batch([this, &backend] {
3752 std::vector<detail::ScreenCore*> const screens = _screens;
3753 for (detail::ScreenCore* const screen : screens) {
3754 if (std::ranges::find(_screens, screen) != _screens.end()) {
3755 screen->runLifecycleOf("onBackendChange");
3756 }
3757 }
3758 ValueRecord env = _env.peek();
3759 env.insert_or_assign("backend", Value{backend});
3760 _env.set(std::move(env));
3761 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
3762 static_cast<void>(key);
3763 markStale(*entry);
3764 }
3765 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> const mounted = _mounted;
3766 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : mounted) {
3767 query->refetchCurrent();
3768 }
3769 });
3770}
3771
3772inline void Session::refetchMounted(detail::CacheEntry const& entry) {
3773 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> const mounted = _mounted;
3774 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : mounted) {
3775 if (_runtime->untracked([query] { return query->entry(); }).get() == &entry) {
3776 query->refetchCurrent();
3777 }
3778 }
3779}
3780
3781// NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): a model type and an action id, as every caller names them.
3782inline void Session::applyReplyEffects(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply,
3783 ReplyUse use, std::string const& instanceToken) {
3784 if (!_options.catalog.action) {
3785 return;
3786 }
3787 std::optional<ActionInfo> const info = _options.catalog.action(actionId);
3788 if (!info || !info->effects) {
3789 return;
3790 }
3791 detail::Marks marks;
3792 for (ActionEffect const& effect : *info->effects) {
3793 if (effect.kind == "changesInstance") {
3794 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
3795 static_cast<void>(key);
3796 if (!entry->evaluate && entry->typeId == typeId && entry->instanceToken == instanceToken) {
3797 marks.add(*entry);
3798 }
3799 }
3800 } else if (effect.record && (effect.kind == "updates" || effect.kind == "changes")) {
3801 applyRecordEffect(effect, *effect.record, *info, reply, use, marks);
3802 }
3803 }
3804 markAndRefetch(marks);
3805}
3806
3807inline void Session::applyRecordEffect(ActionEffect const& effect, std::string const& record, ActionInfo const& info,
3808 Value const& reply, ReplyUse use, detail::Marks& marks) {
3809 // The reply's rows of the record, by key; none when the reply does not hold it keyed, or must only mark.
3810 auto const own = std::ranges::find(info.records, record, &ActionRecordInfo::record);
3811 std::optional<std::string> const ownKey =
3812 effect.kind == "updates" && use == ReplyUse::Applied && own != info.records.end() ? own->keyField
3813 : std::nullopt;
3814 detail::RowsByKey rows;
3815 if (ownKey) {
3816 for (Value const* const row : detail::keyedRowsOf(reply, own->paths, *ownKey)) {
3817 rows.insert_or_assign(detail::canonicalJson(*row->field(*ownKey)), row);
3818 }
3819 }
3820 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
3821 static_cast<void>(key);
3822 ActionRecordInfo const* const held = entry->holding(record);
3823 if (held == nullptr) {
3824 continue;
3825 }
3826 if (!ownKey || !held->keyField) {
3827 marks.add(*entry);
3828 continue;
3829 }
3830 if (auto patched = detail::patchHeldRows(entry->confirmed, held->paths, *held->keyField, rows)) {
3831 confirm(*entry, *patched);
3832 }
3833 // A fetch in flight may have read before the write, and would settle over the patch.
3834 if (entry->pending.peek()) {
3835 markStale(*entry);
3836 }
3837 }
3838}
3839
3840inline void Session::markAndRefetch(detail::Marks const& marks) {
3841 for (detail::CacheEntry* const entry : marks.entries) {
3842 markStale(*entry);
3843 }
3844 for (detail::CacheEntry const* const entry : marks.entries) {
3845 refetchMounted(*entry);
3846 }
3847}
3848
3849inline void Session::countTopics(detail::CacheEntry const& entry, int delta) {
3850 if (entry.evaluate) {
3851 return;
3852 }
3853 // One topic: its count, and the queues a change of the count from or to zero goes to.
3854 auto const count = [delta](auto& refs, auto const& topic, auto& watches, auto& unwatches) {
3855 int& refsOf = refs[topic];
3856 refsOf += delta;
3857 if (delta > 0 && refsOf == 1 && unwatches.erase(topic) == 0) {
3858 watches.insert(topic);
3859 } else if (refsOf <= 0) {
3860 refs.erase(topic);
3861 if (watches.erase(topic) == 0) {
3862 unwatches.insert(topic);
3863 }
3864 }
3865 };
3866 if (!entry.records.empty()) {
3867 for (ActionRecordInfo const& record : entry.records) {
3868 count(_recordRefs, record.record, _watchRecords, _unwatchRecords);
3869 }
3870 return;
3871 }
3872 constexpr std::string_view kShared = "shared:";
3873 if (entry.instanceToken.starts_with(kShared)) {
3874 count(_instanceRefs, std::pair{entry.typeId, entry.instanceToken.substr(kShared.size())}, _watchInstances,
3875 _unwatchInstances);
3876 }
3877}
3878
3879inline void Session::sendWatch(std::string_view kind, wire::WatchBody const& body) const {
3880 auto completion = _options.watcher(std::string{kind}, glz::write_json(body).value_or(std::string{}));
3881 completion.then([](std::string const&) {}).onError([](std::exception_ptr const&) {});
3882}
3883
3884inline void Session::flushWatches() {
3885 if (!_options.watcher) {
3886 _watchRecords.clear();
3887 _unwatchRecords.clear();
3888 _watchInstances.clear();
3889 _unwatchInstances.clear();
3890 return;
3891 }
3892 auto const take = [](auto& records, auto& instances) {
3893 wire::WatchBody body;
3894 body.records.assign(records.begin(), records.end());
3895 for (auto const& [modelType, primary] : instances) {
3896 body.instances.push_back(wire::InstanceTopic{.modelType = modelType, .primary = primary, .instance = 0});
3897 }
3898 records.clear();
3899 instances.clear();
3900 return body;
3901 };
3902 if (!_watchRecords.empty() || !_watchInstances.empty()) {
3903 sendWatch(wire::kWatchKind, take(_watchRecords, _watchInstances));
3904 }
3905 if (!_unwatchRecords.empty() || !_unwatchInstances.empty()) {
3906 sendWatch(wire::kUnwatchKind, take(_unwatchRecords, _unwatchInstances));
3907 }
3908}
3909
3910inline wire::WatchBody Session::watchSet() const {
3911 wire::WatchBody body;
3912 for (auto const& [record, refs] : _recordRefs) {
3913 static_cast<void>(refs);
3914 body.records.push_back(record);
3915 }
3916 for (auto const& [topic, refs] : _instanceRefs) {
3917 static_cast<void>(refs);
3918 body.instances.push_back(
3919 wire::InstanceTopic{.modelType = topic.first, .primary = topic.second, .instance = 0});
3920 }
3921 return body;
3922}
3923
3924inline void Session::markAllStale() {
3925 _runtime->batch([this] {
3926 detail::Marks marks;
3927 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
3928 static_cast<void>(key);
3929 if (!entry->evaluate) {
3930 marks.add(*entry);
3931 }
3932 }
3933 markAndRefetch(marks);
3934 });
3935}
3936
3937inline void Session::reconnected() {
3938 // The whole set replaces what the server holds, so the queued changes are superseded.
3939 _watchRecords.clear();
3940 _unwatchRecords.clear();
3941 _watchInstances.clear();
3942 _unwatchInstances.clear();
3943 if (_options.watcher) {
3944 wire::WatchBody body = watchSet();
3945 body.replace = true;
3946 sendWatch(wire::kWatchKind, body);
3947 }
3948 markAllStale();
3949}
3950
3951inline void Session::deliverEvent(wire::EventBody const& event) {
3952 if (event.topic == wire::kResyncTopic) {
3953 reconnected();
3954 return;
3955 }
3956 if (event.topic != wire::kChangesTopic) {
3957 return;
3958 }
3959 if (auto changes = wire::readChangesBody(event.payload.str)) {
3960 applyChanges(*changes);
3961 }
3962}
3963
3964inline void Session::applyChanges(wire::ChangesBody const& changes) {
3965 _runtime->batch([&] {
3966 detail::Marks marks;
3967 for (effects::RecordChange const& change : changes.records) {
3968 markRecordChange(change, marks);
3969 }
3970 for (wire::InstanceTopic const& instance : changes.instances) {
3971 markInstanceChange(instance, marks);
3972 }
3973 markAndRefetch(marks);
3974 });
3975}
3976
3977inline void Session::markRecordChange(effects::RecordChange const& change, detail::Marks& marks) {
3978 // The keys' canonical text, so a key the server wrote is compared with the rows' own.
3979 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> keys;
3980 for (glz::raw_json const& key : change.keys.value_or(std::vector<glz::raw_json>{})) {
3981 auto json = parseJson(key.str);
3982 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
3983 if (value) {
3984 keys.insert(detail::canonicalJson(*value));
3985 }
3986 }
3987 for (auto const& [name, entry] : _entries) {
3988 static_cast<void>(name);
3989 ActionRecordInfo const* const held = entry->holding(change.record);
3990 if (held == nullptr) {
3991 continue;
3992 }
3993 // An entry still waiting for its first value may come to hold a key; keyless rows cannot be told apart.
3994 if (!change.keys || !held->keyField || !entry->hasValue.peek()) {
3995 marks.add(*entry);
3996 continue;
3997 }
3998 std::string const& keyField = *held->keyField;
3999 bool const holdsKey = std::ranges::any_of(
4000 detail::keyedRowsOf(entry->confirmed, held->paths, keyField),
4001 [&](Value const* row) { return keys.contains(detail::canonicalJson(*row->field(keyField))); });
4002 if (holdsKey) {
4003 marks.add(*entry);
4004 }
4005 }
4006}
4007
4008inline void Session::markInstanceChange(wire::InstanceTopic const& instance, detail::Marks& marks) {
4009 std::string const shared = "shared:" + instance.primary;
4010 for (auto const& [name, entry] : _entries) {
4011 static_cast<void>(name);
4012 if (entry->evaluate || entry->typeId != instance.modelType) {
4013 continue;
4014 }
4015 // Without a primary key, the instance is one of the connection's own private ones.
4016 bool const same =
4017 instance.primary.empty() ? !entry->instanceToken.starts_with("shared") : entry->instanceToken == shared;
4018 if (same) {
4019 marks.add(*entry);
4020 }
4021 }
4022}

4025 ReplyUse use, std::string const& instanceToken) {
4026 _runtime->batch([&] { applyReplyEffects(typeId, actionId, reply, use, instanceToken); });
4027}

4031namespace detail {

4033/// @brief The text of an instance key, as the bridge's string-keyed attach takes it.
4034/// @param key The key's value.
4035/// @return The text; empty for `null`.
4036[[nodiscard]] inline std::string instanceKeyText(Value const& key) {
4037 if (key.isNull()) {
4038 return {};
4039 }
4040 if (std::int64_t const* const number = key.asInt()) {
4041 return std::to_string(*number);
4042 }
4043 if (std::string const* const text = key.asString()) {
4044 return *text;
4045 }
4046 return canonicalJson(key);
4047}
4048
4049/// @brief The channel an alias is bound to for its current token, binding it when the token changed.
4050/// @param alias The alias.
4051/// @param core The screen.
4052/// @return The channel, or `nullptr` while the alias is unbound.
4053[[nodiscard]] inline std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channelOf(ModelAlias& alias, ScreenCore& core) {
4054 std::string const token = core.runtime().untracked([&] { return alias.token->get(); });
4055 if (token.empty()) {
4056 return nullptr;
4057 }
4058 if (alias.channel && alias.boundToken == token) {
4059 return alias.channel;
4060 }
4061 std::string const& type = alias.decl->type;
4062 switch (alias.mode) {
4063 case InstanceMode::Borrowed: {
4064 auto const found = core.borrowed.find(alias.decl->name);
4065 alias.channel = found == core.borrowed.end() ? nullptr : found->second.channel;
4066 break;
4067 }
4068 case InstanceMode::Shared:
4069 // `shared` is for a stateless model, whose instances are interchangeable: its calls go to an instance of
4070 // the alias's own, and what it shares with other screens is the query cache, through the token.
4071 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Private, {});
4072 break;
4073 case InstanceMode::Keyed:
4074 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Shared, token.substr(7));
4075 break;
4076 case InstanceMode::Private:
4077 case InstanceMode::Default:
4078 default:
4079 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Private, {});
4080 break;
4081 }
4082 alias.boundToken = token;
4083 return alias.channel;
4084}

4101 owner->inner.set(nullptr);
4102 }
4103 }

4106// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): an element's value can read a nested scope's readiness, one level per nesting.
4107inline bool RtScope::ready() const {
4108 for (auto const& element : elements) {
4109 Value const shown = core.elementValue(*element, "visible");
4110 bool const* const visible = shown.asBool();
4111 ValueList const* const errors = element->errors->get().asList();
4112 if ((visible == nullptr || *visible) && errors != nullptr && !errors->empty()) {
4113 return false;
4114 }
4115 }
4116 for (auto const& check : checks) {
4117 if (check->decl->blocking && check->failing->get()) {
4118 return false;
4119 }
4120 }
4121 return true;
4122}
4123
4124// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): an `app.` name is read in the root scope with its head consumed, once per segment.
4125inline Value ScopeEnv::ref(std::string_view head, std::span<std::string const> path) const {
4126 if (head == "app") {
4127 RtScope const* const app = _scope->core.session.appScope();
4128 if (app == nullptr || path.empty()) {
4129 return Value{};
4130 }
4131 return ScopeEnv{*app, nullptr}.ref(path.front(), path.subspan(1));
4132 }
4133 if (_bindings != nullptr) {
4134 for (Binding const& bound : std::views::reverse(*_bindings)) {
4135 if (bound.name == head) {
4136 return walk(bound.read(), path);
4137 }
4138 }
4139 }
4140 NameRef const* const name = _scope->find(head);
4141 if (name == nullptr) {
4142 return Value{};
4143 }
4144 switch (name->category) {
4145 case NameCategory::Param:
4146 return walk(name->param, path);
4147 case NameCategory::State:
4148 _scope->core.initState(*name->state->scope, *name->state);
4149 // State inits are acyclic (`loadDocument` checks it), so the value is made by now.
4150 return walk(name->state->value->get(), path);
4151 case NameCategory::Let:
4152 return walk(name->let->get(), path);
4153 case NameCategory::Query:
4154 return walk(name->query->value(), path);
4155 case NameCategory::Element:
4156 if (path.empty()) {
4157 return Value{};
4158 }
4159 return walk(_scope->core.elementValue(*name->element, path.front()), path.subspan(1));
4160 case NameCategory::Transfer: {
4161 if (path.empty()) {
4162 return Value{};
4163 }
4164 TransferState const& transfer = *name->transfer;
4165 Value value;
4166 if (path.front() == "progress") {
4167 value = transfer.progress.get();
4168 } else if (path.front() == "pending") {
4169 value = Value{transfer.pending.get()};
4170 } else if (path.front() == "error") {
4171 value = transfer.error.get();
4172 }
4173 return walk(value, path.subspan(1));
4174 }
4175 case NameCategory::Model:
4176 case NameCategory::Mutation:
4177 default:
4178 return Value{};
4179 }
4180}
4181
4182// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per control form and kind of name.
4183inline Value ScopeEnv::control(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const {
4184 Session const& session = _scope->core.session;
4185 NameRef const* const found = _scope->find(name);
4186 if (form == ExprKind::Can) {
4187 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query) {
4188 return session.can(found->query->decl().action);
4189 }
4190 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation) {
4191 return session.can(found->mutation->decl().action);
4192 }
4193 return session.can(name);
4194 }
4195 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query) {
4196 QueryRuntime const& query = *found->query;
4197 if (form == ExprKind::Query) {
4198 return query.value();
4199 }
4200 if (form == ExprKind::Pending) {
4201 return query.pending();
4202 }
4203 if (form == ExprKind::Error) {
4204 return query.error();
4205 }
4206 return form == ExprKind::ErrorKind ? query.errorKind() : Value{};
4207 }
4208 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation) {
4209 MutationRuntime const& mutation = *found->mutation;
4210 if (form == ExprKind::Result) {
4211 return mutation.result();
4212 }
4213 if (form == ExprKind::Pending) {
4214 return mutation.pending();
4215 }
4216 if (form == ExprKind::Error) {
4217 return mutation.error();
4218 }
4219 return form == ExprKind::ErrorKind ? mutation.errorKind() : Value{};
4220 }
4221 return Value{};
4222}
4223
4224inline Value ScopeEnv::pref(std::string_view point, std::span<std::string const> path) const {
4225 ValueRecord const& prefs = _scope->core.prefs.get();
4226 auto const found = prefs.find(point);
4227 return found == prefs.end() ? Value{} : walk(found->second, path);

4242inline QueryRuntime::QueryRuntime(QueryDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias)
4243 : _decl{&decl},
4244 _typeId{alias->decl->type},
4245 _scope{&scope},
4246 _alias{alias},
4247 _entry{scope.core.runtime()},
4248 _carried{scope.core.runtime()},
4249 _waiting{scope.core.runtime(), false} {
4250 scope.core.session.attachQuery(*this);
4251}
4252
4253inline QueryRuntime::~QueryRuntime() {
4254 _debounce.cancel();
4255 _refresh.cancel();
4256 _scope->core.session.forgetQuery(*this);
4257 if (auto const& current = _entry.peek()) {
4258 _scope->core.session.release(current);
4259 }
4260}
4261
4262inline std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> QueryRuntime::channel() const { return channelOf(*_alias, _scope->core); }
4263
4264// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): the query's key, its fetch and its refresh triggers.
4265inline void QueryRuntime::start() {
4266 RtScope& scope = *_scope;
4267 auto& key = scope.nodes.computed([this]() -> Target {
4268 Target target;
4269 if (_decl->when) {
4270 Value const when = evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _decl->when);
4271 bool const* const flag = when.asBool();
4272 if (flag == nullptr || !*flag) {
4273 return target;
4274 }
4275 }
4276 std::string token = _alias->token->get();
4277 if (token.empty()) {
4278 return target;
4279 }
4280 Value body = _decl->body ? evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _decl->body) : Value{ValueRecord{}};
4281 if (body.isNull()) {
4282 return target;
4283 }
4284 target.idle = false;
4285 target.token = std::move(token);
4286 target.bodyText = canonicalJson(body);
4287 target.body = std::move(body);
4288 return target;
4289 });
4290 _key = &key;
4291 reactive::Scheduler* const scheduler = scope.core.session.options().scheduler;
4292 std::weak_ptr<bool> const alive = _alive;
4293 scope.nodes.effect([this, &key, scheduler, alive, first = true]() mutable {
4294 Target target = key.get();
4295 _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] {
4296 if (first || target.idle || _decl->debounce <= 0 || scheduler == nullptr) {
4297 first = false;
4298 _debounce.cancel();
4299 _waiting.set(false);
4300 switchTo(target);
4301 return;
4302 }
4303 _pendingTarget = std::move(target);
4304 _waiting.set(true);
4305 _debounce = scheduler->after(std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->debounce}, [this, alive] {
4306 if (alive.expired()) {
4307 return;
4308 }
4309 _scope->core.runtime().batch([this] {
4310 _waiting.set(false);
4311 switchTo(_pendingTarget);
4312 });
4313 });
4314 });
4315 });
4316 if (_decl->refreshEvery > 0 && scheduler != nullptr) {
4317 _refresh = scheduler->every(std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->refreshEvery}, [this, alive] {
4318 if (alive.expired()) {
4319 return;
4320 }
4321 auto const current = _entry.peek();
4322 if (!current || _waiting.peek() || current->pending.peek()) {
4323 return;
4324 }
4325 _scope->core.runtime().batch([&] { _scope->core.session.fetch(current, channel()); });
4326 });
4327 }
4328}
4329
4330inline void QueryRuntime::switchTo(Target const& target) {
4331 Session& session = _scope->core.session;
4332 std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry> const old = _entry.peek();
4333 if (old && target == _target) {
4334 return;
4335 }
4336 Value shown = old && old->hasValue.peek() ? old->value.peek() : _carried.peek();
4337 _target = target;
4338 if (target.idle) {
4339 _carried.set(Value{});
4340 _entry.set(nullptr);
4341 if (old) {
4342 session.release(old);
4343 }
4344 return;
4345 }
4346 auto fresh = session.acquire(target.token, _typeId, _decl->action, _decl->evaluate, target.body);
4347 _carried.set(std::move(shown));
4348 _entry.set(fresh);
4349 if (old) {
4350 session.release(old);
4351 }
4352 bool const young = fresh->fetchedAt.has_value() &&
4353 session.now() - *fresh->fetchedAt < std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->staleTime};
4354 if (!fresh->pending.peek() && (!fresh->hasValue.peek() || fresh->stale || !young)) {
4355 session.fetch(fresh, channel());
4356 }
4357}
4358
4359inline void QueryRuntime::refetch() {
4360 _scope->core.runtime().batch([this] {
4361 bool switched = false;
4362 if (_waiting.peek()) {
4363 _debounce.cancel();
4364 _waiting.set(false);
4365 switchTo(_pendingTarget);
4366 switched = true;
4367 }
4368 auto const current = _entry.peek();
4369 if (current && !(switched && current->pending.peek())) {
4370 _scope->core.session.fetch(current, channel());
4371 }
4372 });
4373}
4374
4375inline void QueryRuntime::refetchCurrent() {
4376 if (_key == nullptr) {
4377 refetch();
4378 return;
4379 }
4380 _scope->core.runtime().batch([this] {
4381 _debounce.cancel();
4382 _waiting.set(false);
4383 Target const target = _key->peek();
4384 if (!(_entry.peek() && target == _target)) {
4385 switchTo(target);
4386 return;
4387 }
4388 if (auto const current = _entry.peek(); current && !current->pending.peek()) {
4389 _scope->core.session.fetch(current, channel());
4390 }
4391 });
4392}
4393
4394inline Value QueryRuntime::value() const {
4395 auto const& current = _entry.get();
4396 if (current) {
4397 if (current->hasValue.get()) {
4398 return current->value.get();
4399 }
4400 if (!current->error.get().empty()) {
4401 return Value{};
4402 }
4403 }
4404 return _carried.get();
4405}
4406
4407inline bool QueryRuntime::pending() const {
4408 if (_waiting.get()) {
4409 return true;
4410 }
4411 auto const& current = _entry.get();
4412 return current && current->pending.get();
4413}
4414
4415inline Value QueryRuntime::error() const {
4416 auto const& current = _entry.get();
4417 if (!current || current->error.get().empty()) {
4418 return Value{};
4419 }
4420 return Value{current->error.get()};
4421}
4422
4423inline Value QueryRuntime::errorKind() const {
4424 auto const& current = _entry.get();
4425 if (!current || current->errorKind.get().empty()) {
4426 return Value{};
4427 }
4428 return Value{current->errorKind.get()};
4429}
4430
4431inline bool QueryRuntime::settled() const {
4432 auto const& current = _entry.get();
4433 return !current || current->hasValue.get() || !current->error.get().empty();
4434}

4436// --- Mutations -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4437
4438inline MutationRuntime::MutationRuntime(MutationDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias)
4439 : _decl{&decl},
4440 _scope{&scope},
4441 _alias{alias},
4442 _typeId{alias->decl->type},
4443 _core{&scope.core},
4444 _inFlight{scope.core.runtime(), 0},
4445 _result{scope.core.runtime()},
4446 _error{scope.core.runtime()},
4447 _errorKind{scope.core.runtime()} {}
4448
4449inline MutationRuntime::~MutationRuntime() {
4450 *_alive = false;
4451 // A run whose reply will now never be read is no longer pending.
4452 if (int const running = _inFlight.peek(); running > 0) {
4453 _core->addPending(-running);
4454 }
4455}
4456
4457// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a mutation's commands can run another mutation, and a serial queue sends its next
4458// run as the last one settles.
4459inline void MutationRuntime::run(Value body, std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings, RunDone done) {
4460 auto run = std::make_shared<Run>();
4461 run->body = std::move(body);
4462 run->bindings = std::move(bindings);
4463 run->done = std::move(done);
4464 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Exclusive && _inFlight.peek() > 0) {
4465 run->done(false, Value{});
4466 return;
4467 }
4468 _inFlight.set(_inFlight.peek() + 1);
4469 _core->addPending(1);
4470 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Serial) {
4471 // The key reads the run's body, so a run keys the same whichever command started it.
4472 Bindings withBody = *run->bindings;
4473 withBody.push_back(Binding{.name = "body", .read = [body = run->body] { return body; }});
4474 Value const key = evalIn(*_scope, &withBody, _decl->serialKey);
4475 run->serialKey = key.isNull() ? std::string{} : canonicalJson(key);
4476 if (_busy.contains(run->serialKey)) {
4477 _queues[run->serialKey].push_back(run);
4478 return;
4479 }
4480 _busy.insert(run->serialKey);
4481 }
4482 send(run);
4483}
4484
4485inline void MutationRuntime::send(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run) {
4486 run->id = ++_runs;
4487 _latest = run->id;
4488 applyOptimistic(*run);
4489 std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const channel = channelOf(*_alias, _scope->core);
4490 if (channel == nullptr) {
4491 settle(run, std::nullopt, std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error{"the model alias has no instance"}));
4492 return;
4493 }
4494 std::weak_ptr<bool> const alive = _alive;
4495 try {
4496 auto completion = channel->execute(_decl->action, canonicalJson(run->body),
4497 CallOptions{.queueOffline = _decl->offlineQueue});
4498 completion
4499 .then([this, alive, run](std::string const& reply) {
4500 if (alive.expired()) {
4501 return;
4502 }
4503 auto json = parseJson(reply);
4504 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
4505 if (!value) {
4506 settle(run, std::nullopt,
4507 std::make_exception_ptr(
4508 std::runtime_error{"the reply is not a document value: " + value.error()}));
4509 return;
4510 }
4511 settle(run, std::move(*value), nullptr);
4512 })
4513 .onError([this, alive, run](std::exception_ptr const& error) {
4514 if (!alive.expired()) {
4515 settle(run, std::nullopt, error);
4516 }
4517 });
4518 } catch (...) {
4519 settle(run, std::nullopt, std::current_exception());
4520 }
4521}
4522
4523inline void MutationRuntime::applyOptimistic(Run& run) {
4524 if (!_decl->optimistic) {
4525 return;
4526 }
4527 NameRef const* const target = _scope->find(_decl->optimistic->query);
4528 if (target == nullptr || target->category != NameCategory::Query) {
4529 return;
4530 }
4531 auto entry = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return target->query->entry(); });
4532 if (!entry) {
4533 return;
4534 }
4535 Bindings bindings = *run.bindings;
4536 bindings.push_back(Binding{.name = "body", .read = [body = run.body] { return body; }});
4537 Value key = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*_scope, &bindings, _decl->optimistic->key); });
4538 Value with = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*_scope, &bindings, _decl->optimistic->with); });
4539 // Before a value has arrived there is no list to miss.
4540 if (entry->hasValue.peek() &&
4541 patchRows(entry->confirmed, _decl->optimistic->at, key, with).error_or(PatchMiss::NoRow) ==
4542 PatchMiss::NoList) {
4543 _scope->core.report(pointerAppend(_decl->path, "optimistic"),
4544 patchMissReason(_decl->optimistic->query, _decl->optimistic->at));
4545 }
4546 entry->layers.push_back(
4547 OptimisticLayer{.run = run.id, .at = _decl->optimistic->at, .key = std::move(key), .with = std::move(with)});
4548 _scope->core.session.showLayers(*entry);
4549 run.layered.push_back(std::move(entry));
4550}
4551
4552inline void MutationRuntime::dropLayers(Run& run) {
4553 for (auto const& entry : run.layered) {
4554 std::erase_if(entry->layers, [&](OptimisticLayer const& layer) { return layer.run == run.id; });
4555 _scope->core.session.showLayers(*entry);
4556 }
4557 run.layered.clear();
4558}
4559
4560// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per outcome a reply can have.
4561inline void MutationRuntime::settle(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run, std::optional<Value> reply,
4562 std::exception_ptr const& error) {
4563 ScreenCore& core = _scope->core;
4564 Session& session = core.session;
4565 bool const applied = _decl->concurrency != Concurrency::Latest || run->id == _latest;
4566 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> const scope = _scope->shared_from_this();
4567 auto commandCtx = [&](Bindings extra) {
4568 return CommandCtx{.scope = scope,
4569 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(std::move(extra)),
4570 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
4571 .boundary = nullptr};
4572 };
4573 Value delivered;
4574 bool succeeded = false;
4575 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per outcome a reply can have.
4576 core.runtime().batch([&] {
4577 _inFlight.set(_inFlight.peek() - 1);
4578 _core->addPending(-1);
4579 if (reply) {
4580 succeeded = true;
4581 // The run's optimistic writes are confirmed by the reply: they become part of the confirmed rows.
4582 for (auto const& entry : run->layered) {
4583 Value confirmed = entry->confirmed;
4584 for (OptimisticLayer const& layer : entry->layers) {
4585 if (layer.run == run->id) {
4586 if (auto patched = patchRows(confirmed, layer.at, layer.key, layer.with)) {
4587 confirmed = std::move(*patched);
4588 }
4589 }
4590 }
4591 std::erase_if(entry->layers, [&](OptimisticLayer const& layer) { return layer.run == run->id; });
4592 session.confirm(*entry, confirmed);
4593 }
4594 run->layered.clear();
4595 std::vector<std::string> secret;
4596 if (session.options().catalog.action) {
4597 if (auto const info = session.options().catalog.action(_decl->action)) {
4598 secret = info->secretFields;
4599 }
4600 }
4601 delivered = withoutFields(*reply, secret);
4602 std::string const token =
4603 _alias == nullptr ? std::string{} : core.runtime().untracked([&] { return _alias->token->get(); });
4604 if (!applied) {
4605 session.actionSucceeded(_typeId, _decl->action, *reply, ReplyUse::Discarded, token);
4606 return;
4607 }
4608 _result.set(*reply);
4609 _error.set(Value{});
4610 _errorKind.set(Value{});
4611 session.actionSucceeded(_typeId, _decl->action, *reply, ReplyUse::Applied, token);
4612 core.runList(_decl->onSuccess, commandCtx(*run->bindings), {});
4613 if (!secret.empty()) {
4614 _result.set(delivered);
4615 }
4616 return;
4617 }
4618 dropLayers(*run);
4619 std::string const kind = session.classify(error);
4620 if (applied) {
4621 _error.set(Value{failureText(error)});
4622 _errorKind.set(Value{kind});
4623 core.runList(_decl->onError, commandCtx(*run->bindings), {});
4624 }
4625 if (kind == "denied" && core.host != nullptr) {
4626 core.host->permissionsStale();
4627 }
4628 });
4629 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Serial) {
4630 next(run->serialKey);
4631 }
4632 run->done(succeeded, delivered);
4633}
4634
4635inline void MutationRuntime::next(std::string const& serialKey) {
4636 auto const found = _queues.find(serialKey);
4637 if (found == _queues.end() || found->second.empty()) {
4638 _queues.erase(serialKey);
4639 _busy.erase(serialKey);
4640 return;
4641 }
4642 std::shared_ptr<Run> const queued = found->second.front();
4643 found->second.pop_front();
4644 _scope->core.runtime().batch([&] { send(queued); });
4645}

4654/// @brief The element a node of a scope keeps its state in.
4655/// @param scope The scope that declares it.
4656/// @param node The node.
4657/// @return The element, or `nullptr` for a node that keeps none.
4658[[nodiscard]] inline ElementState* elementFor(RtScope const& scope, DocNode const& node) {
4659 for (auto const& element : scope.elements) {
4660 if (element->node == &node) {
4661 return element.get();
4662 }
4663 }
4664 return nullptr;
4665}

4667/// @brief The transfers of the `upload` commands in a list, nested lists included.
4668/// @param commands The list.
4669/// @param out Where the transfer ids go.
4670// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested command list
4671inline void transfersOf(Commands const& commands, std::vector<std::string>& out) {
4672 for (Command const& command : commands) {
4673 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Upload && !command.transfer.empty()) {
4674 out.push_back(command.transfer);
4675 }
4676 transfersOf(command.commands, out);
4677 transfersOf(command.alternative, out);
4678 }
4679}

4681// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a document is a tree of nodes and parts, and collecting descends it.
4682// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of node and part.
4683inline void ScreenCore::collect(DocNode const& node, RtScope& scope, std::vector<Commands const*>& commands) {
4684 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(node.kind, false);
4685 if (!node.id.empty() || statefulKind(node.kind)) {
4686 auto element = std::make_unique<ElementState>(runtime());
4687 element->node = &node;
4688 element->scope = &scope;
4689 if (!node.id.empty()) {
4690 NameRef name;
4691 name.category = NameCategory::Element;
4692 name.element = element.get();
4693 scope.names.insert_or_assign(node.id, name);
4694 }
4695 wireErrors(*element);
4696 scope.elements.push_back(std::move(element));
4697 }
4698 bool const createsScope = spec != nullptr && (spec->flags & kScope) != 0;
4699 for (auto const& [key, list] : node.events) {
4700 KeySpec const* const keyed = spec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*spec, key);
4701 if (!createsScope || keyed == nullptr || (keyed->flags & kInner) == 0) {
4702 commands.push_back(&list);
4703 }
4704 }
4705 for (auto const& [chord, list] : node.keys) {
4706 static_cast<void>(chord);
4707 commands.push_back(&list);
4708 }
4709 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
4710 KeySpec const* const keyed = spec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*spec, key);
4711 if (createsScope && keyed != nullptr && (keyed->flags & kInner) != 0) {
4712 continue;
4713 }
4714 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
4715 collect(*child, scope, commands);
4716 }
4717 }
4718 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
4719 static_cast<void>(key);
4720 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
4721 KindSpec const* const partSpec = findKind(part->kind, true);
4722 if (partSpec != nullptr && (partSpec->flags & kScope) != 0) {
4723 continue;
4724 }
4725 for (auto const& [event, list] : part->events) {
4726 static_cast<void>(event);
4727 commands.push_back(&list);
4728 }
4729 for (auto const& [childKey, nodes] : part->children) {
4730 KeySpec const* const keyed = partSpec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*partSpec, childKey);
4731 if (keyed != nullptr && (keyed->flags & kInner) != 0) {
4732 continue;
4733 }
4734 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
4735 collect(*child, scope, commands);
4736 }
4737 }
4738 }
4739 }
4740}
4741// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)

4743// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one section per kind of declaration.
4744inline void ScreenCore::declare(RtScope& scope, ScopeDecl const* decl, std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content,
4745 std::vector<Commands const*> const& commands) {
4746 std::vector<Commands const*> lists = commands;
4747 for (DocNode const* const node : content) {
4748 collect(*node, scope, lists);
4749 }
4750 std::vector<std::string> transferIds;
4751 for (Commands const* const list : lists) {
4752 transfersOf(*list, transferIds);
4753 }
4754 for (std::string const& transferId : transferIds) {
4755 if (scope.names.contains(transferId)) {
4756 continue;
4757 }
4758 scope.transfers.push_back(std::make_unique<TransferState>(runtime()));
4759 NameRef name;
4760 name.category = NameCategory::Transfer;
4761 name.transfer = scope.transfers.back().get();
4762 scope.names.insert_or_assign(transferId, name);
4763 }
4764 if (decl != nullptr) {
4765 for (ModelDecl const& model : decl->models) {
4766 auto alias = std::make_unique<ModelAlias>();
4767 alias->decl = &model;
4768 alias->mode = model.instance;
4769 if (alias->mode == InstanceMode::Default) {
4770 std::optional<ModelInfo> const info =
4771 session.options().catalog.model ? session.options().catalog.model(model.type) : std::nullopt;
4772 alias->mode = info && info->stateless ? InstanceMode::Shared : InstanceMode::Private;
4773 }
4774 ModelAlias* const raw = alias.get();
4775 switch (raw->mode) {
4776 case InstanceMode::Keyed:
4777 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, raw]() -> std::string {
4778 std::string const key = instanceKeyText(evalIn(scope, nullptr, raw->decl->key));
4779 return key.empty() ? std::string{} : "shared:" + key;
4780 });
4781 break;
4782 case InstanceMode::Shared:
4783 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([] { return std::string{"shared"}; });
4784 break;
4785 case InstanceMode::Borrowed: {
4786 auto const found = borrowed.find(model.name);
4787 std::string token = found == borrowed.end() ? std::string{} : found->second.token;
4788 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([token = std::move(token)] { return token; });
4789 break;
4790 }
4791 case InstanceMode::Private:
4792 case InstanceMode::Default:
4793 default: {
4794 std::string token = session.privateToken();
4795 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([token = std::move(token)] { return token; });
4796 break;
4797 }
4798 }
4799 NameRef name;
4800 name.category = NameCategory::Model;
4801 name.model = raw;
4802 scope.names.insert_or_assign(model.name, name);
4803 scope.models.push_back(std::move(alias));
4804 }
4805 for (LetDecl const& let : decl->lets) {
4806 NameRef name;
4807 name.category = NameCategory::Let;
4808 name.letExpr = let.value;
4809 name.let = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = let.value] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
4810 scope.names.insert_or_assign(let.name, name);
4811 }
4812 for (StateDecl const& state : decl->state) {
4813 auto slot = std::make_unique<StateSlot>();
4814 slot->decl = &state;
4815 slot->scope = &scope;
4816 NameRef name;
4817 name.category = NameCategory::State;
4818 name.state = slot.get();
4819 scope.names.insert_or_assign(state.name, name);
4820 scope.states.push_back(std::move(slot));
4821 }
4822 auto aliasOf = [&scope](std::string const& model) -> ModelAlias* {
4823 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(model);
4824 return found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Model ? found->model : nullptr;
4825 };
4826 for (QueryDecl const& query : decl->queries) {
4827 scope.queries.push_back(std::make_unique<QueryRuntime>(query, scope, aliasOf(query.model)));
4828 NameRef name;
4829 name.category = NameCategory::Query;
4830 name.query = scope.queries.back().get();
4831 scope.names.insert_or_assign(query.name, name);
4832 }
4833 for (MutationDecl const& mutation : decl->mutations) {
4834 scope.mutations.push_back(std::make_unique<MutationRuntime>(mutation, scope, aliasOf(mutation.model)));
4835 NameRef name;
4836 name.category = NameCategory::Mutation;
4837 name.mutation = scope.mutations.back().get();
4838 scope.names.insert_or_assign(mutation.name, name);
4839 }
4840 }
4841 for (auto const& slot : scope.states) {
4842 initState(scope, *slot);
4843 }
4844 for (auto const& element : scope.elements) {
4845 wireElement(*element);
4846 }
4847 if (decl == nullptr) {
4848 return;
4849 }
4850 for (CheckDecl const& check : decl->checks) {
4851 auto made = std::make_unique<CheckRuntime>();
4852 made->decl = &check;
4853 made->failing = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = check.assertion] {
4854 Value const asserted = evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr);
4855 bool const* const flag = asserted.asBool();
4856 return flag != nullptr && !*flag;
4857 });
4858 made->message = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = check.message, session = &session] {
4859 return textOf(evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr), session->formatting());
4860 });
4861 for (std::string const& target : check.targets) {
4862 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(target);
4863 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
4864 found->element->checks.push_back(made.get());
4865 made->targets.push_back(found->element);
4866 found->element->checksVersion.set(found->element->checksVersion.peek() + 1);
4867 }
4868 }
4869 scope.checks.push_back(std::move(made));
4870 }
4871 for (auto const& query : scope.queries) {
4872 query->start();
4873 }
4874 for (WatchDecl const& watch : decl->watches) {
4875 auto& source = scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = watch.on] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
4876 scope.nodes.effect([this, &scope, &source, watched = &watch, first = true]() mutable {
4877 static_cast<void>(source.get());
4878 if (first) {
4879 first = false;
4880 return;
4881 }
4882 bool const user = session.lastWriteByUser();
4883 if (watched->source == WatchSource::User && !user) {
4884 return;
4885 }
4886 runtime().untracked([&] {
4887 CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = scope.shared_from_this(),
4888 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(),
4889 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
4890 .boundary = nullptr};
4891 if (user) {
4892 session.asUser([&] { runList(watched->body, ctx, {}); });
4893 } else {
4894 runList(watched->body, ctx, {});
4895 }
4896 });
4897 });
4898 }
4899}
