4901/// @brief What a date input reads from a value: the instant it shows, and whether the value names one at all.
4902struct DateReading {
4903 /// @brief The instant shown; empty for an empty field.
4904 std::optional<time::DateTime> instant;
4905 /// @brief Whether the value names a date, an instant or nothing; `false` for text that names no date.
4906 bool readable = true;
4907};
4908
4909/// @brief Reads what a date input shows for @p value, in a display zone @p offsetMinutes from UTC.
4910///
4911/// The value is read as the date functions read it (`readDateValue`): a timestamp is its instant; a `yyyy-MM-dd`
4912/// string is midnight of that date in the display zone; a string `DateTime::fromIso8601` reads is its instant; `null`
4913/// and `""` are empty. Any other value is empty and unreadable.
4914/// @param value The value.
4915/// @param offsetMinutes The display zone's offset from UTC, in minutes.
4916/// @return The instant, or nothing, and whether the value was readable.
4917[[nodiscard]] inline DateReading dateInstantOf(Value const& value, std::int32_t offsetMinutes) {
4918 DateValue const reading = readDateValue(value);
4919 switch (reading.form) {
4920 case DateForm::Absent:
4921 return {};
4922 case DateForm::Date:
4923 return {.instant =
4924 time::DateTime{std::chrono::sys_days{reading.date} - std::chrono::minutes{offsetMinutes}}};
4925 case DateForm::Timestamp:
4926 case DateForm::InstantText:
4927 return {.instant = reading.instant};
4928 case DateForm::Unreadable:
4929 default:
4930 return {.instant = std::nullopt, .readable = false};
4931 }
4932}
4933
4934/// @brief A date input's date text for @p instant in a display zone @p offsetMinutes from UTC.
4935/// @param instant The instant.
4936/// @param offsetMinutes The display zone's offset from UTC, in minutes.
4937/// @return `yyyy-MM-dd`.
4938[[nodiscard]] inline std::string dateTextOf(time::DateTime const& instant, std::int32_t offsetMinutes) {
4939 auto const local = instant.value + std::chrono::minutes{offsetMinutes};
4940 std::chrono::year_month_day const date{std::chrono::floor<std::chrono::days>(local)};
4941 return std::format("{:04}-{:02}-{:02}", static_cast<int>(date.year()), static_cast<unsigned>(date.month()),
4942 static_cast<unsigned>(date.day()));
4943}
4944
4945/// @brief Whether two values show the same in an input: by text for a text input, by instant for a date input, by
4946/// value otherwise.
4947/// @param kind The input's kind.
4948/// @param lhs One value.
4949/// @param rhs The other.
4950/// @param format The formatting facts.
4951/// @return It.
4952[[nodiscard]] inline bool sameShown(std::string_view kind, Value const& lhs, Value const& rhs,
4953 FormatContext const& format) {
4954 if (kind == "textInput" || kind == "filePicker") {
4955 return textOf(lhs, format) == textOf(rhs, format);
4956 }
4957 if (kind == "dateTimeInput") {
4958 return dateInstantOf(lhs, format.utcOffsetMinutes).instant ==
4959 dateInstantOf(rhs, format.utcOffsetMinutes).instant;
4960 }
4961 return lhs == rhs;
4962}
4963
4964/// @brief The key of a select option: a record's `key`, `id` or `value` field, or the option itself.
4965/// @param option The option.
4966/// @return The key.
4967[[nodiscard]] inline Value optionKey(Value const& option) {
4968 if (option.asRecord() == nullptr) {
4969 return option;
4970 }
4971 for (std::string_view const field : {"key", "id", "value"}) {
4972 if (Value const* const found = option.field(field)) {
4973 return *found;
4974 }
4975 }
4976 return Value{};
4977}

4979// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one rule per source of an error.
4980inline void ScreenCore::wireErrors(ElementState& element) {
4981 RtScope& scope = *element.scope;
4982 element.errors = &scope.nodes.computed([this, &element]() -> Value {
4983 static_cast<void>(element.checksVersion.get());
4984 DocNode const& field = *element.node;
4985 RtScope const& owner = *element.scope;
4986 std::vector<std::string> errors;
4987 // A group's `required` is its legend's mark only: a group has no value, so no `Required` is derived from it.
4988 if (ExprPtr const required = field.kind != "group" ? field.prop("required") : nullptr) {
4989 Value const requiredNow = evalIn(owner, nullptr, required);
4990 bool const* const flag = requiredNow.asBool();
4991 if (flag != nullptr && *flag && !engaged(inputValue(element))) {
4992 errors.emplace_back("Required");
4993 }
4994 }
4995 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(evalIn(owner, nullptr, field.prop("errors")))) {
4996 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
4997 }
4998 if (!field.id.empty()) {
4999 std::vector<std::string> const path{"errors", field.id};
5000 for (auto const& query : owner.queries) {
5001 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(walk(query->value(), path))) {
5002 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
5003 }
5004 }
5005 for (auto const& mutation : owner.mutations) {
5006 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(walk(mutation->result(), path))) {
5007 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
5008 }
5009 }
5010 }
5011 for (CheckRuntime const* const check : element.checks) {
5012 if (check->failing->get()) {
5013 errors.push_back(check->message->get());
5014 }
5015 }
5016 return listOfStrings(errors);
5017 });
5018}
5019
5020// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of element.
5021inline void ScreenCore::wireElement(ElementState& element) {
5022 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
5023 RtScope& scope = *element.scope;
5024 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
5025 if (kind == "form") {
5026 wireForm(element);
5027 return;
5028 }
5029 if (kind == "collection" || kind == "wizard") {
5030 wireComposite(element);
5031 return;
5032 }
5033 bool const input = kind == "textInput" || kind == "checkbox" || kind == "select" || kind == "dateTimeInput" ||
5034 kind == "slider" || kind == "filePicker";
5035 if (input) {
5036 std::string_view key = "value";
5037 if (kind == "checkbox") {
5038 key = "checked";
5039 } else if (kind == "select") {
5040 key = "selected";
5041 }
5042 ExprPtr const expr = kind == "filePicker" ? nullptr : node.prop(key);
5043 bool const controlled = expr && (expr->kind != ExprKind::Literal || !expr->literal.isNull());
5044 if (controlled) {
5045 element.bound = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
5046 element.draft.set(runtime().untracked([&] { return element.bound->get(); }));
5047 scope.nodes.effect([this, &element, kind] {
5048 Value const bound = element.bound->get();
5049 runtime().untracked([&] {
5050 if (!element.edited.peek()) {
5051 element.draft.set(bound);
5052 } else if (sameShown(kind, element.draft.peek(), bound, session.formatting())) {
5053 element.edited.set(false);
5054 }
5055 });
5056 });
5057 } else if (kind == "checkbox") {
5058 element.draft.set(false);
5059 }
5060 }
5061 if (kind == "select") {
5062 element.rows =
5063 &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = node.prop("options")] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
5064 if (element.bound == nullptr && node.name("onStale") == "clear") {
5065 scope.nodes.effect([this, &element] {
5066 Value const options = element.rows->get();
5067 runtime().untracked([&] {
5068 Value const selected = element.draft.peek();
5069 if (selected.isNull()) {
5070 return;
5071 }
5072 ValueList const* const items = options.asList();
5073 bool const kept = items != nullptr && std::ranges::any_of(*items, [&](Value const& option) {
5074 return optionKey(option) == selected;
5075 });
5076 if (!kept) {
5077 session.noteWrite();
5078 element.draft.set(Value{});
5079 }
5080 });
5081 });
5082 }
5083 }
5084 if (kind == "table" && node.prop("rows")) {
5085 element.rows =
5086 &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = node.prop("rows")] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
5087 // A bound selection is controlled, as a select's `selected` is: any expression but a literal `null` binds it.
5088 ExprPtr const selection = node.prop("selection");
5089 if (selection && (selection->kind != ExprKind::Literal || !selection->literal.isNull())) {
5090 element.bound = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, selection] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, selection); });
5091 }
5092 // A bound sort is controlled as the selection is.
5093 ExprPtr const sort = node.prop("sort");
5094 if (sort && (sort->kind != ExprKind::Literal || !sort->literal.isNull())) {
5095 element.sortBound = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, sort] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, sort); });
5096 }
5097 element.view = &scope.nodes.computed([this, &element] { return tableView(element, nullptr); });
5098 }
5099}
5100
5101/// @brief A table's sort as its element value reads it: the bound `sort` when the key binds one, else the table's
5102/// own.
5103/// @param element The table's element.
5104/// @return The sort. Tracked.
5105[[nodiscard]] inline Value tableSort(ElementState const& element) {
5106 return element.sortBound != nullptr ? element.sortBound->get() : element.sort.get();
5107}
5108
5109/// @brief A table's page values: `viewCount` (the rows it orders, every page), `page`, `pageCount`, and
5110/// `pageFirst` and `pageLast`, the 1-based positions of the page's first and last rows, both 0 when there are
5111/// none. A table that does not page reads page 0 of 1, over every row.
5112/// @param element The table's element.
5113/// @param name The value's name.
5114/// @return The value. Tracked.
5115[[nodiscard]] inline Value tablePageValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) {
5116 if (element.view == nullptr) {
5117 return name == "pageCount" ? std::int64_t{1} : std::int64_t{0};
5118 }
5119 TableView const& view = element.view->get();
5120 if (name == "viewCount") {
5121 return static_cast<std::int64_t>(view.rows.size());
5122 }
5123 if (name == "page") {
5124 return view.page;
5125 }
5126 if (name == "pageCount") {
5127 return view.pageCount;
5128 }
5129 bool const none = view.first == view.last;
5130 if (name == "pageFirst") {
5131 return none ? std::int64_t{0} : static_cast<std::int64_t>(view.first + 1);
5132 }
5133 return static_cast<std::int64_t>(view.last);
5134}
5135
5136/// @brief The selected keys of the rows a table holds on pages other than the one shown, in their order: what an
5137/// `Extend` report keeps, since the backend holds the shown page alone.
5138/// @param view The table's rows and page.
5139/// @param selection The selection, a list of keys.
5140/// @param rowKey A row's key.
5141/// @return The keys.
5142[[nodiscard]] inline ValueList selectedOffPage(TableView const& view, Value const& selection,
5143 std::function<Key(Value const&)> const& rowKey) {
5144 std::unordered_set<Key> onPage;
5145 std::unordered_set<Key> offPage;
5146 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < view.rows.size(); ++index) {
5147 (index >= view.first && index < view.last ? onPage : offPage).insert(rowKey(view.rows.at(index)));
5148 }
5149 ValueList kept;
5150 if (ValueList const* const selected = selection.asList()) {
5151 for (Value const& item : *selected) {
5152 Key const key = keyOf(item);
5153 if (offPage.contains(key) && !onPage.contains(key)) {
5154 kept.push_back(item);
5155 }
5156 }
5157 }
5158 return kept;
5159}
5160
5161/// @brief The sortable column part of a table with the id @p columnId.
5162/// @param table The table.
5163/// @param columnId The column's id.
5164/// @return The part, or `nullptr` when no sortable column has that id.
5165[[nodiscard]] inline DocNode const* sortableColumn(DocNode const& table, std::string_view columnId) {
5166 for (DocNodePtr const& column : table.partList("columns")) {
5167 if (column->id == columnId && column->flag("sortable")) {
5168 return column.get();
5169 }
5170 }
5171 return nullptr;
5172}
5173
5174/// @brief One key of a table's sort: the column part that orders the rows, and whether it is descending.
5175struct SortKey {
5176 /// @brief The sortable column.
5177 DocNode const* column = nullptr;
5178 /// @brief Whether the key sorts descending.
5179 bool descending = false;
5180};
5181
5182/// @brief A table's sort read as its keys: a list of `{"column", "direction"}` records naming sortable columns.
5183/// @param table The table.
5184/// @param sort The sort; `null` is the source order, as `[]` is.
5185/// @return The keys, most significant first; `nullopt` when @p sort is not such a list.
5186[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<std::vector<SortKey>> sortKeysOf(DocNode const& table, Value const& sort) {
5187 std::vector<SortKey> keys;
5188 if (sort.isNull()) {
5189 return keys;
5190 }
5191 ValueList const* const items = sort.asList();
5192 if (items == nullptr) {
5193 return std::nullopt;
5194 }
5195 for (Value const& item : *items) {
5196 Value const* const column = item.field("column");
5197 Value const* const direction = item.field("direction");
5198 std::string const* const columnId = column == nullptr ? nullptr : column->asString();
5199 std::string const* const way = direction == nullptr ? nullptr : direction->asString();
5200 DocNode const* const part = columnId == nullptr ? nullptr : sortableColumn(table, *columnId);
5201 if (part == nullptr || way == nullptr || (*way != "asc" && *way != "desc")) {
5202 return std::nullopt;
5203 }
5204 keys.push_back(SortKey{.column = part, .descending = *way == "desc"});
5205 }
5206 return keys;
5207}
5208
5209inline void ScreenCore::groupRows(ElementState const& element, Bindings const* bindings, TableView& view) {
5210 auto const parts = element.node->partList("group");
5211 if (parts.empty()) {
5212 return;
5213 }
5214 ExprPtr const groupBy = parts.front()->prop("by");
5215 RtScope const& scope = *element.scope;
5216 ScopeEnv const tableEnv{scope, bindings};
5217 Evaluator runs{tableEnv};
5218 // A heading's key is its run's key and its ordinal among the runs with an equal key, since adjacent grouping
5219 // can give two runs one key (samples A, B, A); the ordinal stays put across a sort, which moves no run.
5220 std::map<std::string, std::size_t, std::less<>> ordinals;
5221 Value key;
5222 ValueList run;
5223 auto const close = [&] {
5224 std::string const json = canonicalJson(key);
5225 Value const record = runRecord(key, std::exchange(run, {}));
5226 ValueRecord entry = *record.asRecord();
5227 entry.insert_or_assign(std::string{kGroupHeadingField},
5228 Value{"\x1Fgroup:" + json + ":" + std::to_string(ordinals[json]++)});
5229 view.runs.emplace_back(std::move(entry));
5230 };
5231 for (Value const& row : view.rows) {
5232 Value value = evaluate(*groupBy, ScopeEnv{scope, bindings, &row});
5233 if (!run.empty() && !runs.sameRun(key, value)) {
5234 close();
5235 }
5236 if (run.empty()) {
5237 key = std::move(value);
5238 }
5239 run.push_back(row);
5240 view.runOf.push_back(view.runs.size());
5241 }
5242 if (!run.empty()) {
5243 close();
5244 }
5245}
5246
5247inline void ScreenCore::sortedRows(ElementState const& element, Bindings const* bindings, TableView& view) {
5248 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
5249 RtScope const& scope = *element.scope;
5250 Value const source = bindings == nullptr ? element.rows->get() : evalIn(scope, bindings, node.prop("rows"));
5251 ValueList const* const items = source.asList();
5252 if (items == nullptr) {
5253 return;
5254 }
5255 view.rows.assign(items->begin(), items->end());
5256 groupRows(element, bindings, view);
5257 Value const sort = tableSort(element);
5258 std::optional<std::vector<SortKey>> const keys = sortKeysOf(node, sort);
5259 std::string const sortPath = pointerAppend(node.path, "sort");
5260 if (!keys) {
5261 report(
5262 sortPath,
5263 "sort is " + canonicalJson(sort) +
5264 R"(; a table's sort is a list of {"column": <a sortable column's id>, "direction": "asc" or "desc"})");
5265 return;
5266 }
5267 if (keys->empty()) {
5268 return;
5269 }
5270 // Each row's keys are read once, then the rows are ordered by them: a change to the sort, the rows, or anything
5271 // a `sortBy` reads sorts again. A grouped table orders by the group first, so every group keeps its place in
5272 // the source order and its rows are sorted within it.
5273 bool const grouped = !view.runOf.empty();
5274 std::vector<std::vector<Value>> rowKeys;
5275 rowKeys.reserve(view.rows.size());
5276 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < view.rows.size(); ++index) {
5277 Value const& row = view.rows.at(index);
5278 ScopeEnv const env{scope, bindings, &row};
5279 std::vector<Value> values;
5280 values.reserve(keys->size() + 1);
5281 if (grouped) {
5282 values.emplace_back(static_cast<std::int64_t>(view.runOf.at(index)));
5283 }
5284 for (SortKey const& key : *keys) {
5285 if (ExprPtr const sortBy = key.column->prop("sortBy")) {
5286 values.push_back(evaluate(*sortBy, env));
5287 } else {
5288 Value const* const field = row.field(key.column->id);
5289 values.push_back(field == nullptr ? Value{} : *field);
5290 }
5291 }
5292 rowKeys.push_back(std::move(values));
5293 }
5294 std::vector<bool> descending;
5295 descending.reserve(keys->size() + 1);
5296 if (grouped) {
5297 descending.push_back(false);
5298 }
5299 for (SortKey const& key : *keys) {
5300 descending.push_back(key.descending);
5301 }
5302 ScopeEnv const env{scope, bindings};
5303 std::optional<std::vector<std::size_t>> const order = Evaluator{env}.sortRows(rowKeys, descending);
5304 if (!order) {
5305 report(sortPath, "the rows' values for the sort are not of one comparable kind; the rows keep their order");
5306 return;
5307 }
5308 std::vector<Value> sorted;
5309 std::vector<std::size_t> runOf;
5310 sorted.reserve(view.rows.size());
5311 for (std::size_t const index : *order) {
5312 sorted.push_back(view.rows.at(index));
5313 if (grouped) {
5314 runOf.push_back(view.runOf.at(index));
5315 }
5316 }
5317 view.rows = std::move(sorted);
5318 view.runOf = std::move(runOf);
5319}
5320
5321inline TableView ScreenCore::tableView(ElementState const& element, Bindings const* bindings) {
5322 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
5323 RtScope const& scope = *element.scope;
5324 TableView view;
5325 sortedRows(element, bindings, view);
5326 view.last = view.rows.size();
5327 ExprPtr const sizeExpr = node.prop("pageSize");
5328 if (!sizeExpr) {
5329 return view;
5330 }
5331 // A `pageSize` of `null` does not page; one that is no positive integer is reported and does not page either.
5332 Value const size = evalIn(scope, bindings, sizeExpr);
5333 std::int64_t const* const perPage = size.asInt();
5334 if (size.isNull() || perPage == nullptr || *perPage < 1) {
5335 if (!size.isNull()) {
5336 report(pointerAppend(node.path, "pageSize"),
5337 "pageSize is " + canonicalJson(size) + "; a page holds a positive whole number of rows");
5338 }
5339 return view;
5340 }
5341 // A `page` of `null` is the first; one that is negative or not a whole number is reported and shows the first.
5342 // One past the last is the last: a filter that shrinks the rows under the user is normal, not an error.
5343 std::int64_t asked = 0;
5344 if (ExprPtr const pageExpr = node.prop("page")) {
5345 Value const page = evalIn(scope, bindings, pageExpr);
5346 std::int64_t const* const index = page.asInt();
5347 if (index != nullptr && *index >= 0) {
5348 asked = *index;
5349 } else if (!page.isNull()) {
5350 report(pointerAppend(node.path, "page"),
5351 "page is " + canonicalJson(page) + "; a page is a whole number from 0");
5352 }
5353 }
5354 auto const total = static_cast<std::int64_t>(view.rows.size());
5355 view.pageCount = std::max<std::int64_t>(1, (total + *perPage - 1) / *perPage);
5356 view.page = std::min(asked, view.pageCount - 1);
5357 view.first = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min(total, view.page * *perPage));
5358 view.last = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min(total, (view.page + 1) * *perPage));
5359 return view;
5360}
5361
5362/// @brief A table's selection as its element value reads it: the bound `selection` when the key binds one, else
5363/// the table's own. A bound value that is not a list (`null` while state starts empty) selects nothing.
5364/// @param element The table's element.
5365/// @return A list of keys. Tracked.
5366[[nodiscard]] inline Value tableSelection(ElementState const& element) {
5367 if (element.bound == nullptr) {
5368 return element.selection.get();
5369 }
5370 Value const bound = element.bound->get();
5371 return bound.asList() != nullptr ? bound : Value{ValueList{}};
5372}
5373
5374/// @brief A JSON text as a document value; `null` when it is not JSON or holds what a value cannot (a fraction).
5375/// @param text The JSON text.
5376/// @return The value.
5377[[nodiscard]] inline Value jsonTextValue(std::string_view text) {
5378 auto const json = parseJson(text);
5379 if (!json) {
5380 return Value{};
5381 }
5382 auto value = valueFromJson(*json);
5383 return value ? *std::move(value) : Value{};
5384}
5385
5386/// @brief One field of a form as a record: `value` (the encoded value, `null` while blank or invalid), `draft` (the
5387/// text), `valid`, `required`, `visible`, `readonly` and `errors`. Tracked.
5388/// @param field The field.
5389/// @return The record.
5390[[nodiscard]] inline Value formFieldValue(forms::FieldState const& field) {
5391 ValueRecord record;
5392 forms::Encoding const& encoding = field.encoded().get();
5393 Value value;
5394 if (encoding.has_value() && encoding->has_value()) {
5395 value = (*encoding)->value.isNull() ? jsonTextValue((*encoding)->json) : (*encoding)->value;
5396 }
5397 std::optional<forms::FieldError> const& error = field.error().get();
5398 record.insert_or_assign("value", std::move(value));
5399 record.insert_or_assign("draft", Value{field.spec().kind == forms::FieldKind::Object ||
5400 field.spec().kind == forms::FieldKind::ObjectArray
5401 ? std::string{}
5402 : field.draft()});
5403 record.insert_or_assign("valid", Value{!error.has_value()});
5404 record.insert_or_assign("required", Value{field.required().get()});
5405 record.insert_or_assign("visible", Value{field.visible().get()});
5406 record.insert_or_assign("readonly", Value{field.readonly().get()});
5407 record.insert_or_assign("errors",
5408 error.has_value() ? Value{ValueList{Value{error->message}}} : Value{ValueList{}});
5409 return Value{std::move(record)};
5410}
5411
5412/// @brief A form's element values (spec 5 §6): `ready`, `body` (the record the form would submit, `null` while not
5413/// ready), `submitted` (whether a submission was sent), `pending`, and each field by its wire name. Tracked.
5414/// @param element The form's element.
5415/// @param name The value's name.
5416/// @return The value; `null` for a name the form does not have, or a form without a session.
5417[[nodiscard]] inline Value formValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) {
5418 forms::FormSession const* const form = element.form.get();
5419 if (form == nullptr) {
5420 return Value{};
5421 }
5422 if (name == "ready") {
5423 return form->ready();
5424 }
5425 if (name == "body") {
5426 std::optional<std::string> const body = form->body();
5427 return body.has_value() ? jsonTextValue(*body) : Value{};
5428 }
5429 if (name == "submitted") {
5430 return form->submitAttempts() > 0;
5431 }
5432 if (name == "pending") {
5433 return form->pending();
5434 }
5435 for (auto const& field : form->fields()) {
5436 if (field->spec().name == name) {
5437 return formFieldValue(*field);
5438 }
5439 }
5440 return Value{};
5441}
5442
5443inline Value ScreenCore::inputValue(ElementState const& element) const {
5444 std::string_view const kind = element.node->kind;
5445 if (kind == "checkbox") {
5446 return elementValue(element, "checked");
5447 }
5448 if (kind == "select") {
5449 return elementValue(element, "selected");
5450 }
5451 return elementValue(element, "value");
5452}
5453
5454// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion,readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per element value.
5455inline Value ScreenCore::elementValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) const {
5456 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
5457 RtScope const& scope = *element.scope;
5458 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
5459 auto flagOf = [&](std::string_view key, bool fallback) -> Value {
5460 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
5461 if (!expr) {
5462 return fallback;
5463 }
5464 Value const value = evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr);
5465 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
5466 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
5467 };
5468 auto errors = [&]() -> Value { return element.errors->get(); };
5469 auto count = [](Value const& list) -> Value {
5470 ValueList const* const items = list.asList();
5471 return static_cast<std::int64_t>(items == nullptr ? 0 : items->size());
5472 };
5473 if (name == "visible" || name == "enabled") {
5474 return flagOf(name, true);
5475 }
5476 if (name == "errors") {
5477 return errors();
5478 }
5479 if (name == "valid") {
5480 Value const current = errors();
5481 ValueList const* const items = current.asList();
5482 return items == nullptr || items->empty();
5483 }
5484 if (name == "shownErrors") {
5485 RtScope const& policy = scope.policyScope();
5486 std::string const mode = policy.showErrors.empty() ? _doc->showErrors : policy.showErrors;
5487 bool const submittedNow = policy.submitted != nullptr && policy.submitted->get();
5488 if (mode == "always" || (mode == "submit" && submittedNow) ||
5489 (mode != "submit" && (submittedNow || element.touched.get() || touchedWithin(element)))) {
5490 return errors();
5491 }
5492 return Value{ValueList{}};
5493 }
5494 if (kind == "dialog" || kind == "drawer") {
5495 if (name == "open") {
5496 return node.prop("open") ? flagOf("open", false) : Value{element.open.get()};
5497 }
5498 if (name == "ready") {
5499 RtScope const* const inner = element.inner.get();
5500 return inner != nullptr && inner->ready();
5501 }
5502 if (name == "submitted") {
5503 return element.submitted.get();
5504 }
5505 return Value{};
5506 }
5507 if (kind == "table") {
5508 if (name == "selection") {
5509 return tableSelection(element);
5510 }
5511 if (name == "activeKey") {
5512 return element.activeKey.get();
5513 }
5514 if (name == "selectedCount") {
5515 return count(tableSelection(element));
5516 }
5517 if (name == "sort") {
5518 return tableSort(element);
5519 }
5520 if (name == "viewCount" || name == "page" || name == "pageCount" || name == "pageFirst" ||
5521 name == "pageLast") {
5522 return tablePageValue(element, name);
5523 }
5524 if (name == "sourceCount") {
5525 return element.rows == nullptr ? Value{std::int64_t{0}} : count(element.rows->get());
5526 }
5527 ExprPtr const rows = node.prop("rows");
5528 if ((name == "pending" || name == "error") && rows && rows->kind == ExprKind::Query) {
5529 ScopeEnv const env{scope, nullptr};
5530 return env.control(name == "pending" ? ExprKind::Pending : ExprKind::Error, rows->name);
5531 }
5532 return name == "pending" ? Value{false} : Value{};
5533 }
5534 if (kind == "tabs") {
5535 // The shown tab's id: the bound one, else the user's own pick, else the first tab's.
5536 ExprPtr const selected = node.prop("selected");
5537 if (name != "selected") {
5538 return Value{};
5539 }
5540 if (selected && (selected->kind != ExprKind::Literal || !selected->literal.isNull())) {
5541 return evalIn(scope, nullptr, selected);
5542 }
5543 if (Value picked = element.draft.get(); !picked.isNull()) {
5544 return picked;
5545 }
5546 auto const tabs = node.partList("tabs");
5547 return tabs.empty() || tabs.front()->id.empty() ? Value{} : Value{tabs.front()->id};
5548 }
5549 if (kind == "form") {
5550 return formValue(element, name);
5551 }
5552 if (name == "draft") {
5553 return element.draft.get();
5554 }
5555 if (name == "dirty") {
5556 return element.edited.get();
5557 }
5558 if (name == "focused") {
5559 return element.focused.get();
5560 }
5561 if (name == "touched") {
5562 return element.touched.get();
5563 }
5564 if (name == "checked" || name == "selected") {
5565 return element.bound != nullptr ? element.bound->get() : element.draft.get();
5566 }
5567 if (name == "selectedOption") {
5568 Value const selected = elementValue(element, "selected");
5569 ValueList const* const options = element.rows == nullptr ? nullptr : element.rows->get().asList();
5570 if (options != nullptr && !selected.isNull()) {
5571 for (Value const& option : *options) {
5572 if (optionKey(option) == selected) {
5573 return option;
5574 }
5575 }
5576 }
5577 return Value{};
5578 }
5579 if (name == "value") {
5580 if (element.bound != nullptr) {
5581 return element.bound->get();
5582 }
5583 return element.committed.get();
5584 }
5585 return Value{};
5586}
5587
5588inline bool ScreenCore::touchedWithin(ElementState const& element) {
5589 if (element.node->kind != "group") {
5590 return false;
5591 }
5592 std::string const inside = element.node->path + "/";
5593 return std::ranges::any_of(element.scope->elements, [&inside](std::unique_ptr<ElementState> const& other) {
5594 return other->node->path.starts_with(inside) && other->touched.get();
5595 });
5596}
5597
5598// --- Commands --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5599
5600// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): command lists nest
5601inline void ScreenCore::runList(Commands const& commands, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
5602 if (!done) {
5603 done = [](bool) {};
5604 }
5605 if (commands.empty()) {
5606 done(true);
5607 return;
5608 }
5609 struct Join {
5610 std::size_t left = 0;
5611 bool ok = true;
5612 Done done;
5613 };
5614 if (recording) {
5615 logList(commands);
5616 }
5617 auto join = std::make_shared<Join>(Join{.left = commands.size() + 1, .ok = true, .done = std::move(done)});
5618 auto finish = [join](bool succeeded) {
5619 join->ok = join->ok && succeeded;
5620 if (--join->left == 0) {
5621 join->done(join->ok);
5622 }
5623 };
5624 for (Command const& command : commands) {
5625 runOne(command, ctx, finish);
5626 }
5627 finish(true);
5628}
5629
5630// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per command of ui/1.
5631inline void ScreenCore::runOne(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
5632 if (!done) {
5633 done = [](bool) {};
5634 }
5635 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
5636 auto eval = [&](ExprPtr const& expr) { return evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), expr); };
5637 auto finish = [&done](bool succeeded) { done(succeeded); };
5638 switch (command.kind) {
5639 case CommandKind::Set:
5640 runSet(command, ctx, done);
5641 return;
5642 case CommandKind::Reset:
5643 runReset(command, ctx, done);
5644 return;
5645 case CommandKind::Run:
5646 runMutation(command, ctx, std::move(done));
5647 return;
5648 case CommandKind::Refetch: {
5649 // A loaded document's `refetch` names a query in scope (`loadDocument` checks it), as `run` names a
5650 // mutation and `open` a dialog.
5651 scope.find(command.target)->query->refetch();
5652 finish(true);
5653 return;
5654 }
5655 case CommandKind::Open:
5656 case CommandKind::Close: {
5657 ElementState* target = nullptr;
5658 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Close && command.target == "self") {
5659 // `self` is the innermost dialog or drawer whose content holds the command, found lexically. A
5660 // component's fallback scope has no parent, so the walk stops at its boundary as its names do.
5661 RtScope const* walk = &scope;
5662 while (walk->owner == nullptr && walk->parent) {
5663 walk = walk->parent.get();
5664 }
5665 target = walk->owner;
5666 if (target == nullptr && walk != rootScope.lock().get()) {
5667 report(command.path, "`close: self` inside a component names no dialog or drawer");
5668 finish(false);
5669 return;
5670 }
5671 if (target == nullptr) {
5672 finish((host != nullptr && host->closeSelf(_doc->id, std::nullopt)) ||
5673 unsupported(command, "`close: self`"));
5674 return;
5675 }
5676 } else {
5677 target = scope.find(command.target)->element;
5678 }
5679 ElementState& element = *target;
5680 if (element.node->prop("open")) {
5681 report(command.path, "the dialog's `open` is bound to an expression");
5682 finish(false);
5683 return;
5684 }
5685 bool const opening = command.kind == CommandKind::Open;
5686 if (opening && !element.open.peek()) {
5687 element.submitted.set(false);
5688 }
5689 session.noteWrite();
5690 element.open.set(opening);
5691 finish(true);
5692 return;
5693 }
5694 case CommandKind::Navigate: {
5695 NavigateRequest const request{.screen = command.target,
5696 .route = eval(command.extra),
5697 .params = eval(command.value),
5698 .as = command.option,
5699 .call = false};
5700 if (host == nullptr) {
5701 finish(unsupported(command, "`navigate`"));
5702 return;
5703 }
5704 // A navigation without `onResult` and `onCancel` asks for no answer, so it files no call: the screen it
5705 // opens answers nobody, and its `return` is the application's.
5706 if (command.commands.empty() && command.alternative.empty()) {
5707 finish(host->navigate(request, {}, {}) || unsupported(command, "`navigate`"));
5708 return;
5709 }
5710 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
5711 CommandCtx const kept = detached(ctx);
5712 auto onResult = [this, weak, kept, list = &command.commands](Value const& result) {
5713 if (auto const held = weak.lock()) {
5714 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*kept.bindings);
5715 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "event", .read = [result] { return result; }});
5716 CommandCtx const next{.scope = held,
5717 .bindings = bindings,
5718 .cancelClose = kept.cancelClose,
5719 .boundary = kept.boundary};
5720 runtime().batch([&] { runList(*list, next, {}); });
5721 }
5722 };
5723 auto onCancel = [this, weak, kept, list = &command.alternative] {
5724 if (auto const held = weak.lock()) {
5725 CommandCtx next = kept;
5726 next.scope = held;
5727 runtime().batch([&] { runList(*list, next, {}); });
5728 }
5729 };
5730 finish(host->navigate(request, std::move(onResult), std::move(onCancel)) ||
5731 unsupported(command, "`navigate`"));
5732 return;
5733 }
5734 case CommandKind::Return:
5735 finish(host != nullptr && host->closeSelf(_doc->id, eval(command.value))
5736 ? true
5737 : unsupported(command, "`return`"));
5738 return;
5739 case CommandKind::Focus:
5740 if (focusTarget(command, scope, ctx.bindings.get())) {
5741 finish(true);
5742 return;
5743 }
5744 report(command.path, "`" + command.target + "` is not mounted");
5745 finish(false);
5746 return;
5747 case CommandKind::Host:
5748 runHostCommand(command, ctx, done);
5749 return;
5750 case CommandKind::SwitchBackend: {
5751 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
5752 auto committed = [this, weak, target = command.target, path = command.path,
5753 done](std::expected<void, std::string> const& outcome) {
5754 if (!weak.lock()) {
5755 return;
5756 }
5757 if (!outcome) {
5758 report(path, "backendSwitchFailed: " + outcome.error());
5759 done(false);
5760 return;
5761 }
5762 session.backendChanged(target);
5763 done(true);
5764 };
5765 if (host != nullptr && host->switchBackend(command.target, std::move(committed))) {
5766 return;
5767 }
5768 report(command.path, "backend `" + command.target + "` is not listed");
5769 finish(false);
5770 return;
5771 }
5772 case CommandKind::ResetPrefs: {
5773 ValueRecord prefsNow = prefs.peek();
5774 if (command.target == "all") {
5775 prefsNow = prefDefaults;
5776 } else if (auto const found = prefDefaults.find(command.target); found != prefDefaults.end()) {
5777 prefsNow.insert_or_assign(command.target, found->second);
5778 }
5779 prefs.set(std::move(prefsNow));
5780 if (host != nullptr) {
5781 host->resetPrefs(_doc->id, command.target);
5782 }
5783 finish(true);
5784 return;
5785 }
5786 case CommandKind::SetLocale:
5787 session.setLocale(command.target);
5788 if (host != nullptr) {
5789 host->setLocale(command.target);
5790 }
5791 finish(true);
5792 return;
5793 case CommandKind::Notify: {
5794 std::string const text = textOf(eval(command.value), session.formatting());
5795 finish(host != nullptr && host->notify(text, command.option) ? true : unsupported(command, "`notify`"));
5796 return;
5797 }
5798 case CommandKind::Seq: {
5799 // A step that waits for a reply keeps the rest of the sequence in that reply's handler, which the
5800 // dispatcher may hold past the screen: the sequence holds its scope weakly and stops once it is gone.
5801 CommandCtx const inner = detached(CommandCtx{.scope = nullptr,
5802 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings),
5803 .cancelClose = ctx.cancelClose,
5804 .boundary = ctx.boundary});
5805 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
5806 auto step = std::make_shared<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>();
5807 *step = [this, inner, weak, list = &command.commands, done = std::move(done),
5808 weakStep = std::weak_ptr<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>{step}](std::size_t index) {
5809 auto const held = weak.lock();
5810 if (index == list->size() || !held) {
5811 done(held != nullptr);
5812 return;
5813 }
5814 auto const self = weakStep.lock();
5815 CommandCtx current = inner;
5816 current.scope = held;
5817 runOne(list->at(index), current, [self, index, done](bool succeeded) {
5818 if (!succeeded) {
5819 done(false);
5820 return;
5821 }
5822 (*self)(index + 1);
5823 });
5824 };
5825 (*step)(0);
5826 return;
5827 }
5828 case CommandKind::All: {
5829 CommandCtx const inner{.scope = ctx.scope,
5830 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings),
5831 .cancelClose = ctx.cancelClose,
5832 .boundary = ctx.boundary};
5833 runList(command.commands, inner, std::move(done));
5834 return;
5835 }
5836 case CommandKind::If: {
5837 Value const condition = eval(command.value);
5838 bool const* const flag = condition.asBool();
5839 if (flag == nullptr) {
5840 finish(true);
5841 return;
5842 }
5843 runList(*flag ? command.commands : command.alternative, ctx, std::move(done));
5844 return;
5845 }
5846 case CommandKind::CancelClose:
5847 *ctx.cancelClose = true;
5848 finish(true);
5849 return;
5850 case CommandKind::Retry:
5851 // `retry` is valid only inside a boundary's `error`, which is lowered with its boundary.
5852 for (QueryRuntime* const query : ctx.boundary->queries) {
5853 if (!runtime().untracked([&] { return query->error(); }).isNull()) {
5854 query->refetch();
5855 }
5856 }
5857 finish(true);
5858 return;
5859 case CommandKind::SignIn: {
5860 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(command.target);
5861 Value const reply = found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation
5862 ? runtime().untracked([&] { return found->mutation->result(); })
5863 : Value{};
5864 session.clear();
5865 finish(host != nullptr && host->signIn(reply) ? true : unsupported(command, "`signIn`"));
5866 return;
5867 }
5868 case CommandKind::SignOut:
5869 session.clear();
5870 if (host != nullptr) {
5871 host->signOut();
5872 }
5873 finish(true);
5874 return;
5875 case CommandKind::Upload:
5876 case CommandKind::Download:
5877 default:
5878 runTransfer(command, ctx, std::move(done));
5879 return;
5880 }
5881}
5882
5883// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a single run, or a run per list item.
5884inline void ScreenCore::runMutation(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) const {
5885 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
5886 MutationRuntime& mutation = *scope.find(command.target)->mutation;
5887 RtScope const& policy = scope.policyScope();
5888 if (policy.submitted != nullptr) {
5889 policy.submitted->set(true);
5890 }
5891 if (policy.owner != nullptr && !runtime().untracked([&] { return policy.ready(); })) {
5892 done(false);
5893 return;
5894 }
5895 RtScope const& declaring = *[&]() -> RtScope const* {
5896 for (RtScope const* candidate = &scope; candidate != nullptr; candidate = candidate->parent.get()) {
5897 if (candidate->names.contains(command.target)) {
5898 return candidate;
5899 }
5900 }
5901 return &scope;
5902 }();
5903 auto bodyFor = [&](Bindings const& bindings) {
5904 if (command.value) {
5905 return evalIn(scope, &bindings, command.value);
5906 }
5907 if (mutation.decl().body) {
5908 return evalIn(declaring, &bindings, mutation.decl().body);
5909 }
5910 return Value{ValueRecord{}};
5911 };
5912 if (!command.extra) {
5913 Value body = bodyFor(*ctx.bindings);
5914 mutation.run(std::move(body), std::make_shared<Bindings const>(*ctx.bindings),
5915 [bindings = ctx.bindings, bindAs = command.binding, done = std::move(done)](bool succeeded,
5916 Value const& reply) {
5917 if (succeeded && !bindAs.empty()) {
5918 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = bindAs, .read = [reply] { return reply; }});
5919 }
5920 done(succeeded);
5921 });
5922 return;
5923 }
5924 Value const each = evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.extra);
5925 ValueList const items = each.asList() == nullptr ? ValueList{} : *each.asList();
5926 if (items.empty()) {
5927 done(true);
5928 return;
5929 }
5930 struct Each {
5931 std::size_t left = 0;
5932 bool ok = true;
5933 Done done;
5934 };
5935 auto state = std::make_shared<Each>(Each{.left = items.size(), .ok = true, .done = std::move(done)});
5936 std::vector<Value> bodies;
5937 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Bindings const>> bound;
5938 for (Value const& item : items) {
5939 Bindings bindings = *ctx.bindings;
5940 if (!command.binding.empty()) {
5941 bindings.push_back(Binding{.name = command.binding, .read = [item] { return item; }});
5942 }
5943 bodies.push_back(bodyFor(bindings));
5944 bound.push_back(std::make_shared<Bindings const>(std::move(bindings)));
5945 }
5946 if (mutation.decl().concurrency != Concurrency::Exclusive) {
5947 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < bodies.size(); ++index) {
5948 mutation.run(bodies.at(index), bound.at(index), [state](bool succeeded, Value const&) {
5949 state->ok = state->ok && succeeded;
5950 if (--state->left == 0) {
5951 state->done(state->ok);
5952 }
5953 });
5954 }
5955 return;
5956 }
5957 // An exclusive mutation refuses a run while another is in flight, so its elements go one after another.
5958 auto step = std::make_shared<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>();
5959 *step = [&mutation, bodies, bound, state,
5960 weakStep = std::weak_ptr<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>{step}](std::size_t index) {
5961 if (index == bodies.size()) {
5962 state->done(state->ok);
5963 return;
5964 }
5965 auto const self = weakStep.lock();
5966 mutation.run(bodies.at(index), bound.at(index), [self, state, index](bool succeeded, Value const&) {
5967 if (!succeeded) {
5968 state->done(false);
5969 return;
5970 }
5971 (*self)(index + 1);
5972 });
5973 };
5974 (*step)(0);
5975}

5977// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
5978inline void ScreenCore::writeSlot(StateSlot& slot, std::span<std::string const> within, Value value,
5979 Command const& command, Done const& done) {
5980 slot.scope->core.initState(*slot.scope, slot);
5981 Type const& type = slot.decl->type;
5982 if (within.empty() && !type.isAny() && !type.admits(value)) {
5983 report(command.path, "`set` writes a value that is not a " + type.name());
5984 done(false);
5985 return;
5986 }
5987 Value next = withPath(slot.value->peek(), within, std::move(value));
5988 session.noteWrite();
5989 slot.value->set(std::move(next));
5990 done(true);
5991}
5992
5993inline void ScreenCore::runSetApp(Command const& command, std::span<std::string const> rest, Value value,
5994 Done const& done) {
5995 if (RtScope const* const app = session.appScope(); app != nullptr && !rest.empty()) {
5996 NameRef const* const named = app->find(rest.front());
5997 if (named != nullptr && named->category == NameCategory::State) {
5998 writeSlot(*named->state, rest.subspan(1), std::move(value), command, done);
5999 return;
6000 }
6001 report(command.path, "`app." + rest.front() + "` is not state of the app document");
6002 done(false);
6003 return;
6004 }
6005 std::string name;
6006 for (std::string const& segment : rest) {
6007 name += name.empty() ? segment : "." + segment;
6008 }
6009 done(host != nullptr && host->setAppValue(name, value) ? true : unsupported(command, "`set` of `app`"));
6010}
6011
6012inline void ScreenCore::runSet(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
6013 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
6014 auto path = splitPath(command.target);
6015 if (!path || path->empty()) {
6016 done(false);
6017 return;
6018 }
6019 std::string const head = path->front();
6020 std::span<std::string const> const rest = std::span<std::string const>{*path}.subspan(1);
6021 Value value = evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
6022 if (head == "app") {
6023 runSetApp(command, rest, std::move(value), done);
6024 return;
6025 }
6026 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(head);
6027 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
6028 writeSlot(*found->state, rest, std::move(value), command, done);
6029 return;
6030 }
6031 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
6032 ElementState& element = *found->element;
6033 session.noteWrite();
6034 element.draft.set(value);
6035 if (element.bound == nullptr) {
6036 element.committed.set(std::move(value));
6037 }
6038 done(true);
6039 return;
6040 }
6041 report(command.path, "`set` names nothing writable here");
6042 done(false);
6043}
6044
6045inline void ScreenCore::runReset(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
6046 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
6047 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(command.target);
6048 auto resetStates = [this](RtScope const& owner) {
6049 for (auto const& slot : owner.states) {
6050 if (slot->value) {
6051 Value init = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(owner, nullptr, slot->decl->init); });
6052 slot->value->set(std::move(init));
6053 }
6054 }
6055 for (auto const& element : owner.elements) {
6056 element->draft.set(element->bound != nullptr ? runtime().untracked([&] { return element->bound->get(); })
6057 : Value{});
6058 element->committed.set(Value{});
6059 element->edited.set(false);
6060 element->touched.set(false);
6061 }
6062 };
6063 bool known = true;
6064 session.noteWrite();
6065 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
6066 StateSlot& slot = *found->state;
6067 initState(*slot.scope, slot);
6068 slot.value->set(runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*slot.scope, nullptr, slot.decl->init); }));
6069 } else if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
6070 ElementState& element = *found->element;
6071 element.submitted.set(false);
6072 if (RtScope const* const inner = element.inner.peek()) {
6073 resetStates(*inner);
6074 }
6075 } else {
6076 report(command.path, "`reset` names no state or dialog here");
6077 known = false;
6078 }
6079 done(known);
6080}
6081
6082inline void ScreenCore::runHostCommand(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
6083 Value const args = evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
6084 if (auto const& run = session.hostCommandRunner()) {
6085 HostCommandResult const result = run(command.target, args);
6086 if (result.kind == HostCommandResult::Kind::Missing) {
6087 report(command.path, "host command `" + command.target + "` is missing");
6088 } else if (result.kind == HostCommandResult::Kind::Refused) {
6089 report(command.path, result.reason);
6090 }
6091 done(result.kind == HostCommandResult::Kind::Ran);
6092 return;
6093 }
6094 bool const known = host != nullptr && host->hostCommand(command.target, args);
6095 if (!known) {
6096 report(command.path, "host command `" + command.target + "` is missing");
6097 }
6098 done(known);
6099}
6100
6101// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a download and an upload, each settled.
6102/// @brief A transfer's share of its screen's pending count.
6103///
6104/// A transfer is pending from the host accepting it to its settle: its completion carries on the command list that
6105/// started it, which the close protocol and save-and-close wait for. The count is taken once the host accepts, so a
6106/// refused transfer never counts, and a host that settles before it returns leaves nothing taken. It is given back
6107/// once, also when the transfer settles after its scope is gone, but not after the screen itself is gone, since the
6108/// count went with it.
6109class TransferHold {
6110public:
6111 /// @brief A hold that counts nothing yet.
6112 /// @param core The screen whose count it moves.
6113 /// @param alive Expires with the screen.
6114 TransferHold(ScreenCore& core, std::weak_ptr<bool> alive) : _core{&core}, _alive{std::move(alive)} {}
6115
6116 /// @brief Counts the transfer, unless it has already settled.
6117 void take() {
6118 if (_state == State::NotTaken) {
6119 _state = State::Taken;
6120 _core->addPending(1);
6121 }
6122 }
6123
6124 /// @brief Gives the count back, if one was taken and the screen is still there; the transfer counts no more.
6125 void release() {
6126 if (_state == State::Taken && !_alive.expired()) {
6127 _core->addPending(-1);
6128 }
6129 _state = State::Released;
6130 }
6131
6132private:
6133 enum class State : std::uint8_t { NotTaken, Taken, Released };
6134
6135 ScreenCore* _core;
6136 std::weak_ptr<bool> _alive;
6137 State _state = State::NotTaken;
6138};
6139
6140/// @brief Bytes as base64 (RFC 4648, with padding): how a document carries an inline file.
6141/// @param bytes The bytes.
6142/// @return The text.
6143[[nodiscard]] inline std::string base64Encode(std::string_view bytes) {
6144 static constexpr std::string_view kAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
6145 std::string out;
6146 out.reserve(((bytes.size() + 2) / 3) * 4);
6147 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < bytes.size(); index += 3) {
6148 std::size_t const left = std::min<std::size_t>(3, bytes.size() - index);
6149 std::uint32_t group = 0;
6150 for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < 3; ++offset) {
6151 group <<= 8U;
6152 if (offset < left) {
6153 group |= static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes.at(index + offset));
6154 }
6155 }
6156 for (std::size_t digit = 0; digit < 4; ++digit) {
6157 out.push_back(digit <= left ? kAlphabet.at((group >> (18U - (6U * digit))) & 0x3FU) : '=');
6158 }
6159 }
6160 return out;
6161}
6162
6163/// @brief Base64 text as bytes (RFC 4648, with or without padding).
6164/// @param text The text.
6165/// @return The bytes, or `std::nullopt` for text that is not base64.
6166[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<std::string> base64Decode(std::string_view text) {
6167 while (!text.empty() && text.back() == '=') {
6168 text.remove_suffix(1);
6169 }
6170 if (text.size() % 4 == 1) {
6171 return std::nullopt;
6172 }
6173 auto digitOf = [](char chr) -> int {
6174 if (chr >= 'A' && chr <= 'Z') {
6175 return chr - 'A';
6176 }
6177 if (chr >= 'a' && chr <= 'z') {
6178 return chr - 'a' + 26;
6179 }
6180 if (chr >= '0' && chr <= '9') {
6181 return chr - '0' + 52;
6182 }
6183 if (chr == '+') {
6184 return 62;
6185 }
6186 return chr == '/' ? 63 : -1;
6187 };
6188 std::string out;
6189 out.reserve((text.size() * 3) / 4);
6190 std::uint32_t group = 0;
6191 int bits = 0;
6192 for (char const chr : text) {
6193 int const digit = digitOf(chr);
6194 if (digit < 0) {
6195 return std::nullopt;
6196 }
6197 group = (group << 6U) | static_cast<std::uint32_t>(digit);
6198 bits += 6;
6199 if (bits >= 8) {
6200 bits -= 8;
6201 out.push_back(static_cast<char>((group >> static_cast<std::uint32_t>(bits)) & 0xFFU));
6202 }
6203 }
6204 return out;
6205}
6206
6207/// @brief How many bytes base64 text decodes to, read from its length alone.
6208/// @param text The text.
6209/// @return The byte count.
6210[[nodiscard]] inline std::size_t base64Size(std::string_view text) {
6211 while (!text.empty() && text.back() == '=') {
6212 text.remove_suffix(1);
6213 }
6214 return (text.size() * 3) / 4;
6215}
6216
6217/// @brief A byte count as a person reads it: `512 bytes`, `2.4 KiB`, `1 MiB`.
6218/// @param bytes The count.
6219/// @return The text.
6220[[nodiscard]] inline std::string sizeText(std::size_t bytes) {
6221 constexpr std::size_t kKiB = 1024;
6222 if (bytes < kKiB) {
6223 return std::to_string(bytes) + " bytes";
6224 }
6225 bool const mebi = bytes >= kKiB * kKiB;
6226 std::size_t const unit = mebi ? kKiB * kKiB : kKiB;
6227 // One decimal place, rounded half up, and none when it is zero.
6228 std::size_t const tenths = ((bytes * 10) + (unit / 2)) / unit;
6229 std::string text = std::to_string(tenths / 10);
6230 if (tenths % 10 != 0) {
6231 text += "." + std::to_string(tenths % 10);
6232 }
6233 return text + (mebi ? " MiB" : " KiB");
6234}
6235
6236/// @brief A document's inline file content as bytes: base64 text, or a list of integers 0 to 255.
6237/// @param value The value.
6238/// @return The bytes, or why the value is neither.
6239[[nodiscard]] inline std::expected<std::string, std::string> inlineBytes(Value const& value) {
6240 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
6241 if (std::optional<std::string> bytes = base64Decode(*text)) {
6242 return *std::move(bytes);
6243 }
6244 return std::unexpected(std::string{"the text is not base64"});
6245 }
6246 if (ValueList const* const list = value.asList()) {
6247 std::string bytes;
6248 bytes.reserve(list->size());
6249 for (Value const& item : *list) {
6250 std::int64_t const* const byte = item.asInt();
6251 if (byte == nullptr || *byte < 0 || *byte > 255) {
6252 return std::unexpected(std::string{"a byte list holds integers 0 to 255"});
6253 }
6254 bytes.push_back(static_cast<char>(static_cast<unsigned char>(*byte)));
6255 }
6256 return bytes;
6257 }
6258 return std::unexpected(std::string{"inline bytes are base64 text or a list of bytes"});
6259}
6260
6261inline void ScreenCore::runTransfer(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
6262 Value const file = evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
6263 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Download) {
6264 runDownload(command, ctx, file, std::move(done));
6265 } else {
6266 runUpload(command, ctx, file, std::move(done));
6267 }
6268}
6269
6270inline void ScreenCore::runDownload(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Value const& file, Done done) {
6271 Value const name = evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.extra);
6272 auto const hold = std::make_shared<TransferHold>(*this, _alive);
6273 auto const settled = [this, weak = std::weak_ptr<RtScope>{ctx.scope}, target = command.target,
6274 preview = command.option == "preview", done,
6275 hold](std::expected<Value, std::string> const& reply) {
6276 auto const held = weak.lock();
6277 if (!held) {
6278 hold->release();
6279 return;
6280 }
6281 runtime().batch([&] {
6282 bool const succeeded = reply.has_value();
6283 NameRef const* const found = succeeded && preview ? held->find(target) : nullptr;
6284 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
6285 initState(*found->state->scope, *found->state);
6286 session.noteWrite();
6287 found->state->value->set(*reply);
6288 }
6289 done(succeeded);
6290 hold->release();
6291 });
6292 };
6293 if (command.bytes) {
6294 std::optional<InlineFile> const inlined = inlineDownload(command, ctx, file, name);
6295 if (!inlined) {
6296 done(false);
6297 return;
6298 }
6299 if (host == nullptr || !host->saveFile(*inlined, command.option, settled)) {
6300 unsupported(command, "`download`");
6301 done(false);
6302 return;
6303 }
6304 hold->take();
6305 return;
6306 }
6307 if (host == nullptr || !host->download(file, command.option, name, settled)) {
6308 unsupported(command, "`download`");
6309 done(false);
6310 return;
6311 }
6312 hold->take();
6313}
6314
6315// Inline bytes are checked before the host is asked: content over the cap, or that does not decode, never reaches it.
6316inline std::optional<InlineFile> ScreenCore::inlineDownload(
6317 Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx,
6318 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): the command's `file` and `name`, in its order.
6319 Value const& file, Value const& name) {
6320 std::size_t const cap = session.options().maxInlineFileBytes;
6321 std::size_t size = 0;
6322 if (std::string const* const text = file.asString()) {
6323 size = base64Size(*text);
6324 } else if (ValueList const* const list = file.asList()) {
6325 size = list->size();
6326 }
6327 std::expected<std::string, std::string> bytes = size > cap ? std::unexpected(std::string{}) : inlineBytes(file);
6328 if (size > cap || (bytes && bytes->size() > cap)) {
6329 report(command.path, "download: " + sizeText(bytes ? bytes->size() : size) + " is over the " + sizeText(cap) +
6330 " inline cap; serve it through the file store");
6331 return std::nullopt;
6332 }
6333 if (!bytes) {
6334 report(command.path, "download: " + bytes.error());
6335 return std::nullopt;
6336 }
6337 return InlineFile{
6338 .name = textOf(name, session.formatting()),
6339 .mediaType = command.mediaType
6340 ? textOf(evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.mediaType), session.formatting())
6341 : std::string{},
6342 .bytes = *std::move(bytes)};
6343}
6344
6345// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per outcome an upload can have.
6346inline void ScreenCore::runUpload(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Value const& file, Done done) {
6347 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
6348 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
6349 auto const hold = std::make_shared<TransferHold>(*this, _alive);
6350 NameRef const* const transferName = command.transfer.empty() ? nullptr : scope.find(command.transfer);
6351 TransferState* const transfer =
6352 transferName != nullptr && transferName->category == NameCategory::Transfer ? transferName->transfer : nullptr;
6353 auto const progress = [weak, transfer](Value fraction) {
6354 if (weak.lock() && transfer != nullptr) {
6355 transfer->progress.set(std::move(fraction));
6356 }
6357 };
6358 // Settles with the members the mutation's body gets beside its own (the reference or the inline file), or the
6359 // failure.
6360 auto const settled = [this, weak, kept = detached(ctx), transfer, command = &command, done,
6361 hold](std::expected<ValueRecord, std::string> reply) {
6362 auto const held = weak.lock();
6363 if (!held) {
6364 hold->release();
6365 return;
6366 }
6367 runtime().batch([&] {
6368 if (transfer != nullptr) {
6369 transfer->pending.set(false);
6370 transfer->error.set(reply ? Value{} : Value{reply.error()});
6371 }
6372 if (!reply) {
6373 done(false);
6374 hold->release();
6375 return;
6376 }
6377 NameRef const* const found = held->find(command->target);
6378 // The mutation's body cannot name the reference (a body is checked where the mutation is declared),
6379 // so the reference is added to it under `as`, `file` by default.
6380 MutationRuntime& mutation = *found->mutation;
6381 Value const base = evalIn(*held, kept.bindings.get(), mutation.decl().body);
6382 ValueRecord fields = base.asRecord() == nullptr ? ValueRecord{} : *base.asRecord();
6383 for (auto& [member, value] : *reply) {
6384 fields.insert_or_assign(member, std::move(value));
6385 }
6386 // The run takes its own count before this one is given back, so pending never reads zero in between.
6387 mutation.run(Value{std::move(fields)}, std::make_shared<Bindings const>(*kept.bindings),
6388 [done](bool succeeded, Value const&) { done(succeeded); });
6389 hold->release();
6390 });
6391 };
6392 if (host == nullptr) {
6393 unsupported(command, "`upload`");
6394 done(false);
6395 return;
6396 }
6397 if (transfer != nullptr) {
6398 transfer->pending.set(true);
6399 transfer->progress.set(Value{std::int64_t{0}});
6400 transfer->error.set(Value{});
6401 }
6402 NameRef const* const target = scope.find(command.target);
6403 UploadRequest request{.file = file, .modelType = {}, .action = {}};
6404 if (target != nullptr && target->category == NameCategory::Mutation && target->mutation != nullptr) {
6405 request.modelType = target->mutation->typeId();
6406 request.action = target->mutation->decl().action;
6407 }
6408 std::string const member = command.binding.empty() ? std::string{"file"} : command.binding;
6409 bool started = false;
6410 if (command.bytes) {
6411 std::size_t const cap = session.options().maxInlineFileBytes;
6412 started = host->readFile(
6413 file, cap,
6414 [this, settled, progress, cap, member, command = &command](std::expected<InlineFile, std::string> read) {
6415 if (!read) {
6416 settled(std::unexpected(read.error()));
6417 return;
6418 }
6419 if (read->bytes.size() > cap) {
6420 // The host should have refused it; the cap holds whether or not it did.
6421 std::string why = "upload: " + sizeText(read->bytes.size()) + " is over the " + sizeText(cap) +
6422 " inline cap; send it through the file store";
6423 report(command->path, why);
6424 settled(std::unexpected(std::move(why)));
6425 return;
6426 }
6427 progress(Value{std::int64_t{1}});
6428 ValueRecord added;
6429 added.insert_or_assign(member, Value{base64Encode(read->bytes)});
6430 if (!command->nameAs.empty()) {
6431 added.insert_or_assign(command->nameAs, Value{read->name});
6432 }
6433 if (!command->typeAs.empty()) {
6434 added.insert_or_assign(command->typeAs, Value{read->mediaType});
6435 }
6436 settled(std::move(added));
6437 });
6438 } else {
6439 started = host->uploadFor(request, progress, [settled, member](std::expected<Value, std::string> reference) {
6440 if (!reference) {
6441 settled(std::unexpected(reference.error()));
6442 return;
6443 }
6444 ValueRecord added;
6445 added.insert_or_assign(member, *std::move(reference));
6446 settled(std::move(added));
6447 });
6448 }
6449 if (!started) {
6450 if (transfer != nullptr) {
6451 transfer->pending.set(false);
6452 transfer->progress.set(Value{});
6453 }
6454 unsupported(command, "`upload`");
6455 done(false);
6456 return;
6457 }
6458 hold->take();
6459}

6465// --- Lowering --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6466
6467/// @brief A value as a `bool` property: `true` only for `true`.
6468/// @param value The value.
6469/// @param format Unused.
6470/// @return It.
6471[[nodiscard]] inline bool boolOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
6472 static_cast<void>(format);
6473 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
6474 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
6475}
6476
6477/// @brief A value as a text property.
6478/// @param value The value.
6479/// @param format The formatting facts.
6480/// @return Its text.
6481[[nodiscard]] inline std::string stringOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
6482 return textOf(value, format);
6483}
6484
6485/// @brief A value as a custom component's text prop (spec 5 §10): an `int` or `exact` as plain decimal text, so no
6486/// id or amount loses precision; `json` as its JSON text; `string` as the formatted text.
6487/// @param value The value.
6488/// @param type The prop type the component declares.
6489/// @param format The formatting facts, for `string`.
6490/// @return The text.
6491[[nodiscard]] inline std::string componentText(Value const& value, std::string_view type,
6492 FormatContext const& format) {
6493 if (type == "json") {
6494 return canonicalJson(value);
6495 }
6496 if (type == "int" || type == "exact") {
6497 if (std::int64_t const* const whole = value.asInt()) {
6498 return std::to_string(*whole);
6499 }
6500 // A value that cannot be rounded at its own places is written as its exact JSON, never clamped.
6501 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
6502 return detail::decimalText(number->value, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(number->value.decimalPlaces.value))
6503 .value_or(canonicalJson(value));
6504 }
6505 if (Quantity const* const quantity = value.asQuantity()) {
6506 auto const text =
6507 detail::decimalText(quantity->value, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(quantity->value.decimalPlaces.value));
6508 return text ? *text + " " + quantity->unit : canonicalJson(value);
6509 }
6510 }
6511 return textOf(value, format);
6512}
6513
6514/// @brief An exact rational as the nearest double, unrounded.
6515///
6516/// `Rational::toDouble` rounds to the value's own places, which is a display reading: `29 / 100` keeps its operands'
6517/// 0 places and would read as 0. The view tree wants the magnitude, so the lowering reads it here.
6518/// @param value The rational.
6519/// @return Its numerator divided by its denominator.
6520[[nodiscard]] inline double realOf(math::Rational const& value) noexcept {
6521 return static_cast<double>(value.numerator) / static_cast<double>(value.denominator);
6522}
6523
6524/// @brief A value as a custom component's `number` prop: the one kind that crosses as a double.
6525/// @param value The value.
6526/// @return It; zero for anything that is not a number.
6527[[nodiscard]] inline double componentNumber(Value const& value) {
6528 if (std::int64_t const* const whole = value.asInt()) {
6529 return static_cast<double>(*whole);
6530 }
6531 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
6532 return realOf(number->value);
6533 }
6534 if (Quantity const* const quantity = value.asQuantity()) {
6535 return realOf(quantity->value);
6536 }
6537 return 0.0;
6538}
6539
6540/// @brief A custom component's event payload as a value: `i:<int64>` an `int`, `s:<text>` a `string`, anything else
6541/// JSON text read as the event's declared type, and text that is none of those a `string`.
6542/// @param payload The payload, as the backend reports it.
6543/// @param type The payload type the component declares; null for an undeclared event.
6544/// @return The value.
6545[[nodiscard]] inline Value componentPayload(std::string const& payload, Type const* type) {
6546 std::string_view const text{payload};
6547 if (text.starts_with("i:")) {
6548 std::int64_t whole = 0;
6549 std::string_view const digits = text.substr(2);
6550 char const* const last = std::to_address(digits.end());
6551 auto const [end, error] = std::from_chars(std::to_address(digits.begin()), last, whole);
6552 if (error == std::errc{} && end == last) {
6553 return Value{whole};
6554 }
6555 }
6556 if (text.starts_with("s:")) {
6557 return Value{std::string{text.substr(2)}};
6558 }
6559 if (auto json = parseJson(text); json && type != nullptr) {
6560 if (auto value = valueFromJson(*json, *type)) {
6561 return std::move(*value);
6562 }
6563 }
6564 return Value{payload};
6565}
6566
6567/// @brief A value as an integer: an `int`, or a decimal truncated toward zero.
6568/// @param value The value.
6569/// @param fallback What anything else gives.
6570/// @return It.
6571[[nodiscard]] inline std::int64_t intOf(Value const& value, std::int64_t fallback) {
6572 if (std::int64_t const* const number = value.asInt()) {
6573 return *number;
6574 }
6575 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
6576 // Integer division truncates toward zero, and reads the exact value rather than one rounded to its places.
6577 return number->value.numerator / number->value.denominator;
6578 }
6579 return fallback;
6580}

6596 if (name == "section") {

6599 if (name == "error") {

6602 if (name == "success") {

6604 }
6605 if (name == "mono") {
6606 return TextRole::Mono;
6607 }
6608 if (name == "display") {

6610 }
6611 if (name == "small") {
6612 return TextRole::Small;
6613 }
6614 if (name == "overline") {

6616 }

6642/// @brief A tone by name.
6643/// @param value `neutral`, `info`, `ok` (or `success`), `warn` (or `warning`), `err` (or `error`).
6644/// @param format Unused.
6645/// @return The tone; `Neutral` for anything else.
6646[[nodiscard]] inline Tone toneOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
6647 std::string const text = textOf(value, format);
6648 if (text == "info") {
6649 return Tone::Info;
6650 }
6651 if (text == "ok" || text == "success") {
6652 return Tone::Ok;
6653 }
6654 if (text == "warn" || text == "warning") {
6655 return Tone::Warn;
6656 }
6657 if (text == "err" || text == "error") {
6658 return Tone::Err;
6659 }
6660 return Tone::Neutral;
6661}
6662
6663/// @brief A tone by its exact name, the strict reading of a value's evaluation: a table row's and a key-value item's
6664/// tone, which unlike `toneOf` takes no alias, so a misspelt name can be reported.
6665/// @param value `neutral`, `info`, `ok`, `warn` or `err`; `null` is `Neutral`.
6666/// @return The tone; `nullopt` for anything else.
6667[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Tone> toneNamed(Value const& value) {
6668 if (value.isNull()) {
6669 return Tone::Neutral;
6670 }
6671 static constexpr std::array<std::pair<std::string_view, Tone>, 5> kTones = {{
6672 {"neutral", Tone::Neutral},
6673 {"info", Tone::Info},
6674 {"ok", Tone::Ok},
6675 {"warn", Tone::Warn},
6676 {"err", Tone::Err},
6677 }};
6678 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
6679 // A loop, not std::ranges::find: an array's iterator is a pointer on some standard libraries and not on
6680 // others, so `auto` there reads differently to each.
6681 for (auto const& [name, tone] : kTones) {
6682 if (name == *text) {
6683 return tone;
6684 }
6685 }
6686 }
6687 return std::nullopt;
6688}

6690/// @brief A span list's runs: each element a record `{text, strong?, mono?, tone?}`, or a plain run of any other value
6691/// but a list or `null`. A run's text is shown as `textOf` shows any value, so a computed number is a run of
6692/// its digits, and a flag is set only by `true`.
6693/// @param value The list; `null` is no runs.
6694/// @param format How a run's value is written.
6695/// @param dropped Set when the value is not a list, or an element is a list, `null`, or a record without `text`;
6696/// such an element is left out.
6697/// @param badTone Set, when given, when a run's `tone` is none of the tone names; the run is kept, untoned.
6698/// @return The runs, in order.
6699[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<TextSpan> spansOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format, bool& dropped,
6700 bool* badTone = nullptr) {
6701 std::vector<TextSpan> spans;
6702 if (value.isNull()) {
6703 return spans;
6704 }
6705 ValueList const* const runs = value.asList();
6706 if (runs == nullptr) {
6707 dropped = true;
6708 return spans;
6709 }
6710 auto const flag = [](Value const* field) {
6711 bool const* const set = field != nullptr ? field->asBool() : nullptr;
6712 return set != nullptr && *set;
6713 };
6714 for (Value const& run : *runs) {
6715 if (run.asRecord() == nullptr) {
6716 if (run.isNull() || run.asList() != nullptr) {
6717 dropped = true;
6718 } else {
6719 spans.push_back(TextSpan{.text = textOf(run, format)});
6720 }
6721 continue;
6722 }
6723 Value const* const text = run.field("text");
6724 if (text == nullptr) {
6725 dropped = true;
6726 continue;
6727 }
6728 Tone tone = Tone::Neutral;
6729 if (Value const* const named = run.field("tone")) {
6730 if (std::optional<Tone> const known = toneNamed(*named)) {
6731 tone = *known;
6732 } else if (badTone != nullptr) {
6733 *badTone = true;
6734 }
6735 }
6736 spans.push_back(TextSpan{.text = textOf(*text, format),
6737 .strong = flag(run.field("strong")),
6738 .mono = flag(run.field("mono")),
6739 .tone = tone,
6740 .action = flag(run.field("action"))});
6741 }
6742 return spans;
6743}

6748[[nodiscard]] inline bool declaresNames(ScopeDecl const& scope) noexcept {
6749 return !(scope.models.empty() && scope.state.empty() && scope.lets.empty() && scope.queries.empty() &&

6765/// @brief A splitter's `sizes`: a list of numbers, each read as `intOf` reads it.
6766/// @param value The value.
6767/// @return The sizes; `nullopt` for anything but a list whose every item is an `int` or a decimal.
6768[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<std::vector<int>> splitterSizesOf(Value const& value) {
6769 ValueList const* const items = value.asList();
6770 if (items == nullptr) {
6771 return std::nullopt;
6772 }
6773 std::vector<int> sizes;
6774 sizes.reserve(items->size());
6775 for (Value const& item : *items) {
6776 if (item.asInt() == nullptr && item.asDecimal() == nullptr) {
6777 return std::nullopt;
6778 }
6779 sizes.push_back(static_cast<int>(intOf(item, 0)));
6780 }
6781 return sizes;
6782}

6784/// @brief A sizing by its document form: `"content"`, `{"fixed": n}`, `{"stretch": w}` or `{"percent": n}`.
6785/// @param value The value.
6786/// @return The sizing.
6787[[nodiscard]] inline Sizing sizingOf(Value const& value) {
6788 if (Value const* const fixed = value.field("fixed")) {
6789 return Sizing::fixed(static_cast<int>(intOf(*fixed, 0)));
6790 }
6791 if (Value const* const percent = value.field("percent")) {
6792 return Sizing::percent(static_cast<int>(intOf(*percent, 1)));
6793 }
6794 if (Value const* const stretch = value.field("stretch")) {
6795 return Sizing::stretch(static_cast<int>(intOf(*stretch, 1)));
6796 }
6797 return Sizing::content();
6798}

6800/// @brief Whether a value is a sizing of one dimension: `"content"`, `{"fixed": n}`, `{"stretch": w}` or
6801/// `{"percent": n}` with n from 1 to 100.
6802/// @param value The value.
6803/// @return Whether `sizingOf` reads it as written rather than as content by default.
6804[[nodiscard]] inline bool isSizing(Value const& value) {
6805 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
6806 return *text == "content";
6807 }
6808 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
6809 if (record == nullptr || record->size() != 1 || record->begin()->second.asInt() == nullptr) {
6810 return false;
6811 }
6812 if (record->contains("percent")) {
6813 std::int64_t const share = *record->begin()->second.asInt();
6814 return share >= 1 && share <= 100;
6815 }
6816 return record->contains("fixed") || record->contains("stretch");
6817}
