6933/// @brief A node with its width sizing replaced; a node of a kind with no layout is returned as it is.
6934/// @param node The node.
6935/// @param width The sizing.
6936/// @return The node.
6937[[nodiscard]] inline Node withWidth(Node const& node, Sizing width) {
6938 if (!node) {
6939 return node;
6940 }
6941 auto copy = std::make_shared<NodeData>(*node);
6942 std::visit(
6943 [&width](auto& spec) {
6944 if constexpr (requires { spec.common.layout; }) {
6945 spec.common.layout.width = width;
6946 }
6947 },
6948 copy->kind);
6949 return copy;
6950}
6951
6952/// @brief The size request of a holder of @p sizings: a stretch by the largest weight where any is a stretch, and
6953/// content otherwise (a share of a row is not a holder's: `listColumn` passes a lone child's on).
6954/// @param sizings One dimension's sizing of each child.
6955/// @return The holder's sizing.
6956[[nodiscard]] inline Sizing holderSizing(std::span<Sizing const> sizings) {
6957 int weight = 0;
6958 for (Sizing const& sizing : sizings) {
6959 if (sizing.kind == Sizing::Kind::Stretch) {
6960 weight = std::max(weight, sizing.amount);
6961 }
6962 }
6963 return weight > 0 ? Sizing::stretch(weight) : Sizing::content();
6964}
6965
6966/// @brief The column that holds a node list. It stretches along an axis when one of its children does, so the
6967/// content means what its nodes would mean written inline in the holder's parent.
6968/// @param children The content.
6969/// @param gap The spacing step between children.
6970/// @return The column; bounds and `alignSelf` stay unset, because they belong to a child.
6971[[nodiscard]] inline Column listColumn(std::vector<Node> children, int gap = 0) {
6972 std::vector<Sizing> widths;
6973 std::vector<Sizing> heights;
6974 for (Node const& child : children) {
6975 LayoutHints const hints = layoutHintsOf(child);
6976 widths.push_back(hints.width);
6977 heights.push_back(hints.height);
6978 }
6979 // A lone child's share of its row is the holder's, and the child fills the holder, so the share is taken once.
6980 if (children.size() == 1 && widths.front().kind == Sizing::Kind::Percent) {
6981 Sizing const share = widths.front();
6982 children.front() = withWidth(children.front(), Sizing::stretch(1));
6983 Column column{.children = std::move(children), .gap = gap};
6984 column.common.layout.width = share;
6985 column.common.layout.height = holderSizing(heights);
6986 return column;
6987 }
6988 Column column{.children = std::move(children), .gap = gap};
6989 column.common.layout.width = holderSizing(widths);
6990 column.common.layout.height = holderSizing(heights);
6991 return column;
6992}
6993
6994/// @brief Content whose scope is made when it mounts and released when it unmounts: a one-row `forEach` whose
6995/// row view builds it.
6996/// @param build Builds the content, its scope included.
6997/// @param hints The size request of the content. A slot reads the sizing of its direct child alone, which is this
6998/// `forEach`, so the content's stretch reaches the slot only through these.
6999/// @return The node.
7000[[nodiscard]] inline Node lazy(std::function<Node()> build, LayoutHints const& hints = {}) {
7001 Common common;
7002 common.layout = hints;
7003 return ui::forEach<int>([] { return std::vector<int>{0}; }, [](int const&) { return Key{std::int64_t{0}}; },
7004 [build = std::move(build)](reactive::Signal<int> const&) { return build(); },
7005 Axis::Vertical, 0, common);
7006}
7007
7008/// @brief A column of content that holds its scope for as long as it is mounted: its `visible` is a binding
7009/// that keeps the scope alive and reads nothing.
7010/// @param children The content.
7011/// @param scope The scope.
7012/// @param keys The chords of the content.
7013/// @param gap The spacing step between the children.
7014/// @return The node.
7015[[nodiscard]] inline Node holding(std::vector<Node> children, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> scope,
7016 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys = {}, int gap = 0) {
7017 Column column = listColumn(std::move(children), gap);
7018 column.common.visible = Prop<bool>{[held = std::move(scope)] { return held != nullptr; }};
7019 column.common.keys = std::move(keys);
7020 return ui::column(std::move(column));
7021}
7022
7023/// @brief Whether an expression reads a name in @p names.
7024/// @param expr The expression.
7025/// @param names The names.
7026/// @return Whether any form of the expression names one.
7027// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): an expression nests its arguments and fields, and the walk follows them.
7028[[nodiscard]] inline bool readsAny(ExprPtr const& expr, std::set<std::string, std::less<>> const& names) {
7029 if (!expr) {
7030 return false;
7031 }
7032 if (!expr->name.empty() && names.contains(expr->name)) {
7033 return true;
7034 }
7035 return std::ranges::any_of(expr->args, [&](ExprPtr const& arg) { return readsAny(arg, names); }) ||
7036 std::ranges::any_of(expr->fields, [&](auto const& field) { return readsAny(field.second, names); });
7037}
7038// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
7039
7040/// @brief Collects the element ids of a document subtree.
7041/// @param node The root.
7042/// @param out Receives the ids.
7043// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): a node's children and parts are nodes, and the walk follows them.
7044inline void collectIds(DocNode const& node, std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& out) {
7045 if (!node.id.empty()) {
7046 out.insert(node.id);
7047 }
7048 for (auto const* group : {&node.children, &node.parts}) {
7049 for (auto const& [key, list] : *group) {
7050 for (DocNodePtr const& child : list) {
7051 collectIds(*child, out);
7052 }
7053 }
7054 }
7055}
7056
7057// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): lowering a node lowers its children, which come back through here.
7058inline Node ScreenCore::lowerAll(std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes, LowerCtx const& ctx, int gap) {
7059 LowerCtx listCtx = ctx;
7060 listCtx.listGap = gap;
7061 if (nodes.size() == 1) {
7062 return lower(*nodes.front(), listCtx);
7063 }
7064 std::vector<Node> children;
7065 children.reserve(nodes.size());
7066 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
7067 children.push_back(lower(*child, listCtx));
7068 }
7069 // Several nodes share a holder, and a share of a row is not a share of a holder: each is reported and takes its
7070 // content size.
7071 for (auto&& [child, written] : std::views::zip(children, nodes)) {
7072 if (layoutHintsOf(child).width.kind == Sizing::Kind::Percent) {
7073 report(written->path,
7074 "a percent among several nodes is a share of their holder; " + std::string{kPercentPlaces});
7075 child = withWidth(child, Sizing::content());
7076 }
7077 }
7078 Column holder = listColumn(std::move(children), gap);
7079 // The column is the mount's, not the document's: a child that bleeds reaches past the padding of the container
7080 // the document names, so the column passes that padding on instead of hiding it.
7081 holder.holder = true;
7082 return ui::column(std::move(holder));
7083}
7084
7085inline void ScreenCore::fillHolder(std::vector<Node>& children, std::string const& path) {
7086 for (Node& child : children) {
7087 if (layoutHintsOf(child).width.kind == Sizing::Kind::Percent) {
7088 report(path, std::string{kPercentInHolder});
7089 child = withWidth(child, Sizing::stretch(1));
7090 }
7091 }
7092}
7093
7094inline LayoutHints ScreenCore::nodeHints(DocNode const& node, std::set<std::string, std::less<>> const& own,
7095 LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7096 LayoutHints hints;
7097 if (ExprPtr const sizing = node.prop("sizing")) {
7098 if (sizing->kind != ExprKind::Literal && readsAny(sizing, own)) {
7099 report(sizing->path,
7100 "this sizing reads a name the case declares, so the case is held at its "
7101 "content size");
7102 } else {
7103 Value const value = once(ctx, sizing);
7104 Value const* const width = value.field("width");
7105 Value const* const height = value.field("height");
7106 if (width != nullptr || height != nullptr) {
7107 hints.width = width != nullptr && isSizing(*width) ? sizingOf(*width) : Sizing::content();
7108 hints.height = height != nullptr && isSizing(*height) ? sizingOf(*height) : Sizing::content();
7109 } else if (isSizing(value)) {
7110 hints.width = sizingOf(value);
7111 }
7112 }
7113 }
7114 return hints;
7115}
7116
7117inline LayoutHints ScreenCore::holderHints(std::span<DocNode const* const> content, ScopeDecl const* decl,
7118 LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7119 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> own;
7120 for (DocNode const* const node : content) {
7121 collectIds(*node, own);
7122 }
7123 if (decl != nullptr) {
7124 for (ModelDecl const& model : decl->models) {
7125 own.insert(model.name);
7126 }
7127 for (StateDecl const& state : decl->state) {
7128 own.insert(state.name);
7129 }
7130 for (LetDecl const& let : decl->lets) {
7131 own.insert(let.name);
7132 }
7133 for (QueryDecl const& query : decl->queries) {
7134 own.insert(query.name);
7135 }
7136 for (MutationDecl const& mutation : decl->mutations) {
7137 own.insert(mutation.name);
7138 }
7139 }
7140 std::vector<Sizing> widths;
7141 std::vector<Sizing> heights;
7142 for (DocNode const* const node : content) {
7143 LayoutHints const hints = nodeHints(*node, own, ctx);
7144 widths.push_back(hints.width);
7145 heights.push_back(hints.height);
7146 }
7147 LayoutHints out;
7148 out.width = holderSizing(widths);
7149 out.height = holderSizing(heights);
7150 return out;
7151}
7152
7153// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a menu nests, and lowering descends the document.
7154inline Node ScreenCore::lower(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7155 if (recording) {
7156 if (loweredNodes.size() >= kPruneLoweredAt && loweredNodes.size() % kPruneLoweredAt == 0) {
7157 std::erase_if(loweredNodes, [](LoweredNode const& entry) { return entry.scope.expired(); });
7158 }
7159 loweredNodes.push_back(LoweredNode{.node = &node, .scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings});
7160 }
7161 // Only a switch reads the gap of the list around it; every other kind's children are held by a holder that sets
7162 // their gap, so none sees its grandparent's.
7163 if (ctx.listGap != 0 && node.kind != "switch") {
7164 LowerCtx plain = ctx;
7165 plain.listGap = 0;
7166 return lowerKind(node, plain, elementFor(*ctx.scope, node));
7167 }
7168 return lowerKind(node, ctx, elementFor(*ctx.scope, node));
7169}
7170
7171inline Prop<TextRole> ScreenCore::roleProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr) {
7172 if (!expr || expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
7173 return bindProp<TextRole>(ctx, expr, TextRole::Normal, roleOf);
7174 }
7175 return slotProp<TextRole>([this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr] {
7176 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
7177 std::optional<TextRole> const role = roleNamed(textOf(value, session.formatting()));
7178 if (!role) {
7179 report(expr->path, "role is " + canonicalJson(value) + "; " + std::string{kRoleNames});
7180 }
7181 return role.value_or(TextRole::Normal);
7182 });
7183}
7184
7185inline Prop<std::string> ScreenCore::surfaceOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7186 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop("surface");
7187 auto nameOf = [this, path = pointerAppend(node.path, "surface")](Value const& value) -> std::string {
7188 if (std::string const* const name = value.asString()) {
7189 return *name;
7190 }
7191 if (!value.isNull()) {
7192 report(path, "a surface is the name of one; " + canonicalJson(value) + " is not a string");
7193 }
7194 return {};
7195 };
7196 if (!expr || expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
7197 return expr ? Prop<std::string>{nameOf(expr->literal)} : Prop<std::string>{std::string{}};
7198 }
7199 return slotProp<std::string>([scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr, nameOf = std::move(nameOf)] {
7200 return nameOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr));
7201 });
7202}
7203
7204inline KeyValueItem ScreenCore::keyValueItemOf(Value const& item, std::string const& path) {
7205 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
7206 Value const* const label = item.field("label");
7207 Value const* const value = item.field("value");
7208 KeyValueItem out{.label = label == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*label, format),
7209 .value = value == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*value, format)};
7210 if (Value const* const spans = item.field("spans")) {
7211 bool dropped = false;
7212 bool badTone = false;
7213 out.spans = spansOf(*spans, format, dropped, &badTone);
7214 if (dropped) {
7215 report(path, kSpansReason);
7216 }
7217 if (badTone) {
7218 report(path, kSpanToneReason);
7219 }
7220 }
7221 if (Value const* const tone = item.field("tone")) {
7222 std::optional<Tone> const named = toneNamed(*tone);
7223 if (!named) {
7224 report(path, "an item's tone is " + canonicalJson(*tone) + "; " + std::string{kToneNames});
7225 }
7226 out.tone = named.value_or(Tone::Neutral);
7227 }
7228 return out;
7229}
7230
7231// A group needs no widget of its own: it lowers to kinds every backend has, so the view tree and the contract do not
7232// change. Its description is a line read in order after its children, since `Common` carries no accessible
7233// description.
7234inline Node ScreenCore::lowerGroup(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element,
7235 std::vector<Node> children) {
7236 Text legend{.text = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf),
7237 .role = TextRole::Label};
7238 legend.field.required = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("required"), false, boolOf);
7239 std::vector<Node> column;
7240 column.reserve(children.size() + 3);
7241 column.push_back(ui::text(std::move(legend)));
7242 std::ranges::move(children, std::back_inserter(column));
7243 if (ExprPtr const description = node.prop("description")) {
7244 Text line{.text = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, description, std::string{}, stringOf), .role = TextRole::Muted};
7245 line.common.visible = slotProp<bool>([scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, description, this] {
7246 return !textOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), description), session.formatting()).empty();
7247 });
7248 column.push_back(ui::text(std::move(line)));
7249 }
7250 // The shown errors, one line each: a check that targets the group shows its message here.
7251 auto shown = [this, element, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, errors = node.prop("errors")] {
7252 return stringsOf(element != nullptr ? elementValue(*element, "shownErrors")
7253 : evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), errors));
7254 };
7255 Text messages{.text = slotProp<std::string>([shown] {
7256 std::string joined;
7257 for (std::string const& message : shown()) {
7258 joined += (joined.empty() ? "" : "\n") + message;
7259 }
7260 return joined;
7261 }),
7262 .role = TextRole::Error};
7263 messages.common.visible = slotProp<bool>([shown] { return !shown().empty(); });
7264 column.push_back(ui::text(std::move(messages)));
7265 Column spec{.children = std::move(column),
7266 .gap = static_cast<int>(intOf(node.prop("gap") ? once(ctx, node.prop("gap")) : Value{}, 0))};
7267 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
7268 if (spec.common.a11y.role.empty()) {
7269 spec.common.a11y.role = "group";
7270 }
7271 bool const named = std::ranges::any_of(node.partList("a11y"),
7272 [](DocNodePtr const& a11y) { return a11y->prop("name") != nullptr; });
7273 if (!named) {
7274 spec.common.a11y.name = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf);
7275 }
7276 return ui::column(std::move(spec));
7277}
7278
7279inline Prop<std::vector<TextSpan>> ScreenCore::spansProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr) {
7280 return slotProp<std::vector<TextSpan>>([this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr] {
7281 bool dropped = false;
7282 bool badTone = false;
7283 std::vector<TextSpan> spans =
7284 spansOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr), session.formatting(), dropped, &badTone);
7285 if (dropped) {
7286 report(expr->path, kSpansReason);
7287 }
7288 if (badTone) {
7289 report(expr->path, kSpanToneReason);
7290 }
7291 return spans;
7292 });
7293}
7294
7295// The size request: `sizing` (the width, or both dimensions), `alignSelf`, and the bounds.
7296inline void ScreenCore::layoutOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, LayoutHints& layout) {
7297 if (ExprPtr const sizing = node.prop("sizing")) {
7298 // The width, or both dimensions from a `{width, height}` record, one left out being content. The loader
7299 // refuses a literal of another form; a computed one that is none is reported and lowers to content.
7300 Value const value = once(ctx, sizing);
7301 Value const* const width = value.field("width");
7302 Value const* const height = value.field("height");
7303 bool const record = width != nullptr || height != nullptr;
7304 bool const valid = record ? (width == nullptr || isSizing(*width)) && (height == nullptr || isSizing(*height))
7305 : isSizing(value);
7306 if (!valid) {
7307 report(sizing->path, "sizing is " + canonicalJson(value) +
7308 "; a sizing is \"content\", {\"fixed\": n}, {\"stretch\": w}, {\"percent\": n} "
7309 "with n from 1 to 100, or a record of width and height of them");
7310 } else if (record) {
7311 layout.width = width != nullptr ? sizingOf(*width) : Sizing::content();
7312 layout.height = height != nullptr ? sizingOf(*height) : Sizing::content();
7313 if (layout.height.kind == Sizing::Kind::Percent) {
7314 report(sizing->path, std::string{kPercentPlaces});
7315 layout.height = Sizing::content();
7316 }
7317 } else {
7318 layout.width = sizingOf(value);
7319 }
7320 }
7321 if (std::string_view const placed = node.name("alignSelf"); !placed.empty()) {
7322 layout.alignSelf = alignOf(placed);
7323 }
7324 layout.bleed = node.flag("bleed");
7325 // Literal integers, checked at load.
7326 for (auto const& [key, bound] :
7327 {std::pair{"minWidth", &LayoutHints::minWidth}, std::pair{"maxWidth", &LayoutHints::maxWidth},
7328 std::pair{"minHeight", &LayoutHints::minHeight}, std::pair{"maxHeight", &LayoutHints::maxHeight}}) {
7329 if (ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key); expr != nullptr && expr->literal.asInt() != nullptr) {
7330 layout.*bound = static_cast<int>(*expr->literal.asInt());
7331 }
7332 }
7333}
7334
7335/// @brief Where a declaration is lowered, as a focus key reads it.
7336struct FocusPlace {
7337 /// @brief The focus key of the component use it is lowered for, and `>`; empty outside a component.
7338 std::string prefix;
7339 /// @brief The keys of the rows that enclose it, outermost first.
7340 std::vector<std::string> rows;
7341};
7342
7343/// @brief Where @p scope is: the row keys of its chain and the component use it is lowered for.
7344/// @param scope The scope.
7345/// @return It.
7346[[nodiscard]] inline FocusPlace focusPlace(RtScope const& scope) {
7347 FocusPlace place;
7348 for (RtScope const* current = &scope; current != nullptr; current = current->parent.get()) {
7349 if (current->row != nullptr) {
7350 place.rows.push_back(current->rowKey);
7351 }
7352 if (current->parent == nullptr) {
7353 place.prefix = current->usePrefix;
7354 }
7355 }
7356 std::ranges::reverse(place.rows);
7357 return place;
7358}
7359
7360/// @brief A focus key: a declaration's pointer under its component use's prefix, with one key per enclosing row.
7361/// @param place Where the declaration is lowered.
7362/// @param path The declaring node's JSON Pointer.
7363/// @return The key, unique per declaration, row and component use.
7364[[nodiscard]] inline std::string focusKey(FocusPlace const& place, std::string_view path) {
7365 std::string key = place.prefix;
7366 key += path;
7367 for (std::string const& row : place.rows) {
7368 key += '@';
7369 key += row;
7370 }
7371 return key;
7372}
7373
7374/// @brief The focus key of the element @p path declares, lowered in @p scope.
7375/// @param path The declaring node's JSON Pointer.
7376/// @param scope The scope it is lowered in.
7377/// @return The key.
7378[[nodiscard]] inline std::string focusKeyOf(std::string_view path, RtScope const& scope) {
7379 return focusKey(focusPlace(scope), path);
7380}
7381
7382inline void ScreenCore::commonOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, Common& common) {
7383 static_cast<void>(element);
7384 common.visible = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("visible"), true, boolOf);
7385 common.enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("enabled"), true, boolOf);
7386 common.tooltip = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("tooltip"), std::string{}, stringOf);
7387 layoutOf(node, ctx, common.layout);
7388 common.testId = std::string{node.name("testId")};
7389 if (!node.id.empty()) {
7390 common.focusId = focusKeyOf(node.path, *ctx.scope);
7391 }
7392 common.surface = surfaceOf(node, ctx);
7393 if (ExprPtr const autofocus = node.prop("autofocus")) {
7394 common.autofocus = boolOf(once(ctx, autofocus), session.formatting());
7395 }
7396 for (DocNodePtr const& a11y : node.partList("a11y")) {
7397 common.a11y.name = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, a11y->prop("name"), std::string{}, stringOf);
7398 common.a11y.role = std::string{a11y->name("role")};
7399 }
7400 for (DocNodePtr const& drag : node.partList("drag")) {
7401 ExprPtr const payload = drag->prop("payload");
7402 common.dragKey = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>(
7403 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, payload]() -> std::optional<Key> {
7404 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), payload);
7405 return value.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(value)};
7406 });
7407 }
7408 for (DocNodePtr const& drop : node.partList("drop")) {
7409 ExprPtr const accepts = drop->prop("accepts");
7410 common.accepts = [this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, accepts](Key const& key) {
7411 if (!accepts) {
7412 return true;
7413 }
7414 Value const accepted = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), accepts); });
7415 if (ValueList const* const items = accepted.asList()) {
7416 return std::ranges::any_of(*items, [&](Value const& item) { return keyOf(item) == key; });
7417 }
7418 return accepted.isNull() || keyOf(accepted) == key;
7419 };
7420 common.onDrop = [this, ctx, commands = drop->event("onDrop")](Key const& key) {
7421 runEvent(commands, ctx, valueOfKey(key));
7422 };
7423 }
7424 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : node.keys) {
7425 common.keys.push_back(
7426 KeyBinding{.chord = chord, .onPress = [this, ctx, list = &commands] { runEvent(list, ctx, Value{}); }});
7427 }
7428}
7429
7430inline void ScreenCore::fieldOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, FieldState& field) {
7431 field.readonly = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("readonly"), false, boolOf);
7432 field.required = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("required"), false, boolOf);
7433 field.stale = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("stale"), false, boolOf);
7434 if (element != nullptr) {
7435 field.errors = slotProp<std::vector<std::string>>(
7436 [this, scope = ctx.scope, element] { return stringsOf(elementValue(*element, "shownErrors")); });
7437 } else if (ExprPtr const errors = node.prop("errors")) {
7438 field.errors = slotProp<std::vector<std::string>>([scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, errors] {
7439 return stringsOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), errors));
7440 });
7441 }
7442 // A tone evaluates the value and is not an error: it changes the field's look and nothing of `valid`.
7443 if (node.prop("description")) {
7444 field.description = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("description"), std::string{}, stringOf);
7445 }
7446 if (node.prop("labelHint")) {
7447 field.labelHint = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("labelHint"), std::string{}, stringOf);
7448 }
7449 if (ExprPtr const tone = node.prop("tone")) {
7450 field.tone = slotProp<Tone>([this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, tone] {
7451 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), tone);
7452 std::optional<Tone> const named = toneNamed(value);
7453 if (!named) {
7454 report(tone->path, "tone is " + canonicalJson(value) + "; " + std::string{kToneNames});
7455 }
7456 return named.value_or(Tone::Neutral);
7457 });
7458 }
7459}
7460
7461inline MenuItem ScreenCore::menuItemOf(DocNode const& part, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7462 MenuItem item;
7463 if (part.flag("separator")) {
7464 item.separator = true;
7465 return item;
7466 }
7467 item.label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part.prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf);
7468 item.description = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part.prop("description"), std::string{}, stringOf);
7469 item.visible = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part.prop("visible"), true, boolOf);
7470 if (Commands const* const commands = part.event("onClick")) {
7471 item.onSelect = [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
7472 }
7473 if (ExprPtr const icon = part.prop("icon")) {
7474 item.icon = textOf(once(ctx, icon), session.formatting());
7475 }
7476 item.keys = std::string{part.name("keys")};
7477 if (ExprPtr const checked = part.prop("checked")) {
7478 item.checked = slotProp<std::optional<bool>>(
7479 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, checked]() -> std::optional<bool> {
7480 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), checked);
7481 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
7482 return flag == nullptr ? std::nullopt : std::optional<bool>{*flag};
7483 });
7484 }
7485 item.enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part.prop("enabled"), true, boolOf);
7486 return item;
7487}
7488
7489// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): a submenu is a menu one level down.
7490inline std::vector<MenuItem> ScreenCore::menuItems(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7491 std::vector<MenuItem> items;
7492 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
7493 MenuItem item = menuItemOf(*part, ctx);
7494 if (!item.separator) {
7495 item.items = menuItems(part->partList("items"), ctx);
7496 }
7497 items.push_back(std::move(item));
7498 }
7499 return items;
7500}
7501
7502// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): a submenu is a menu one level down.
7503inline std::vector<HeadMenuModel> ScreenCore::lowerHeadMenu(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7504 std::vector<HeadMenuModel> models;
7505 models.reserve(parts.size());
7506 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
7507 models.push_back(HeadMenuModel{.id = part->id,
7508 .path = part->path,
7509 .item = menuItemOf(*part, ctx),
7510 .items = lowerHeadMenu(part->partList("items"), ctx)});
7511 }
7512 return models;
7513}
7514
7515inline std::vector<HeadToolModel> ScreenCore::lowerHeadTools(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7516 static constexpr int kSearchWidth = 30;
7517 std::vector<HeadToolModel> models;
7518 models.reserve(parts.size());
7519 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
7520 bool const search = part->name("kind") == "search";
7521 HeadToolModel model{
7522 .id = part->id,
7523 .path = part->path,
7524 .kind = search ? HeadToolKind::Search : HeadToolKind::Select,
7525 .label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf),
7526 .value = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("value"), std::string{}, stringOf),
7527 .placeholder = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("placeholder"), std::string{}, stringOf),
7528 .options = {},
7529 .selected = {},
7530 .width = search ? kSearchWidth : 0,
7531 .enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("enabled"), true, boolOf),
7532 .visible = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("visible"), true, boolOf),
7533 .edit = {},
7534 .submit = {}};
7535 if (ExprPtr const width = part->prop("width")) {
7536 if (std::int64_t const* const units = width->literal.asInt()) {
7537 model.width = static_cast<int>(*units);
7538 }
7539 }
7540 if (!search) {
7541 model.options = slotProp<std::vector<SelectOption>>(
7542 [this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, options = part->prop("options")] {
7543 return selectOptions(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), options), session.formatting());
7544 });
7545 model.selected = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>([scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings,
7546 selected = part->prop("selected")]() -> std::optional<Key> {
7547 Value const value = selected ? evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), selected) : Value{};
7548 return value.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(value)};
7549 });
7550 }
7551 Commands const* const edited = part->event(search ? "onChange" : "onChoose");
7552 model.edit = [this, ctx, edited](Value event) { runEvent(edited, ctx, std::move(event)); };
7553 if (search) {
7554 model.submit = [this, ctx, onSubmit = part->event("onSubmit")](Value event) {
7555 runEvent(onSubmit, ctx, std::move(event));
7556 };
7557 }
7558 models.push_back(std::move(model));
7559 }
7560 return models;
7561}
7562
7563inline ActionModels ScreenCore::lowerActionParts(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7564 ActionModels models;
7565 models.reserve(parts.size());
7566 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
7567 ActionModel model{.id = part->id,
7568 .path = part->path,
7569 .label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf),
7570 .icon = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("icon"), std::string{}, stringOf),
7571 .iconOnly = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("iconOnly"), false, boolOf),
7572 .emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Normal,
7573 .enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("enabled"), true, boolOf),
7574 .visible = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("visible"), true, boolOf),
7575 .run = {}};
7576 model.emphasis = emphasisNamed(part->name("emphasis")).value_or(ButtonEmphasis::Normal);
7577 if (Commands const* const commands = part->event("onClick")) {
7578 model.run = [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
7579 }
7580 models.push_back(std::move(model));
7581 }
7582 return models;
7583}
7584
7585inline Node ScreenCore::actionBarOf(ActionModels actions) {
7586 ActionBar bar;
7587 for (ActionModel& action : actions) {
7588 Button button{.label = action.label,
7589 .emphasis = action.emphasis,
7590 .onClick = std::move(action.run),
7591 .common = {},
7592 .icon = action.icon.evaluate()};
7593 if (action.iconOnly.isBound() || action.iconOnly.constant()) {
7594 // The label is the button's name and tooltip; the caption is empty while the icon stands alone.
7595 button.label = Prop<std::string>{[label = action.label, iconOnly = action.iconOnly] {
7596 return iconOnly.evaluate() ? std::string{} : label.evaluate();
7597 }};
7598 button.common.a11y.name = action.label;
7599 button.common.tooltip = action.label;
7600 }
7601 button.common.visible = std::move(action.visible);
7602 button.common.enabled = std::move(action.enabled);
7603 button.common.testId = "action_" + action.id;
7604 bar.children.push_back(ui::button(std::move(button)));
7605 }
7606 return ui::actionBar(std::move(bar));
7607}
7608
7609inline std::vector<BadgeModel> ScreenCore::lowerBadgeParts(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7610 std::vector<BadgeModel> badges;
7611 badges.reserve(parts.size());
7612 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
7613 badges.push_back(BadgeModel{.text = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("text"), std::string{}, stringOf),
7614 .tone = bindProp<Tone>(ctx, part->prop("tone"), Tone::Neutral, toneOf),
7615 .icon = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("icon"), std::string{}, stringOf),
7616 .visible = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("visible"), true, boolOf)});
7617 }
7618 return badges;
7619}
7620
7621// The readers every kind's lowering shares, each bound to the node being lowered.
7622class ScreenCore::KindKit {
7623public:
7624 KindKit(ScreenCore& core, DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element)
7625 : _core{core}, _node{node}, _ctx{ctx}, _element{element}, _format{core.session.formatting()} {}
7626
7627 // The children under @p key, each lowered with @p gap as the gap of the list around it.
7628 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Node> children(std::string_view key, int gap = 0) const {
7629 LowerCtx listCtx = _ctx;
7630 listCtx.listGap = gap;
7631 std::vector<Node> out;
7632 for (DocNodePtr const& child : _node.nodes(key)) {
7633 out.push_back(_core.lower(*child, listCtx));
7634 }
7635 return out;
7636 }
7637
7638 // The children under @p key as one node: none is empty, several share a holder that sets @p gap.
7639 [[nodiscard]] Node child(std::string_view key, int gap = 0) const {
7640 auto const nodes = _node.nodes(key);
7641 return nodes.empty() ? Node{} : _core.lowerAll(nodes, _ctx, gap);
7642 }
7643
7644 [[nodiscard]] std::int64_t onceInt(std::string_view key, std::int64_t fallback) const {
7645 ExprPtr const expr = _node.prop(key);
7646 return expr ? intOf(_core.once(_ctx, expr), fallback) : fallback;
7647 }
7648
7649 [[nodiscard]] bool onceBool(std::string_view key, bool fallback) const {
7650 ExprPtr const expr = _node.prop(key);
7651 return expr ? boolOf(_core.once(_ctx, expr), _format) : fallback;
7652 }
7653
7654 // A stack's padding: one step, or the loader-checked constant list of the vertical and the horizontal step. A
7655 // computed padding that yields a list is not a step: it is reported once and taken as 0.
7656 [[nodiscard]] Padding stackPadding() const {
7657 ExprPtr const expr = _node.prop("padding");
7658 if (!expr) {
7659 return {};
7660 }
7661 Value const value = _core.once(_ctx, expr);
7662 if (ValueList const* const steps = value.asList()) {
7663 if (expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal && steps->size() == 2) {
7664 return Padding{static_cast<int>(intOf(steps->at(0), 0)), static_cast<int>(intOf(steps->at(1), 0))};
7665 }
7666 _core.report(_node.path + "/padding", "a computed `padding` is one spacing step, not a list; taken as 0");
7667 return {};
7668 }
7669 return Padding{static_cast<int>(intOf(value, 0))};
7670 }
7671
7672 [[nodiscard]] std::string onceText(std::string_view key) const {
7673 ExprPtr const expr = _node.prop(key);
7674 return expr ? textOf(_core.once(_ctx, expr), _format) : std::string{};
7675 }
7676
7677 [[nodiscard]] Prop<std::string> textProp(std::string_view key) const {
7678 return _core.bindProp<std::string>(_ctx, _node.prop(key), std::string{}, stringOf);
7679 }
7680
7681 // A field shows no caption of its own, so its label is what names it to assistive technology. An `a11y` part
7682 // that gives a name was written for that purpose and wins; one that gives only a role leaves the label.
7683 void nameByLabel(Common& common) const {
7684 bool const named = std::ranges::any_of(_node.partList("a11y"),
7685 [](DocNodePtr const& a11y) { return a11y->prop("name") != nullptr; });
7686 if (_node.prop("label") && !named) {
7687 common.a11y.name = textProp("label");
7688 }
7689 }
7690
7691 // A standalone input draws its label as a caption only when the document asks for it (`showLabel`).
7692 template <typename Spec>
7693 void captionOf(Spec& spec) const {
7694 if (_node.prop("label")) {
7695 spec.label = textProp("label");
7696 }
7697 spec.showLabel = _node.flag("showLabel");
7698 }
7699
7700 [[nodiscard]] Action action(std::string_view key) const {
7701 Commands const* const commands = _node.event(key);
7702 if (commands == nullptr) {
7703 return {};
7704 }
7705 return [core = &_core, ctx = _ctx, commands] { core->runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
7706 }
7707
7708 [[nodiscard]] ActionButton actionPart() const {
7709 ActionButton button;
7710 for (DocNodePtr const& part : _node.partList("action")) {
7711 button.label = _core.bindProp<std::string>(_ctx, part->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf);
7712 if (Commands const* const commands = part->event("onClick")) {
7713 button.onClick = [core = &_core, ctx = _ctx, commands] { core->runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
7714 }
7715 }
7716 return button;
7717 }
7718
7719 // A reader of the element's value under @p name.
7720 [[nodiscard]] auto read(std::string_view name) const {
7721 return [element = _element, core = &_core, name = std::string{name}] {
7722 return core->elementValue(*element, name);
7723 };
7724 }
7725
7726private:
7727 // NOLINTBEGIN(cppcoreguidelines-avoid-const-or-ref-data-members): the kit lives inside one lowering call, in
7728 // which all four outlive it.
7729 ScreenCore& _core;
7730 DocNode const& _node;
7731 LowerCtx const& _ctx;
7732 ElementState* _element;
7733 FormatContext const& _format;
7734 // NOLINTEND(cppcoreguidelines-avoid-const-or-ref-data-members)
7735};
7736
7737// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of ui/1.
7738inline std::optional<Node> ScreenCore::lowerWidget(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
7739 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
7740 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
7741 KindKit const kit{*this, node, ctx, element};
7742 if (kind == "text") {
7743 Text spec{.role = roleProp(ctx, node.prop("role"))};
7744 // A text with spans shows them, so its `text`, an older client's fallback, is not lowered.
7745 if (ExprPtr const spans = node.prop("spans")) {
7746 spec.spans = spansProp(ctx, spans);
7747 } else {
7748 spec.text = kit.textProp("text");
7749 }
7750 if (!node.name("align").empty()) {
7751 spec.align = textAlignNamed(node.name("align"));
7752 }
7753 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
7754 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
7755 return ui::text(std::move(spec));
7756 }
7757 if (kind == "button") {
7758 Button spec{.label = kit.textProp("label")};
7759 spec.icon = kit.onceText("icon");
7760 spec.emphasis = emphasisNamed(node.name("emphasis")).value_or(ButtonEmphasis::Normal);
7761 if (node.name("style") == "item") {
7762 spec.style = ButtonStyle::Item;
7763 }
7764 spec.shape = shapeNamed(node.name("shape")).value_or(ControlShape::Default);
7765 spec.size = sizeNamed(node.name("size")).value_or(ButtonSize::Normal);
7766 spec.mono = node.flag("mono");
7767 spec.weight = weightNamed(node.name("weight")).value_or(0);
7768 if (node.prop("selected")) {
7769 spec.selected = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("selected"), false, boolOf);
7770 // An entry's content, drawn in place of its label: one node as it is, several in a column.
7771 if (std::vector<Node> content = kit.children("children"); content.size() == 1) {
7772 spec.child = std::move(content.front());
7773 } else if (!content.empty()) {
7774 spec.child = ui::column(Column{.children = std::move(content)});
7775 }
7776 }
7777 Commands const* const onClick = node.event("onClick");
7778 Commands const* const onActivate = node.event("onActivate");
7779 if (onClick != nullptr || onActivate != nullptr) {
7780 spec.onClick = [this, ctx, onClick, onActivate] {
7781 runEvent(onClick, ctx, Value{});
7782 runEvent(onActivate, ctx, Value{});
7783 };
7784 }
7785 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
7786 return ui::button(std::move(spec));
7787 }
7788 if (kind == "textInput") {
7789 std::string const commitOn = node.name("commitOn").empty() ? "change" : std::string{node.name("commitOn")};
7790 auto commit = [this, ctx, element, commitOn, onChange = node.event("onChange")](std::string const& when,
7791 std::string const& text) {
7792 if (commitOn != when) {
7793 return;
7794 }
7795 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
7796 session.noteWrite();
7797 element->committed.set(Value{text});
7798 }
7799 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{text});
7800 };
7801 TextInput spec;
7802 spec.value =
7803 slotProp<std::string>([this, element] { return textOf(element->draft.get(), session.formatting()); });
7804 spec.onChange = [this, element, commit](std::string text) {
7805 session.asUser([&] {
7806 session.noteWrite();
7807 element->draft.set(Value{text});
7808 element->edited.set(true);
7809 });
7810 commit("change", text);
7811 };
7812 spec.onCommit = [this, ctx, element, commit, onCommit = node.event("onCommit")](std::string const& text) {
7813 element->touched.set(true);
7814 commit("blur", text);
7815 runEvent(onCommit, ctx, Value{text});
7816 };
7817 // Only a field that does something on Enter submits: one without `onSubmit` that does not commit on Enter
7818 // lets Enter go on to its ancestors' chords, a dialog's `default` among them.
7819 if (Commands const* const onSubmit = node.event("onSubmit"); onSubmit != nullptr || commitOn == "enter") {
7820 spec.onSubmit = [this, ctx, commit, onSubmit](std::string const& text) {
7821 commit("enter", text);
7822 runEvent(onSubmit, ctx, Value{text});
7823 };
7824 }
7825 spec.placeholder = kit.textProp("placeholder");
7826 std::string const mode = kit.onceText("mode");
7827 spec.mode = TextInputMode::SingleLine;
7828 if (mode == "multiline") {
7829 spec.mode = TextInputMode::Multiline;
7830 } else if (mode == "password") {
7831 spec.mode = TextInputMode::Password;
7832 }
7833 // A multiline input shows no unit and no icon; a computed mode that turns out multiline is reported and
7834 // its unit and icon left out, so the mount never meets them there. The loader refuses a literal one.
7835 for (std::string_view const key :
7836 {std::string_view{"unit"}, std::string_view{"icon"}, std::string_view{"prefix"}}) {
7837 if (ExprPtr const given = node.prop(key); given != nullptr && spec.mode == TextInputMode::Multiline) {
7838 report(given->path, "a multiline input shows no " + std::string{key});
7839 }
7840 }
7841 spec.mono = node.flag("mono");
7842 if (spec.mode != TextInputMode::Multiline) {
7843 spec.emphasis = node.name("emphasis") == "prominent" ? InputEmphasis::Prominent : InputEmphasis::Normal;
7844 spec.icon = kit.onceText("icon");
7845 spec.align = alignOf(node.name("align"));
7846 if (spec.align == Align::Stretch) {
7847 spec.align = Align::Start;
7848 }
7849 if (node.prop("unit")) {
7850 spec.unit = kit.textProp("unit");
7851 }
7852 if (node.prop("prefix")) {
7853 spec.prefix = kit.textProp("prefix");
7854 }
7855 }
7856 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
7857 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
7858 kit.nameByLabel(spec.common);
7859 kit.captionOf(spec);
7860 return ui::textInput(std::move(spec));
7861 }
7862 if (kind == "checkbox") {
7863 Checkbox spec{.label = kit.textProp("label"), .checked = slotProp<bool>([read = kit.read("checked")] {
7864 Value const value = read();
7865 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
7866 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
7867 })};
7868 spec.onToggle = [this, ctx, element, onToggle = node.event("onToggle"),
7869 onChange = node.event("onChange")](bool checked) {
7870 // A toggle is a check box's commit, so it touches the box.
7871 session.asUser([&] {
7872 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
7873 session.noteWrite();
7874 element->draft.set(checked);
7875 }
7876 element->touched.set(true);
7877 });
7878 runEvent(onToggle, ctx, Value{checked});
7879 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{checked});
7880 };
7881 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
7882 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
7883 return ui::checkbox(std::move(spec));
7884 }
7885 if (kind == "select") {
7886 Select spec;
7887 spec.options = slotProp<std::vector<SelectOption>>(
7888 [this, element] { return selectOptions(element->rows->get(), session.formatting()); });
7889 spec.selected = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>([read = kit.read("selected")]() -> std::optional<Key> {
7890 Value const selected = read();
7891 return selected.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(selected)};
7892 });
7893 spec.onSelect = [this, ctx, element, onChoose = node.event("onChoose"),
7894 onChange = node.event("onChange")](Key const& key) {
7895 Value const chosen = valueOfKey(key);
7896 // A choice is a select's commit, so it touches the select.
7897 session.asUser([&] {
7898 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
7899 session.noteWrite();
7900 element->draft.set(chosen);
7901 }
7902 element->touched.set(true);
7903 });
7904 runEvent(onChoose, ctx, chosen);
7905 runEvent(onChange, ctx, chosen);
7906 };
7907 // A computed style of no known name is reported once and drawn as a dropdown; the loader refuses a constant
7908 // one.
7909 if (ExprPtr const style = node.prop("style")) {
7910 std::string const name = textOf(once(ctx, style), session.formatting());
7911 if (name == "radio") {
7912 spec.style = SelectStyle::Radio;
7913 } else if (name == "segmented") {
7914 spec.style = SelectStyle::Segmented;
7915 } else if (name != "dropdown") {
7916 report(style->path, "style is `" + name + "`; a select's style is dropdown, radio or segmented");
7917 }
7918 }
7919 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
7920 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
7921 kit.nameByLabel(spec.common);
7922 kit.captionOf(spec);
7923 return ui::select(std::move(spec));
7924 }
7925 if (kind == "slider") {
7926 Slider spec;
7927 spec.value = slotProp<std::int64_t>([read = kit.read("value"), element] {
7928 return intOf(element->bound != nullptr ? read() : element->draft.get(), 0);
7929 });
7930 spec.minimum = kit.onceInt("min", 0);
7931 spec.maximum = kit.onceInt("max", 100);
7932 spec.step = kit.onceInt("step", 1);
7933 spec.onChange = [this, ctx, element, onChange = node.event("onChange")](std::int64_t value) {
7934 session.asUser([&] {
7935 session.noteWrite();
7936 element->draft.set(value);
7937 element->edited.set(true);
7938 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
7939 element->committed.set(value);
7940 }
7941 });
7942 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{value});
7943 };
7944 spec.onCommit = [this, ctx, element, onCommit = node.event("onCommit")](std::int64_t value) {
7945 element->touched.set(true);
7946 runEvent(onCommit, ctx, Value{value});
7947 };
7948 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
7949 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
7950 kit.nameByLabel(spec.common);
7951 return ui::slider(std::move(spec));
7952 }
7953 if (kind == "dateTimeInput") {
7954 DateTimeInput spec;
7955 DateMode const mode = kit.onceText("mode") == "date" ? DateMode::Date : DateMode::DateTime;
7956 std::optional<TypeKind> heldAtLoad;
7957 if (auto const found = _doc->dateValueKinds.find(&node); found != _doc->dateValueKinds.end()) {
7958 heldAtLoad = found->second;
7959 }
7960 std::string const valuePath = pointerAppend(node.path, "value");
7961 std::int32_t const offsetMinutes = format.utcOffsetMinutes;
7962 spec.value = slotProp<std::optional<time::Timestamp>>([this, element, offsetMinutes,
7963 valuePath]() -> std::optional<time::Timestamp> {
7964 DateReading const reading = dateInstantOf(element->draft.get(), offsetMinutes);
7965 if (!reading.readable) {
7966 report(valuePath, "`dateTimeInput` shows a timestamp or an ISO-8601 date or date-time string");
7967 }
7968 return reading.instant ? std::optional<time::Timestamp>{time::Timestamp{*reading.instant}} : std::nullopt;
7969 });
7970 spec.onChange = [this, ctx, element, heldAtLoad, mode, offsetMinutes, onChange = node.event("onChange"),
7971 onCommit = node.event("onCommit")](std::optional<time::Timestamp> value) {
7972 bool asString = element->bound != nullptr && element->bound->get().asString() != nullptr;
7973 if (heldAtLoad) {
7974 asString = *heldAtLoad == TypeKind::String;
7975 }
7976 std::optional<time::DateTime> const instant = value ? value->value : std::nullopt;
7977 Value entered;
7978 if (!asString) {
7979 if (instant) {
7980 entered = Value{*instant};
7981 }
7982 } else if (!instant) {
7983 entered = Value{std::string{}};
7984 } else if (mode == DateMode::Date) {
7985 entered = Value{dateTextOf(*instant, offsetMinutes)};
7986 } else {
7987 entered = Value{instant->toIso8601()};
7988 }
7989 element->touched.set(true);
7990 session.asUser([&] {
7991 session.noteWrite();
7992 element->draft.set(entered);
7993 element->edited.set(true);
7994 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
7995 element->committed.set(entered);
7996 }
7997 });
7998 runEvent(onChange, ctx, entered);
7999 runEvent(onCommit, ctx, entered);
8000 };
8001 spec.mode = mode;
8002 spec.offsetMinutes = offsetMinutes;
8003 // Read once and untracked, like the zone: a pattern changed after mount applies to inputs mounted later.
8004 FormatContext const& now = session.formattingNow();
8005 spec.pattern = mode == DateMode::Date ? now.datePattern : now.dateTimePattern;
8006 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
8007 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8008 kit.nameByLabel(spec.common);
8009 kit.captionOf(spec);
8010 return ui::dateTimeInput(std::move(spec));
8011 }
8012 if (kind == "filePicker") {
8013 FilePicker spec;
8014 spec.path =
8015 slotProp<std::string>([this, element] { return textOf(element->draft.get(), session.formatting()); });
8016 spec.onPicked = [this, ctx, element, onPick = node.event("onPick")](std::string path) {
8017 session.asUser([&] {
8018 session.noteWrite();
8019 element->draft.set(Value{path});
8020 element->committed.set(Value{path});
8021 });
8022 runEvent(onPick, ctx, Value{path});
8023 };
8024 spec.mode = kit.onceText("mode") == "save" ? FilePickerMode::Save : FilePickerMode::Open;
8025 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
8026 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8027 kit.nameByLabel(spec.common);
8028 return ui::filePicker(std::move(spec));
8029 }
8030 if (kind == "menu") {
8031 Menu spec{.items = menuItems(node.partList("items"), ctx)};
8032 if (node.name("style") == "button") {
8033 spec.style = MenuStyle::Button;
8034 spec.label = kit.textProp("label");
8035 spec.icon = kit.onceText("icon");
8036 if (node.name("emphasis") == "primary") {
8037 spec.emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Primary;
8038 } else if (node.name("emphasis") == "danger") {
8039 spec.emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Danger;
8040 } else if (node.name("emphasis") == "ghost") {
8041 spec.emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Ghost;
8042 }
8043 }
8044 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8045 return ui::menu(std::move(spec));
8046 }
8047 return std::nullopt;
8048}
8049
8050// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of ui/1.
8051inline std::optional<Node> ScreenCore::lowerDisplay(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8052 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
8053 KindKit const kit{*this, node, ctx, element};
8054 if (kind == "banner") {
8055 Banner spec{.tone = bindProp<Tone>(ctx, node.prop("tone"), Tone::Info, toneOf)};
8056 if (ExprPtr const spans = node.prop("spans")) {
8057 spec.spans = spansProp(ctx, spans);
8058 } else {
8059 spec.text = kit.textProp("text");
8060 }
8061 spec.action = kit.actionPart();
8062 spec.dismissible = kit.onceBool("dismissible", false);
8063 spec.onDismiss = kit.action("onDismiss");
8064 spec.actionStyle = bannerActionStyleNamed(node.name("actionStyle")).value_or(BannerActionStyle::Ghost);
8065 spec.actionStretch = node.flag("actionStretch");
8066 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8067 return ui::banner(std::move(spec));
8068 }
8069 if (kind == "badge") {
8070 Badge spec{.tone = bindProp<Tone>(ctx, node.prop("tone"), Tone::Neutral, toneOf),
8071 .text = kit.textProp("text")};
8072 spec.icon = kit.onceText("icon");
8073 std::string_view const style = node.name("style");
8074 spec.style = BadgeStyle::Filled;
8075 if (style == "outline") {
8076 spec.style = BadgeStyle::Outline;
8077 } else if (style == "quiet") {
8078 spec.style = BadgeStyle::Quiet;
8079 }
8080 spec.shape = shapeNamed(node.name("shape")).value_or(ControlShape::Default);
8081 spec.mono = node.flag("mono");
8082 if (Commands const* const onRemove = node.event("onRemove")) {
8083 spec.onRemove = [this, ctx, onRemove] { runEvent(onRemove, ctx, Value{}); };
8084 spec.removeLabel = kit.textProp("removeLabel");
8085 }
8086 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8087 return ui::badge(std::move(spec));
8088 }
8089 if (kind == "progress") {
8090 Progress spec;
8091 spec.value = slotProp<std::optional<double>>(
8092 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("value")]() -> std::optional<double> {
8093 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
8094 if (std::int64_t const* const number = value.asInt()) {
8095 return static_cast<double>(*number);
8096 }
8097 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
8098 return realOf(number->value);
8099 }
8100 return std::nullopt;
8101 });
8102 spec.label = kit.textProp("label");
8103 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8104 return ui::progress(std::move(spec));
8105 }
8106 if (kind == "steps") {
8107 Steps spec;
8108 spec.items =
8109 slotProp<std::vector<Step>>([this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("items")] {
8110 std::vector<Step> steps;
8111 Value const items = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
8112 if (ValueList const* const list = items.asList()) {
8113 for (Value const& item : *list) {
8114 Value const* const label = item.field("label");
8115 Value const* const state = item.field("state");
8116 std::string const name = state == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*state, {});
8117 steps.push_back(
8118 Step{.label = label == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*label, session.formatting()),
8119 .state = stepStateOf(name)});
8120 }
8121 }
8122 return steps;
8123 });
8124 spec.current = slotProp<std::optional<std::size_t>>(
8125 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("current")]() -> std::optional<std::size_t> {
8126 std::int64_t const index = intOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr), -1);
8127 return index < 0 ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::size_t>{static_cast<std::size_t>(index)};
8128 });
8129 spec.labelled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("labelled"), true, boolOf);
8130 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8131 return ui::steps(std::move(spec));
8132 }
8133 if (kind == "chart") {
8134 return lowerChart(node, ctx, element);
8135 }
8136 if (kind == "keyValue") {
8137 KeyValue spec;
8138 spec.captions = node.name("fieldLayout") == "stacked" ? CaptionPlacement::Above : CaptionPlacement::Beside;
8139 // The loader has checked `captionWidth` is a literal integer.
8140 if (ExprPtr const width = node.prop("captionWidth")) {
8141 spec.captionWidth = static_cast<int>(*width->literal.asInt());
8142 }
8143 spec.items = slotProp<std::vector<KeyValueItem>>(
8144 [this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("items")] {
8145 std::vector<KeyValueItem> out;
8146 Value const items = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
8147 if (ValueList const* const list = items.asList()) {
8148 for (Value const& item : *list) {
8149 out.push_back(keyValueItemOf(item, expr->path));
8150 }
8151 }
8152 return out;
8153 });
8154 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8155 return ui::keyValue(std::move(spec));
8156 }
8157 if (kind == "emptyState") {
8158 EmptyState spec{.title = kit.textProp("title"), .text = kit.textProp("text")};
8159 spec.icon = kit.onceText("icon");
8160 spec.action = kit.actionPart();
8161 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8162 return ui::emptyState(std::move(spec));
8163 }
8164 return std::nullopt;
8165}

8167inline Node ScreenCore::lowerStack(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8168 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
8169 KindKit const kit{*this, node, ctx, element};
8170 int const gap = static_cast<int>(kit.onceInt("gap", 0));
8171 if (std::string const arrangement = arrangedBy(node.id); !arrangement.empty()) {
8172 return lowerArranged(node, ctx, element, arrangement, kind == "column" ? Axis::Vertical : Axis::Horizontal,
8173 gap);
8174 }
8175 if (kind == "column") {
8176 Column spec{.children = kit.children("children", gap),
8177 .gap = gap,
8178 .align = alignOf(node.name("align")),
8179 .justify = justifyOf(node.name("justify")),
8180 .divided = node.flag("divided"),
8181 .padding = kit.stackPadding()};
8182 if (node.prop("selected")) {
8183 spec.selected = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("selected"), false, boolOf);
8184 }
8185 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8186 return ui::column(std::move(spec));
8187 }
8188 Row spec{.children = kit.children("children"),
8189 .gap = gap,
8190 .align = alignOf(node.name("align")),
8191 .justify = justifyOf(node.name("justify")),
8192 .wrap = node.flag("wrap"),
8193 .divided = node.flag("divided"),
8194 .padding = kit.stackPadding()};
8195 if (node.prop("selected")) {
8196 spec.selected = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("selected"), false, boolOf);
8197 }
8198 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8199 return ui::row(std::move(spec));
8200}

8202inline Node ScreenCore::lowerGrid(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8203 KindKit const kit{*this, node, ctx, element};
8204 Grid spec{.columns = static_cast<int>(kit.onceInt("columns", 1)),
8205 .gap = static_cast<int>(kit.onceInt("gap", 0)),
8206 .align = alignOf(node.name("align")),
8207 .minColumnWidth = static_cast<int>(kit.onceInt("minColumnWidth", 0))};
8208 for (DocNodePtr const& track : node.partList("tracks")) {
8209 ExprPtr const width = track->prop("width");
8210 spec.tracks.push_back(GridTrack{.width = width ? sizingOf(once(ctx, width)) : Sizing::stretch(),
8211 .align = cellPlaceNamed(track->name("align")).value_or(Align::Start)});
8212 }
8213 for (DocNodePtr const& cell : node.nodes("children")) {
8214 ExprPtr const span = cell->prop("span");
8215 spec.cells.push_back(
8216 GridCell{.node = lower(*cell, ctx), .span = static_cast<int>(span ? intOf(once(ctx, span), 1) : 1)});
8217 }
8218 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8219 return ui::grid(std::move(spec));
8220}

8222inline Node ScreenCore::lowerPanel(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8223 KindKit const kit{*this, node, ctx, element};
8224 Panel spec{.title = kit.textProp("title"), .padding = static_cast<int>(kit.onceInt("padding", 0))};
8225 spec.header = kit.child("header");
8226 spec.child = kit.child("children", static_cast<int>(kit.onceInt("gap", kPanelGap)));
8227 spec.collapsible = kit.onceBool("collapsible", false);
8228 spec.collapsed = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("collapsed"), false, boolOf);
8229 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("onToggle")) {
8230 spec.onToggle = [this, ctx, commands](bool collapsed) { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{collapsed}); };
8231 }
8232 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8233 return ui::panel(std::move(spec));
8234}

8236inline Node ScreenCore::lowerSplitter(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8237 KindKit const kit{*this, node, ctx, element};
8238 ExprPtr const orientation = node.prop("orientation");
8239 Splitter spec{.children = kit.children("children"),
8240 .orientation = orientation && axisOf(once(ctx, orientation)) == Axis::Vertical ? Axis::Vertical
8241 : Axis::Horizontal};
8242 // No `onResize`: a user's drag stays the splitter's own, and the document's sizes are where it starts.
8243 if (ExprPtr const sizes = node.prop("sizes")) {
8244 spec.sizes = bindProp<std::vector<int>>(
8245 ctx, sizes, {}, [this, path = sizes->path](Value const& value, FormatContext const& /*format*/) {
8246 std::optional<std::vector<int>> parsed = splitterSizesOf(value);
8247 if (!parsed) {
8248 report(path, "sizes is " + canonicalJson(value) + "; sizes is a list of numbers, one per pane");
8249 }
8250 return std::move(parsed).value_or(std::vector<int>{});
8251 });
8252 }
8253 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8254 // A literal `sizes` that matches the panes places them, so a pane's own width is not used.
8255 if (ExprPtr const sizes = node.prop("sizes"); sizes && sizes->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
8256 std::optional<std::vector<int>> const given = splitterSizesOf(sizes->literal);
8257 if (given && given->size() == spec.children.size()) {
8258 for (std::size_t at = 0; at < spec.children.size(); ++at) {
8259 // A stretch pane asks only to fill, which `sizes` leaves it to do; a fixed or percent pane names a
8260 // size.
8261 Sizing::Kind const kind = layoutHintsOf(spec.children.at(at)).width.kind;
8262 if (spec.orientation == Axis::Horizontal &&
8263 (kind == Sizing::Kind::Fixed || kind == Sizing::Kind::Percent)) {
8264 report(sizes->path, "this splitter's `sizes` places its panes; pane " + std::to_string(at) +
8265 "'s sizing is not used");
8266 }
8267 }
8268 }
8269 }
8270 return ui::splitter(std::move(spec));
8271}
8272
8273inline void ScreenCore::reportActionBarGaps(DocNode const& bar, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
8274 for (DocNodePtr const& child : bar.nodes("children")) {
8275 if (child->kind != "forEach" || child->prop("gap") == nullptr) {
8276 continue;
8277 }
8278 ExprPtr const axis = child->prop("axis");
8279 if (axis != nullptr && axis->kind != ExprKind::Literal && axisOf(once(ctx, axis)) == Axis::Horizontal) {
8280 report(child->path + "/gap", kActionBarGapRefusal);
8281 }
8282 }
8283}

8285inline Node ScreenCore::lowerCollapsible(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {

8287 Collapsible spec{.title = kit.textProp("title"), .open = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("open"), true, boolOf)};
8288 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("onToggle")) {
8289 spec.onToggle = [this, ctx, commands](bool open) { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{open}); };
8290 }
8291 spec.header = kit.child("header");
8292 spec.child = kit.child("children", static_cast<int>(kit.onceInt("gap", kPanelGap)));
8293 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8294 return ui::collapsible(std::move(spec));

8312// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of ui/1.
8313inline Node ScreenCore::lowerKind(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8314 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
8315 KindKit const kit{*this, node, ctx, element};
8316 if (std::optional<Node> widget = lowerWidget(node, ctx, element)) {
8317 return std::move(*widget);
8318 }
8319 if (kind == "group") {
8320 return lowerGroup(node, ctx, element, kit.children("children"));
8321 }
8322 if (kind == "column" || kind == "row") {
8323 return lowerStack(node, ctx, element);
8324 }
8325 if (kind == "grid") {
8326 return lowerGrid(node, ctx, element);
8327 }
8328 if (kind == "spacer") {
8329 Spacer spec;
8330 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8331 return ui::spacer(std::move(spec));
8332 }
8333 if (kind == "panel") {
8334 return lowerPanel(node, ctx, element);
8335 }
8336 if (kind == "scroll") {
8337 ExprPtr const axis = node.prop("axis");
8338 Scroll spec{.child = kit.child("children"), .axis = axis ? axisOf(once(ctx, axis)) : Axis::Vertical};
8339 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8340 return ui::scroll(std::move(spec));
8341 }
8342 if (kind == "switch") {
8343 return lowerSwitch(node, ctx);
8344 }
8345 if (kind == "tabs") {
8346 return lowerTabs(node, ctx, element);
8347 }
8348 if (kind == "dialog" || kind == "drawer") {
8349 return lowerDialog(node, ctx, element);
8350 }
8351 if (kind == "busy") {
8352 Busy spec{.active = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("active"), false, boolOf), .label = kit.textProp("label")};
8353 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8354 return ui::busy(std::move(spec));
8355 }
8356 if (kind == "forEach" || kind == "table") {
8357 return lowerRows(node, ctx, element);
8358 }
8359 if (std::optional<Node> display = lowerDisplay(node, ctx, element)) {
8360 return std::move(*display);
8361 }
8362 if (kind == "splitter") {
8363 return lowerSplitter(node, ctx, element);
8364 }
8365 if (kind == "collapsible") {
8366 return lowerCollapsible(node, ctx, element);
8367 }
8368 if (kind == "dropZone") {
8369 return lowerDropZone(node, ctx, element);
8370 }
8371 if (kind == "actionBar") {
8372 KindKit const bar{*this, node, ctx, element};
8373 ActionBar spec{.children = bar.children("children"),
8374 .align = alignOf(node.name("align")),
8375 .justify = justifyOf(node.name("justify")),
8376 .wrap = node.flag("wrap")};
8377 reportActionBarGaps(node, ctx);
8378 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8379 return ui::actionBar(std::move(spec));
8380 }
8381 if (kind == "boundary") {
8382 return lowerBoundary(node, ctx);
8383 }
8384 if (kind == "custom") {
8385 return lowerCustom(node, ctx);
8386 }
8387 if (kind == "customize") {
8388 return lowerCustomize(node, ctx);
8389 }
8390 if (kind == "form") {
8391 return lowerForm(node, ctx, element);
8392 }
8393 if (kind == "collection" || kind == "wizard") {
8394 return lowerComposite(node, ctx, element);
8395 }
8396 report(node.path, "`" + node.kind + "` is a node kind this interpreter does not lower");
8397 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{node.kind}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
8398}
8399
8400/// @brief A document field overlay's expressions, evaluated once, as the engine's overlay.
8401/// @param scope The scope the form is declared in.
8402/// @param part The `fields` entry.
8403/// @param format How values read as text and numbers.
8404/// @return The overlay.
8405[[nodiscard]] inline forms::FieldOverlay overlayOf(RtScope const& scope, DocNode const& part,
8406 FormatContext const& format) {
8407 auto const read = [&](std::string_view key) -> std::optional<Value> {
8408 ExprPtr const expr = part.prop(key);
8409 if (!expr) {
8410 return std::nullopt;
8411 }
8412 return scope.core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
8413 };
8414 auto const text = [&](std::string_view key) -> std::optional<std::string> {
8415 auto const value = read(key);
8416 return value.has_value() && !value->isNull() ? std::optional<std::string>{textOf(*value, format)}
8417 : std::nullopt;
8418 };
8419 auto const flag = [&](std::string_view key) {
8420 auto const value = read(key);
8421 bool const* const set = value.has_value() ? value->asBool() : nullptr;
8422 return set != nullptr && *set;
8423 };
8424 forms::FieldOverlay overlay{.omit = flag("omit"), .hidden = flag("hidden")};
8425 overlay.label = text("label");
8426 overlay.unit = text("unit");
8427 overlay.widget = text("widget");
8428 if (auto const decimals = read("decimals");
8429 decimals.has_value() && decimals->asInt() != nullptr && *decimals->asInt() >= 0) {
8430 overlay.decimals = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::int64_t>(*decimals->asInt(), 18));
8431 }
8432 if (auto const blankAs = text("blankAs")) {
8433 overlay.blankAs = *blankAs == "empty" ? forms::BlankAs::Empty : forms::BlankAs::Omit;
8434 }
8435 return overlay;
8436}
8437
8438/// @brief A lowering context whose scope is held weakly: what an Effect the scope itself owns may keep, so the scope
8439/// does not keep itself alive.
8440struct DetachedLower {
8441 /// @brief The scope, weakly.
8442 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> scope;
8443 /// @brief The names bound there.
8444 std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
8445 /// @brief The innermost boundary.
8446 std::shared_ptr<BoundaryRuntime> boundary;
8447};
8448
8449/// @brief Detaches a lowering context's scope.
8450/// @param ctx The context.
8451/// @return The context, its scope held weakly.
8452[[nodiscard]] inline DetachedLower detachedLower(LowerCtx const& ctx) {
8453 return DetachedLower{.scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
8454}
8455
8456/// @brief Puts a detached context's scope back.
8457/// @param held The detached context.
8458/// @return The context; its scope is null once the scope is gone.
8459[[nodiscard]] inline LowerCtx attached(DetachedLower const& held) {
8460 return LowerCtx{.scope = held.scope.lock(), .bindings = held.bindings, .boundary = held.boundary};
8461}
8462
8463// Builds the form's session when its element is declared, so its values can be read before the form is drawn.
8464inline void ScreenCore::wireForm(ElementState& element) {
8465 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
8466 RtScope& scope = *element.scope;
8467 std::string const action{node.name("action")};
8468 Catalog const& catalog = session.options().catalog;
8469 std::optional<std::string> const schema = catalog.schema ? catalog.schema(action) : std::nullopt;
8470 if (!schema.has_value()) {
8471 report(node.path, "no schema for `" + action + "`: the catalog has none for a `form` to build from");
8472 return;
8473 }
8474 NameRef const* const alias = scope.find(node.name("model"));
8475 if (alias == nullptr || alias->model == nullptr) {
8476 report(node.path, "`" + std::string{node.name("model")} + "` is not a model alias");
8477 return;
8478 }
8479 forms::FieldOverlays overlays;
8480 // `fields` is one record part holding a `field` part per overlaid member.
8481 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("fields")) {
8482 for (DocNodePtr const& part : record->partList("fields")) {
8483 overlays.insert_or_assign(part->id, overlayOf(scope, *part, session.formatting()));
8484 }
8485 }
8486 auto model = forms::FormModel::fromSchema(action, *schema, overlays);
8487 if (!model) {
8488 report(node.path,
8489 "the form of `" + action + "` does not build: " + model.error().path + ": " + model.error().message);
8490 return;
8491 }
8492 if (node.name("submit") == "explicit") {
8493 model = model->withSubmitMode(forms::SubmitMode::Explicit);
8494 } else if (node.name("submit") == "auto") {
8495 model = model->withSubmitMode(forms::SubmitMode::Automatic);
8496 }
8497 element.form = std::make_unique<forms::FormSession>(runtime(), *std::move(model), aliasSubmits(alias->model),
8498 aliasCalls(alias->model), engineOptions());
8499 if (ExprPtr const prefill = node.prop("prefill")) {
8500 // A prefill follows its expression. A value of the record being edited (the first value, or one under the
8501 // same `key`) keeps the fields the user changed; another record, a new `key`, or any later value of a form
8502 // without one, loads every field.
8503 forms::FormSession* const form = element.form.get();
8504 struct Followed {
8505 bool loaded = false;
8506 Value key;
8507 };
8508 auto const followed = std::make_shared<Followed>();
8509 scope.nodes.effect([this, &scope, prefill, key = node.prop("key"), form, followed] {
8510 Value const value = evalIn(scope, nullptr, prefill);
8511 if (value.isNull()) {
8512 return;
8513 }
8514 runtime().untracked([&] {
8515 Value const current = key ? evalIn(scope, nullptr, key) : Value{};
8516 bool const same = !followed->loaded || (key && current == followed->key);
8517 followed->loaded = true;
8518 followed->key = current;
8519 std::string const json = glz::write_json(valueToJson(value)).value_or(std::string{});
8520 if (same) {
8521 form->refill(json);
8522 } else {
8523 form->prefill(json);
8524 }
8525 });
8526 });
8527 }
8528}
8529
8530inline Node ScreenCore::lowerForm(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8531 forms::FormSession* const form = element == nullptr ? nullptr : element->form.get();
8532 if (form == nullptr) {
8533 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{node.name("action")}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
8534 }
8535 // The form's events, each run once per change of the count it watches.
8536 auto const watch = [this, &ctx](Commands const* commands, auto count, auto payload) {
8537 if (commands == nullptr || commands->empty()) {
8538 return;
8539 }
8540 auto const seen = std::make_shared<std::uint64_t>(runtime().untracked(count));
8541 ctx.scope->nodes.effect([this, held = detachedLower(ctx), commands, count, payload, seen] {
8542 std::uint64_t const now = count();
8543 if (now == *seen) {
8544 return;
8545 }
8546 *seen = now;
8547 runtime().untracked([&] { runEvent(commands, attached(held), payload()); });
8548 });
8549 };
8550 watch(
8551 node.event("onSubmit"), [form] { return form->submitAttempts(); },
8552 [form] {
8553 std::optional<std::string> const body = form->body();
8554 return body.has_value() ? jsonTextValue(*body) : Value{};
8555 });
8556 watch(
8557 node.event("onSuccess"), [form] { return form->successCount(); },
8558 [form] {
8559 std::optional<std::string> const& reply = form->lastReply();
8560 return reply.has_value() ? jsonTextValue(*reply) : Value{};
8561 });
8562 if (Commands const* const onError = node.event("onError"); onError != nullptr && !onError->empty()) {
8563 // Each failure is a new exception: run once per failure, with its text.
8564 auto const seen =
8565 std::make_shared<std::exception_ptr>(runtime().untracked([form] { return form->lastError(); }));
8566 ctx.scope->nodes.effect([this, held = detachedLower(ctx), onError, form, seen] {
8567 std::exception_ptr const error = form->lastError();
8568 if (error == nullptr || error == *seen) {
8569 return;
8570 }
8571 *seen = error;
8572 runtime().untracked([&] { runEvent(onError, attached(held), Value{failureText(error)}); });
8573 });
8574 }
8575 forms::FormViewOptions options{.showTitle = false};
8576 presentForm(node, ctx, options);
8577 options.title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf);
8578 // A field whose overlay names a component is drawn by it; only top-level fields take one, as every overlay.
8579 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("fields")) {
8580 for (DocNodePtr const& overlay : record->partList("fields")) {
8581 if (!overlay->name("component").empty()) {
8582 options.overrides.byField(overlay->id,
8583 [this, ctx, field = overlay.get()](forms::FieldView const& view) {
8584 return fieldComponent(view, *field, ctx);
8585 });
8586 }
8587 }
8588 }
8589 Column column{.children = {forms::formView(*form, std::move(options))}};
8590 commonOf(node, ctx, element, column.common);
8591 return ui::column(std::move(column));
8592}
8593
8594/// @brief A component's `change` payload as the wire value of the field it draws, read as the `value` prop's
8595/// declared type.
8596/// @param payload The payload, as the backend reports it.
8597/// @param type The `value` prop's type.
8598/// @return The wire value, or why the payload is not one.
8599[[nodiscard]] inline std::expected<forms::detail::engine::Json, std::string> changeWire(std::string const& payload,
8600 std::string_view type) {
8601 std::string_view text{payload};
8602 if (type == "string") {
8603 if (text.starts_with("s:")) {
8604 text.remove_prefix(2);
8605 }
8606 // Parentheses: braces would pick the initializer-list constructor and make a one-element array.
8607 return forms::detail::engine::Json(std::string{text});
8608 }
8609 if (text.starts_with("i:")) {
8610 text.remove_prefix(2);
8611 }
8612 std::optional<forms::detail::engine::Json> json = forms::detail::engine::parseJson(text);
8613 if (!json) {
8614 return std::unexpected(std::string{"it is not JSON"});
8615 }
8616 bool const fits = type == "json" || json->is_null() || (type == "bool" && json->is_boolean()) ||
8617 ((type == "int" || type == "number") && json->is_number()) ||
8618 (type == "exact" && (json->is_number() || json->is_string()));
8619 if (!fits) {
8620 bool const vowel = type == "int" || type == "exact";
8621 return std::unexpected("it is not " + std::string{vowel ? "an " : "a "} + std::string{type});
8622 }
8623 return *std::move(json);
8624}
8625
8626/// @brief What a form fills of a field component's props: the field's value, errors, read-only and required state,
8627/// and label, each a tracked read of the field.
8628/// @param prop The prop's name.
8629/// @param state The field.
8630/// @return The read, or empty for a prop the form does not fill.
8631[[nodiscard]] inline std::function<Value()> formFilled(std::string const& prop, forms::FieldState* state) {
8632 if (prop == "value") {
8633 return [state] {
8634 forms::Encoding const& encoding = state->encoded().get();
8635 if (!encoding.has_value() || !encoding->has_value()) {
8636 return Value{};
8637 }
8638 return (*encoding)->value.isNull() ? jsonTextValue((*encoding)->json) : (*encoding)->value;
8639 };
8640 }
8641 if (prop == "errors") {
8642 return [state] {
8643 std::optional<forms::FieldError> const& error = state->error().get();
8644 return error.has_value() ? Value{ValueList{Value{error->message}}} : Value{ValueList{}};
8645 };
8646 }
8647 if (prop == "readonly") {
8648 return [state] { return Value{state->readonly().get()}; };
8649 }
8650 if (prop == "required") {
8651 return [state] { return Value{state->required().get()}; };
8652 }
8653 if (prop == "label") {
8654 return [state] { return Value{state->label()}; };
8655 }
8656 return {};
8657}
8658
8659// NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): a prop's name, then its declared type.
8660inline CustomProp ScreenCore::componentProp(std::string const& prop, std::string const& type,
8661 std::function<Value()> read) {
8662 if (type == "bool") {
8663 return CustomProp{.name = prop, .value = slotProp<bool>([this, read = std::move(read)] {
8664 return boolOf(read(), session.formatting());
8665 })};
8666 }
8667 if (type == "number") {
8668 return CustomProp{.name = prop,
8669 .value = slotProp<double>([read = std::move(read)] { return componentNumber(read()); })};
8670 }
8671 return CustomProp{.name = prop, .value = slotProp<std::string>([this, read = std::move(read), type] {
8672 return componentText(read(), type, session.formatting());
8673 })};
8674}
8675
8676inline void ScreenCore::changeField(forms::FieldState& state, forms::FieldSpec const& spec, std::string const& path,
8677 std::string_view valueType, std::string const& payload) {
8678 auto wire = changeWire(payload, valueType);
8679 // A base64 member holds a file's bytes, which a document moves inline only under the session's cap.
8680 if (std::size_t const cap = session.options().maxInlineFileBytes;
8681 wire && spec.bytes && wire->is_string() && base64Size(wire->get_string()) > cap) {
8682 report(path, "field " + spec.name + ": " + std::to_string(base64Size(wire->get_string())) +
8683 " bytes is over the " + std::to_string(cap) + " inline cap");
8684 return;
8685 }
8686 if (wire) {
8687 if (auto edited = state.edit(*wire); !edited) {
8688 wire = std::unexpected(edited.error());
8689 }
8690 }
8691 if (!wire) {
8692 report(path, "field " + spec.name + ": the component's change does not decode: " + wire.error());
8693 }
8694}
8695
8696inline Node ScreenCore::fieldComponent(forms::FieldView const& view, DocNode const& overlay, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
8697 std::string const name{overlay.name("component")};
8698 // A loaded document's field component is declared, with a `value` prop and a `change` event.
8699 Component const& component = _doc->components.at(name);
8700 forms::FieldState* const state = &view.state();
8701 Custom spec{.name = name,
8702 .fallback = view.defaultControl(),
8703 .props = {},
8704 .minVersion =
8705 static_cast<int>(std::clamp<std::int64_t>(component.version, 0, std::numeric_limits<int>::max())),
8706 .onEvent = {}};
8707 for (auto const& [prop, type] : component.props) {
8708 if (prop == "value" && type == "json") {
8709 // The wire JSON itself, so an object's or a collection's every digit reaches the component.
8710 spec.props.push_back(CustomProp{.name = prop, .value = slotProp<std::string>([state] {
8711 forms::Encoding const& encoding = state->encoded().get();
8712 return encoding.has_value() && encoding->has_value()
8713 ? (*encoding)->json
8714 : std::string{"null"};
8715 })});
8716 continue;
8717 }
8718 std::function<Value()> read = formFilled(prop, state);
8719 if (!read) {
8720 ExprPtr given;
8721 for (DocNodePtr const& record : overlay.partList("props")) {
8722 if (ExprPtr const expr = record->prop(prop)) {
8723 given = expr;
8724 }
8725 }
8726 read = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, given] {
8727 return given ? evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), given) : Value{};
8728 };
8729 }
8730 spec.props.push_back(componentProp(prop, type, std::move(read)));
8731 }
8732 spec.onEvent = [this, state, path = overlay.path, fieldSpec = &view.spec(),
8733 valueType = component.props.at("value")](std::string const& event, std::string const& payload) {
8734 if (event == "change") {
8735 changeField(*state, *fieldSpec, path, valueType, payload);
8736 }
8737 };
8738 return ui::custom(std::move(spec));
8739}
