8741// Every call goes through the alias's channel, bound for its current instance when the call is made.
8742inline forms::Submitter ScreenCore::aliasCalls(ModelAlias* alias) {
8743 return [this, alias](std::string_view actionId, std::string const& body) -> async::Completion<std::string> {
8744 std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const channel = channelOf(*alias, *this);
8745 if (channel == nullptr) {
8746 auto [failed, promise] = async::Completion<std::string>::makeSettleable(&runtime().owner());
8747 promise.reject(std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error{"the node's model alias is not bound"}));
8748 return std::move(failed);
8749 }
8750 return channel->execute(std::string{actionId}, body, CallOptions{});
8751 };
8752}
8753
8754// The calls of a form, collection or wizard: a success other than of @p read, the collection's own query, tells the
8755// session, which applies the action's effects, as a mutation's success does.
8756inline forms::Submitter ScreenCore::aliasSubmits(ModelAlias* alias, std::string read) {
8757 return [this, alias, call = aliasCalls(alias), read = std::move(read)](
8758 std::string_view actionId, std::string body) -> async::Completion<std::string> {
8759 async::Completion<std::string> completion = call(actionId, std::move(body));
8760 if (actionId != read) {
8761 completion.then([this, alive = std::weak_ptr<bool>{_alive}, alias, typeId = alias->decl->type,
8762 action = std::string{actionId}](std::string const& reply) {
8763 if (alive.expired()) {
8764 return;
8765 }
8766 auto json = parseJson(reply);
8767 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
8768 std::string const token = runtime().untracked([&] { return alias->token->get(); });
8769 session.actionSucceeded(typeId, action, value ? *value : Value{}, ReplyUse::Applied, token);
8770 });
8771 }
8772 return completion;
8773 };
8774}

8776// The session's locale, translations and display zone, as every form the engine builds here reads them.
8777inline forms::FormSessionOptions ScreenCore::engineOptions() const {
8778 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
8779 forms::FormSessionOptions options{};
8780 options.locale = format.numeric;
8781 options.bcp47 = format.locale;
8782 options.translations = format.translations;
8783 options.displayOffsetMinutes = format.utcOffsetMinutes;
8784 return options;
8785}
8786
8787// Builds a collection's or wizard's session when its element is declared. The node's `action` is the collection's
8788// query or the wizard's first step; the catalog answers the document for it, and every call (the query, the actions,
8789// every step's submission) goes through the node's model alias.
8790inline void ScreenCore::wireComposite(ElementState& element) {
8791 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
8792 RtScope const& scope = *element.scope;
8793 bool const collection = node.kind == "collection";
8794 std::string const action{node.name("action")};
8795 Catalog const& catalog = session.options().catalog;
8796 auto const& lookup = collection ? catalog.view : catalog.wizard;
8797 std::optional<std::string> const document = lookup ? lookup(action) : std::nullopt;
8798 if (!document.has_value()) {
8799 report(node.path, std::string{"no "} + (collection ? "view" : "wizard") + " document for `" + action +
8800 "`: the catalog has none for a `" + node.kind + "` to build from");
8801 return;
8802 }
8803 NameRef const* const alias = scope.find(node.name("model"));
8804 if (alias == nullptr || alias->model == nullptr) {
8805 report(node.path, "`" + std::string{node.name("model")} + "` is not a model alias");
8806 return;
8807 }
8808 forms::SchemaLookup const schemas = catalog.schema ? forms::SchemaLookup{catalog.schema} : forms::SchemaLookup{};
8809 forms::Submitter const call = aliasCalls(alias->model);
8810 if (collection) {
8811 auto model = forms::CollectionModel::fromSchema(*document);
8812 if (!model) {
8813 report(node.path, "the collection of `" + action + "` does not build: " + model.error().path + ": " +
8814 model.error().message);
8815 return;
8816 }
8817 if (model->query() != action) {
8818 report(node.path, "the view document of `" + action + "` lists `" + std::string{model->query()} + "`");
8819 return;
8820 }
8821 std::string query{model->query()};
8822 element.collection = std::make_unique<forms::CollectionSession>(runtime(), *std::move(model), schemas,
8823 aliasSubmits(alias->model, std::move(query)),
8824 call, engineOptions());
8825 return;
8826 }
8827 // The wizard's id, the stem of its translation keys, is the action it starts with.
8828 auto model = forms::WizardModel::fromSchema(action, *document);
8829 if (!model) {
8830 report(node.path,
8831 "the wizard of `" + action + "` does not build: " + model.error().path + ": " + model.error().message);
8832 return;
8833 }
8834 if (model->steps().front().action != action) {
8835 report(node.path,
8836 "the wizard document of `" + action + "` starts with `" + model->steps().front().action + "`");
8837 return;
8838 }
8839 try {
8840 element.wizard = std::make_unique<forms::WizardSession>(runtime(), *std::move(model), schemas,
8841 aliasSubmits(alias->model), call, engineOptions());
8842 } catch (std::invalid_argument const& error) {
8843 report(node.path, error.what());
8844 }
8845}
8846
8847// The presentation keys a form, a collection and a wizard share, but the title: the label of the explicit-mode button
8848// and the status line naming it, bound in the node's scope; whether the status line shows, the grid's columns and the
8849// field layout and the inline caption column's width, as read at load.
8850inline void ScreenCore::presentForm(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, forms::FormViewOptions& options) {
8851 if (ExprPtr const label = node.prop("submitLabel")) {
8852 options.submitLabel = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, label, std::string{}, stringOf);
8853 }
8854 if (auto const shown = node.flags.find("showStatus"); shown != node.flags.end()) {
8855 options.showStatus = shown->second;
8856 }
8857 if (ExprPtr const columns = node.prop("columns"); columns != nullptr && columns->literal.asInt() != nullptr) {
8858 options.gridColumns = static_cast<int>(*columns->literal.asInt());
8859 options.flatGridColumns = options.gridColumns;
8860 }
8861 if (node.name("fieldLayout") == "inline") {
8862 options.fieldLayout = forms::FieldLayout::Inline;
8863 }
8864 // The loader has checked `captionWidth` is a literal integer.
8865 if (ExprPtr const width = node.prop("captionWidth")) {
8866 options.inlineLabelWidth = static_cast<int>(*width->literal.asInt());
8867 }
8868}
8869
8870inline Node ScreenCore::lowerComposite(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8871 // The editor's and the steps' titles are the dialog's and the header's; the forms do not repeat them. A `title`
8872 // replaces the view's own heading.
8873 forms::FormViewOptions form{};
8874 form.showTitle = false;
8875 presentForm(node, ctx, form);
8876 Prop<std::string> title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf);
8877 Node view;
8878 if (element != nullptr && element->collection != nullptr) {
8879 forms::CollectionViewOptions options{};
8880 options.form = std::move(form);
8881 options.title = std::move(title);
8882 view = forms::collectionView(*element->collection, std::move(options));
8883 } else if (element != nullptr && element->wizard != nullptr) {
8884 forms::WizardViewOptions options{};
8885 options.form = std::move(form);
8886 options.title = std::move(title);
8887 view = forms::wizardView(*element->wizard, options);
8888 } else {
8889 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{node.name("action")}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
8890 }
8891 Column column{.children = {std::move(view)}};
8892 commonOf(node, ctx, element, column.common);
8893 return ui::column(std::move(column));
8894}
8895
8896// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): an overlay's scope, content, actions and keys are one lowering.
8897// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): an overlay's scope, content, actions and keys are one lowering.
8898inline Node ScreenCore::lowerDialog(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
8899 Prop<bool> open = node.prop("open") ? bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("open"), false, boolOf)
8900 : slotProp<bool>([element] { return element->open.get(); });
8901 std::vector<DocNode const*> bodyContent;
8902 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
8903 bodyContent.push_back(child.get());
8904 }
8905 int const bodyGap =
8906 node.prop("gap") ? static_cast<int>(intOf(once(ctx, node.prop("gap")), kDialogGap)) : kDialogGap;
8907 LayoutHints const bodyHints = holderHints(bodyContent, node.scope ? &*node.scope : nullptr, ctx);
8908 Node body = lazy(
8909 [this, ctx, &node, element, bodyGap]() -> Node {
8910 auto inner = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
8911 inner->owner = element;
8912 addPending(1);
8913 inner->submitted = &element->submitted;
8914 inner->showErrors = std::string{node.name("showErrors")};
8915 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
8916 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
8917 content.push_back(child.get());
8918 }
8919 std::vector<Commands const*> lists;
8920 for (std::string_view const key : {"default", "cancel"}) {
8921 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event(key)) {
8922 lists.push_back(commands);
8923 }
8924 }
8925 for (DocNodePtr const& action : node.partList("actions")) {
8926 if (Commands const* const commands = action->event("onClick")) {
8927 lists.push_back(commands);
8928 }
8929 }
8930 declare(*inner, node.scope ? &*node.scope : nullptr, content, lists);
8931 element->inner.set(inner.get());
8932 LowerCtx const innerCtx{
8933 .scope = inner, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary, .listGap = bodyGap};
8934 std::vector<Node> children;
8935 children.reserve(content.size());
8936 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
8937 children.push_back(lower(*child, innerCtx));
8938 }
8939 // The overlay's actions end its scoped content, so they bind in its scope; the mount puts them in its
8940 // footer.
8941 if (ActionModels actions = lowerActionParts(node.partList("actions"), innerCtx); !actions.empty()) {
8942 children.push_back(actionBarOf(std::move(actions)));
8943 }
8944 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys;
8945 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("default")) {
8946 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{.chord = "Enter", .onPress = [this, innerCtx, commands] {
8947 runEvent(commands, innerCtx, Value{});
8948 }});
8949 }
8950 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("cancel")) {
8951 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{
8952 .chord = "Esc", .onPress = [this, innerCtx, commands] { runEvent(commands, innerCtx, Value{}); }});
8953 }
8954 fillHolder(children, node.path);
8955 return holding(std::move(children), inner, std::move(keys), bodyGap);
8956 },
8957 bodyHints);
8958 Action onDismiss = [this, ctx, element, commands = node.event("onDismiss")] {
8959 session.asUser([&] {
8960 session.noteWrite();
8961 element->open.set(false);
8962 });
8963 runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{});
8964 };
8965 if (node.kind == "drawer") {
8966 ExprPtr const side = node.prop("side");
8967 Drawer spec{
8968 .open = std::move(open),
8969 .title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf),
8970 .description = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("description"), std::string{}, stringOf),
8971 .child = std::move(body),
8972 .onDismiss = std::move(onDismiss),
8973 .side = side && textOf(once(ctx, side), session.formatting()) == "start" ? Side::Start : Side::End};
8974 if (ExprPtr const spans = node.prop("descriptionSpans")) {
8975 spec.descriptionSpans = spansProp(ctx, spans);
8976 }
8977 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8978 return ui::drawer(std::move(spec));
8979 }
8980 Dialog spec{.open = std::move(open),
8981 .title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf),
8982 .description = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("description"), std::string{}, stringOf),
8983 .child = std::move(body),
8984 .onDismiss = std::move(onDismiss),
8985 .common = {},
8986 .sheet = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("sheet"), false, boolOf),
8987 .dismissLabel = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("dismissLabel"), std::string{"Close"}, stringOf)};
8988 if (ExprPtr const spans = node.prop("descriptionSpans")) {
8989 spec.descriptionSpans = spansProp(ctx, spans);
8990 }
8991 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
8992 return ui::dialog(std::move(spec));
8993}
8994
8995inline Node ScreenCore::lowerSwitch(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
8996 std::vector<ExprPtr> whens;
8997 Switch spec;
8998 std::int64_t index = 0;
8999 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("cases")) {
9000 whens.push_back(part->prop("when"));
9001 DocNode const* const casePart = part.get();
9002 std::vector<DocNode const*> caseContent;
9003 for (DocNodePtr const& child : casePart->nodes("children")) {
9004 caseContent.push_back(child.get());
9005 }
9006 LayoutHints const caseHints = holderHints(caseContent, casePart->scope ? &*casePart->scope : nullptr, ctx);
9007 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{
9008 .key = Key{index++},
9009 .node = lazy(
9010 [this, ctx, casePart, caseGap = ctx.listGap]() -> Node {
9011 auto inner = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
9012 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
9013 for (DocNodePtr const& child : casePart->nodes("children")) {
9014 content.push_back(child.get());
9015 }
9016 declare(*inner, casePart->scope ? &*casePart->scope : nullptr, content, {});
9017 LowerCtx const innerCtx{
9018 .scope = inner, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary, .listGap = caseGap};
9019 std::vector<Node> children;
9020 children.reserve(content.size());
9021 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
9022 children.push_back(lower(*child, innerCtx));
9023 }
9024 fillHolder(children, casePart->path);
9025 return holding(std::move(children), inner, {}, caseGap);
9026 },
9027 caseHints)});
9028 }
9029 spec.selector = slotProp<Key>(
9030 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, selected = node.prop("on"), whens = std::move(whens)] {
9031 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), selected);
9032 for (std::size_t at = 0; at < whens.size(); ++at) {
9033 if (evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), whens.at(at)) == value) {
9034 return Key{static_cast<std::int64_t>(at)};
9035 }
9036 }
9037 return Key{std::int64_t{-1}};
9038 });
9039 auto const fallback = node.nodes("default");
9040 spec.fallback = fallback.empty() ? Node{} : lowerAll(fallback, ctx, ctx.listGap);
9041 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, spec.common);
9042 return ui::switchOf(std::move(spec));
9043}
9044
9045// The tab a bound `selected` names. A value that names no tab shows the first, and is reported once.
9046inline Prop<std::size_t> ScreenCore::controlledTabSelection(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx,
9047 ExprPtr const& selected,
9048 std::shared_ptr<std::vector<std::string>> const& ids) {
9049 auto const unknownReported = std::make_shared<bool>(false);
9050 return Prop<std::size_t>{[this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, selected, ids, unknownReported,
9051 path = pointerAppend(node.path, "selected")]() -> std::size_t {
9052 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), selected);
9053 std::string const* const named = value.asString();
9054 auto const found = named == nullptr ? ids->end() : std::ranges::find(*ids, *named);
9055 if (found != ids->end()) {
9056 return static_cast<std::size_t>(std::distance(ids->begin(), found));
9057 }
9058 if (!*unknownReported) {
9059 *unknownReported = true;
9060 report(path, canonicalJson(value) + " names no tab; the first is shown");
9061 }
9062 return 0;
9063 }};
9064}
9065
9066// A document names tabs by id; the view tree by index, so the ids map to indices once. A bound `selected` is the
9067// controlled index: a pick runs `onChoose` and the page follows `selected` alone. Without it the node keeps the
9068// user's pick itself, as a bound index too, whose page follows the pick: a constant would move only the highlight.
9069inline Node ScreenCore::lowerTabs(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
9070 Tabs spec;
9071 auto ids = std::make_shared<std::vector<std::string>>();
9072 for (DocNodePtr const& tab : node.partList("tabs")) {
9073 auto const nodes = tab->nodes("children");
9074 ids->push_back(tab->id);
9075 spec.tabs.push_back(Tab{.label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, tab->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf),
9076 .node = nodes.empty() ? Node{} : lowerAll(nodes, ctx)});
9077 }
9078 spec.moreLabel = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("moreLabel"), std::string{"More"}, stringOf);
9079 if (ExprPtr const inset = node.prop("inset")) {
9080 spec.inset = static_cast<int>(intOf(once(ctx, inset), 0));
9081 }
9082 if (ExprPtr const pageInset = node.prop("pageInset")) {
9083 spec.pageInset = static_cast<int>(intOf(once(ctx, pageInset), 0));
9084 }
9085 spec.stripSurface = std::string{node.name("stripSurface")};
9086 ExprPtr const selected = node.prop("selected");
9087 Commands const* const onChoose = node.event("onChoose");
9088 bool const controlled = selected && (selected->kind != ExprKind::Literal || !selected->literal.isNull());
9089 auto const picked = std::make_shared<reactive::Signal<std::size_t>>(runtime(), std::size_t{0});
9090 spec.selected = controlled ? controlledTabSelection(node, ctx, selected, ids)
9091 : Prop<std::size_t>{[picked] { return picked->get(); }};
9092 spec.onSelect = [this, ctx, onChoose, ids, picked, controlled, element](std::size_t index) {
9093 if (!controlled) {
9094 picked->set(index);
9095 if (element != nullptr && index < ids->size()) {
9096 element->draft.set(Value{ids->at(index)});
9097 }
9098 }
9099 if (onChoose != nullptr && index < ids->size()) {
9100 runEvent(onChoose, ctx, Value{ids->at(index)});
9101 }
9102 };
9103 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
9104 return ui::tabs(std::move(spec));
9105}
9106
9107// Focuses the declaration the command's target resolved to: of several candidates (cases of one switch), the one
9108// that is mounted. Each candidate is keyed by the command's own enclosing row keys, as many as enclose the
9109// candidate; with `row`, the innermost of them is the row's key instead.
9110inline bool ScreenCore::focusTarget(Command const& command, RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings) {
9111 if (!focusElement) {
9112 return false;
9113 }
9114 auto const found = _doc->focusTargets.find(command.path);
9115 if (found == _doc->focusTargets.end()) {
9116 return focusElement(command.target);
9117 }
9118 FocusPlace const place = focusPlace(scope);
9119 std::optional<std::string> row;
9120 if (found->second.row) {
9121 Value const value = evalIn(scope, bindings, command.extra);
9122 if (value.isNull()) {
9123 return false;
9124 }
9125 row = canonicalJson(valueOfKey(keyOf(value)));
9126 }
9127 for (FocusCandidate const& candidate : found->second.candidates) {
9128 std::size_t const kept = row ? candidate.rows - 1 : candidate.rows;
9129 if (candidate.rows == 0 && row) {
9130 continue;
9131 }
9132 if (kept > place.rows.size()) {
9133 continue;
9134 }
9135 FocusPlace candidatePlace{
9136 .prefix = place.prefix,
9137 .rows = {place.rows.begin(), std::next(place.rows.begin(), static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(kept))}};
9138 if (row) {
9139 candidatePlace.rows.push_back(*row);
9140 }
9141 if (focusElement(focusKey(candidatePlace, candidate.path))) {
9142 return true;
9143 }
9144 }
9145 return false;
9146}
9147
9148inline std::shared_ptr<RtScope> ScreenCore::rowScope(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx,
9149 reactive::Signal<Value> const& row,
9150 std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content, std::string key) {
9151 auto scope = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, &row, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
9152 scope->rowKey = std::move(key);
9153 declare(*scope, node.scope ? &*node.scope : nullptr, content, {});
9154 return scope;
9155}
9156
9157// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a list of rows and a table.
9158inline Node ScreenCore::lowerRows(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
9159 ExprPtr const rowsExpr = node.prop("rows");
9160 if (!rowsExpr) {
9161 report(node.path, "a model-backed `table` needs the table engine, which this interpreter does not lower yet");
9162 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{"table"}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
9163 }
9164 std::function<std::vector<Value>()> rows = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, rowsExpr] {
9165 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), rowsExpr);
9166 ValueList const* const items = value.asList();
9167 return items == nullptr ? std::vector<Value>{} : std::vector<Value>{items->begin(), items->end()};
9168 };
9169 auto keyFn = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, keyExpr = node.prop("key")](Value const& row) -> Key {
9170 if (Value const* const heading = row.field(kGroupHeadingField); heading != nullptr && heading->asString()) {
9171 return Key{*heading->asString()};
9172 }
9173 if (!keyExpr) {
9174 Value const rowKey = rowId(row);
9175 return keyOf(rowKey.isNull() ? row : rowKey);
9176 }
9177 ScopeEnv const env{*scope, bindings.get(), &row};
9178 return keyOf(evaluate(*keyExpr, env));
9179 };
9180 if (node.kind == "forEach") {
9181 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
9182 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
9183 content.push_back(child.get());
9184 }
9185 auto rowView = [this, ctx, &node, content, keyFn](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) -> Node {
9186 std::string key = runtime().untracked([&] { return canonicalJson(valueOfKey(keyFn(row.peek()))); });
9187 auto scope = rowScope(node, ctx, row, content, std::move(key));
9188 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
9189 std::vector<Node> children;
9190 children.reserve(content.size());
9191 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
9192 children.push_back(lower(*child, rowCtx));
9193 }
9194 return holding(std::move(children), scope);
9195 };
9196 ExprPtr const axis = node.prop("axis");
9197 ExprPtr const gap = node.prop("gap");
9198 Common common;
9199 commonOf(node, ctx, element, common);
9200 Axis const along = axis ? axisOf(once(ctx, axis)) : Axis::Vertical;
9201 bool wrap = node.flag("wrap");
9202 if (wrap && along != Axis::Horizontal) {
9203 // Only a computed axis gets here: the loader refuses a literal one that is not horizontal.
9204 report(node.path + "/wrap",
9205 "`wrap` fills lines along a row; this `forEach`'s `axis` is not \"horizontal\"");
9206 wrap = false;
9207 }
9208 bool divided = node.flag("divided");
9209 if (divided && along != Axis::Vertical) {
9210 report(node.path + "/divided",
9211 "`divided` draws rules between rows of a column; this `forEach`'s `axis` is \"horizontal\"");
9212 divided = false;
9213 }
9214 return ui::forEach<Value>(std::move(rows), std::move(keyFn), std::move(rowView), along,
9215 gap ? static_cast<int>(intOf(once(ctx, gap), 0)) : 0, common, wrap, divided);
9216 }
9217 // The table's rows, sorted: the element's own view, which its element values read too, unless names bound
9218 // where the table is lowered (a component's `props`) reach its rows, which the element cannot see.
9219 reactive::Computed<TableView> const* view = element == nullptr ? nullptr : element->view;
9220 if (view != nullptr && ctx.bindings != nullptr && !ctx.bindings->empty()) {
9221 view = &ctx.scope->nodes.computed(
9222 [this, element, bindings = ctx.bindings] { return tableView(*element, bindings.get()); });
9223 }
9224 if (view != nullptr) {
9225 // The page's rows, each group's heading entry before the first of its rows the page holds, so a group split
9226 // across pages gets its heading on both.
9227 rows = [view] {
9228 TableView const& shown = view->get();
9229 std::vector<Value> entries;
9230 entries.reserve(shown.last - shown.first);
9231 for (std::size_t index = shown.first; index < shown.last; ++index) {
9232 if (!shown.runOf.empty() &&
9233 (index == shown.first || shown.runOf.at(index) != shown.runOf.at(index - 1))) {
9234 entries.push_back(shown.runs.at(shown.runOf.at(index)));
9235 }
9236 entries.push_back(shown.rows.at(index));
9237 }
9238 return entries;
9239 };
9240 }
9241 std::vector<TableColumn> columns;
9242 std::vector<DocNode const*> cells;
9243 std::vector<std::string> fields;
9244 // One entry per column, in the same order as `cells`/`fields`. Captured by `cellsOf` below (not `columns`
9245 // itself, which is moved into `ui::table<Value>(...)` further down and so cannot be read from inside a lambda
9246 // that outlives this function) so the default-cell closure can apply each column's role to its generated cell.
9247 std::vector<TextRole> roles;
9248 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
9249 // The table's `valign` is the default of every column that gives none; the loader checked both names.
9250 Align const tableValign = cellPlaceNamed(node.name("valign")).value_or(Align::Center);
9251 if (ExprPtr const derived = node.prop("columns")) {
9252 Value const list = once(ctx, derived);
9253 // A computed place that names none is reported once for the table, whichever column and key it was.
9254 bool placeReported = false;
9255 auto const placeOf = [&](Value const& item, std::string_view key, Align fallback) {
9256 Value const* const given = item.field(key);
9257 if (given == nullptr || given->isNull()) {
9258 return fallback;
9259 }
9260 std::string const* const name = given->asString();
9261 std::optional<Align> const placed = name == nullptr ? std::nullopt : cellPlaceNamed(*name);
9262 if (!placed && !placeReported) {
9263 placeReported = true;
9264 report(derived->path, "a column's `" + std::string{key} + "` is " + canonicalJson(*given) +
9265 "; a cell's place is start, center or end");
9266 }
9267 return placed.value_or(fallback);
9268 };
9269 if (ValueList const* const items = list.asList()) {
9270 for (Value const& item : *items) {
9271 Value const* const field = item.field("id");
9272 Value const* const label = item.field("label");
9273 fields.push_back(field == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*field, format));
9274 columns.push_back(
9275 TableColumn{.label = textOf(label != nullptr ? *label : Value{fields.back()}, format),
9276 .align = placeOf(item, "align", Align::Start),
9277 .valign = placeOf(item, "valign", tableValign)});
9278 cells.push_back(nullptr);
9279 roles.push_back(TextRole::Normal);
9280 }
9281 }
9282 }
9283 // A part's column index, which a header click reports, counts the derived columns before it.
9284 std::size_t const derivedCount = columns.size();
9285 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("columns")) {
9286 ExprPtr const label = part->prop("label");
9287 ExprPtr const width = part->prop("width");
9288 ExprPtr const role = part->prop("role");
9289 TextRole columnRole = TextRole::Normal;
9290 if (role) {
9291 // Read once, with the rest of the column; a value that names no role is reported, as a text's is.
9292 Value const value = once(ctx, role);
9293 std::optional<TextRole> const named = roleNamed(textOf(value, format));
9294 if (!named) {
9295 report(role->path, "role is " + canonicalJson(value) + "; " + std::string{kRoleNames});
9296 }
9297 columnRole = named.value_or(TextRole::Normal);
9298 }
9299 bool const shrink = part->flag("shrink");
9300 Sizing const sized = width ? sizingOf(once(ctx, width)) : Sizing::content();
9301 if (shrink && sized.kind != Sizing::Kind::Stretch) {
9302 report(part->path + "/shrink",
9303 "`shrink` lets a stretch column go narrower than its header; this column's width does not stretch");
9304 }
9305 columns.push_back(TableColumn{.label = label ? textOf(once(ctx, label), format) : std::string{},
9306 .width = sized,
9307 .role = columnRole,
9308 .align = cellPlaceNamed(part->name("align")).value_or(Align::Start),
9309 .valign = cellPlaceNamed(part->name("valign")).value_or(tableValign),
9310 .sortable = part->flag("sortable"),
9311 .wrap = part->flag("wrap", true),
9312 .shrink = shrink && sized.kind == Sizing::Kind::Stretch});
9313 cells.push_back(part.get());
9314 fields.emplace_back(part->id);
9315 roles.push_back(columnRole);
9316 }
9317 auto registry = std::make_shared<std::map<std::string, std::weak_ptr<RtScope>, std::less<>>>();
9318 // A value that names no tone is reported once for the table, whichever row and value it was.
9319 auto toneReported = std::make_shared<bool>(false);
9320 auto cellsOf = [this, ctx, &node, cells, fields, roles, registry, keyFn,
9321 toneReported](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) {
9322 if (row.peek().field(kGroupHeadingField) != nullptr) {
9323 return headingRow(node, ctx, row,
9324 runtime().untracked([&] { return canonicalJson(valueOfKey(keyFn(row.peek()))); }));
9325 }
9326 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
9327 for (DocNode const* const column : cells) {
9328 if (column != nullptr) {
9329 for (DocNodePtr const& cell : column->nodes("cell")) {
9330 content.push_back(cell.get());
9331 }
9332 }
9333 }
9334 std::string key = runtime().untracked([&] { return canonicalJson(valueOfKey(keyFn(row.peek()))); });
9335 auto scope = rowScope(node, ctx, row, content, key);
9336 (*registry)[std::move(key)] = scope;
9337 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
9338 std::vector<Node> out;
9339 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < cells.size(); ++index) {
9340 DocNode const* const column = cells.at(index);
9341 auto const nodes = column == nullptr ? std::span<DocNodePtr const>{} : column->nodes("cell");
9342 if (!nodes.empty()) {
9343 out.push_back(lowerAll(nodes, rowCtx));
9344 continue;
9345 }
9346 out.push_back(ui::text(Text{.text = slotProp<std::string>([this, &row, field = fields.at(index)] {
9347 Value const* const value = row.get().field(field);
9348 return value == nullptr ? std::string{}
9349 : textOf(*value, session.formatting());
9350 }),
9351 .role = roles.at(index)}));
9352 }
9353 if (!out.empty()) {
9354 // The row's first cell owns the row's scope, which lives as long as the row's node: a cell is placed by
9355 // its column, so the scope is not held by a wrapping container, which the column would place instead.
9356 auto owner = std::make_shared<std::pair<Node, std::shared_ptr<RtScope>> const>(out.front(), scope);
9357 out.front() = Node{owner, owner->first.get()};
9358 }
9359 TableRowView rowView{.cells = std::move(out), .tone = std::nullopt};
9360 // The row's name, in its own scope: what its select box and assistive technology read.
9361 if (ExprPtr const labelExpr = node.prop("rowLabel")) {
9362 rowView.label = bindProp<std::string>(rowCtx, labelExpr, std::string{}, stringOf);
9363 }
9364 if (ExprPtr const toneExpr = node.prop("rowTone")) {
9365 rowView.tone = slotProp<std::optional<Tone>>(
9366 [this, scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, toneExpr, toneReported]() -> std::optional<Tone> {
9367 return rowToneOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), toneExpr), toneExpr->path, *toneReported);
9368 });
9369 }
9370 return rowView;
9371 };
9372 TableOptions options;
9373 options.showHeader = node.flag("showHeader", true);
9374 options.selectColumn = node.flag("selectColumn");
9375 if (ExprPtr const selectAll = node.prop("selectAllLabel")) {
9376 options.selectAllLabel = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, selectAll, std::string{}, stringOf);
9377 }
9378 if (ExprPtr const threshold = node.prop("virtualizeThreshold")) {
9379 options.virtualize.threshold =
9380 static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max<std::int64_t>(0, intOf(once(ctx, threshold), 2000)));
9381 }
9382 if (ExprPtr const overscan = node.prop("virtualizeOverscan")) {
9383 options.virtualize.overscan =
9384 static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max<std::int64_t>(0, intOf(once(ctx, overscan), 10)));
9385 }
9386 std::string const mode =
9387 node.prop("selectionMode") ? textOf(once(ctx, node.prop("selectionMode")), format) : std::string{};
9388 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::None;
9389 if (mode == "single") {
9390 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::Single;
9391 } else if (mode == "multiple") {
9392 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::Multiple;
9393 }
9394 // The selection the table shows: the bound `selection`, or the table's own. A slot even for a literal list, so
9395 // a bound selection is fixed until the document writes it, and a user's change the document leaves unwritten
9396 // snaps back. A bound value that is neither a list nor `null` is reported once.
9397 auto selectionReported = std::make_shared<bool>(false);
9398 options.selection = slotProp<std::vector<Key>>([this, element, selectionReported, path = node.path] {
9399 std::vector<Key> keys;
9400 if (element->bound != nullptr) {
9401 Value const bound = element->bound->get();
9402 if (!bound.isNull() && bound.asList() == nullptr && !*selectionReported) {
9403 *selectionReported = true;
9404 report(pointerAppend(path, "selection"),
9405 "selection is " + canonicalJson(bound) + "; a table's selection is a list of keys");
9406 }
9407 }
9408 Value const selection = tableSelection(*element);
9409 if (ValueList const* const items = selection.asList()) {
9410 for (Value const& item : *items) {
9411 keys.push_back(keyOf(item));
9412 }
9413 }
9414 return keys;
9415 });
9416 // A user's change: the table's own selection takes it when no key binds one, then `onSelectionChange` runs with
9417 // `event` the new selection, in the table's scope, in the same batch. The backend holds one page: a `Replace`
9418 // is the whole new selection, and an `Extend` keeps the selected keys of the rows on other pages, before the
9419 // reported ones. A key whose row `rows` no longer has drops on any user change.
9420 options.onSelectionChange = [this, ctx, element, view, keyFn, commands = node.event("onSelectionChange")](
9421 std::vector<Key> const& keys, SelectionChange change) {
9422 ValueList items;
9423 if (change == SelectionChange::Extend && view != nullptr) {
9424 items = runtime().untracked([&] { return selectedOffPage(view->get(), tableSelection(*element), keyFn); });
9425 }
9426 // A heading is never selected. A virtualized backend knows the keys of rows it has not realized but not
9427 // which of them are headings, so its Ctrl+A or range can name one.
9428 for (Key const& key : keys) {
9429 if (std::string const* const text = std::get_if<std::string>(&key);
9430 text != nullptr && text->starts_with("\x1Fgroup:")) {
9431 continue;
9432 }
9433 items.push_back(valueOfKey(key));
9434 }
9435 Value const selected{std::move(items)};
9436 runtime().batch([&] {
9437 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
9438 session.asUser([&] {
9439 session.noteWrite();
9440 element->selection.set(selected);
9441 });
9442 }
9443 runEvent(commands, ctx, selected);
9444 });
9445 };
9446 // The header marks the sort's first key; a sort that names no sortable column marks none.
9447 auto const columnIndex = [&node, derivedCount](std::string_view columnId) -> std::optional<std::size_t> {
9448 auto const parts = node.partList("columns");
9449 auto const found =
9450 std::ranges::find_if(parts, [columnId](DocNodePtr const& part) { return part->id == columnId; });
9451 if (found == parts.end()) {
9452 return std::nullopt;
9453 }
9454 return derivedCount + static_cast<std::size_t>(std::distance(parts.begin(), found));
9455 };
9456 options.sort = slotProp<std::optional<TableSort>>([element, &node, columnIndex]() -> std::optional<TableSort> {
9457 std::optional<std::vector<SortKey>> const keys = sortKeysOf(node, tableSort(*element));
9458 if (!keys || keys->empty()) {
9459 return std::nullopt;
9460 }
9461 std::optional<std::size_t> const index = columnIndex(keys->front().column->id);
9462 if (!index) {
9463 return std::nullopt;
9464 }
9465 return TableSort{.column = *index,
9466 .direction = keys->front().descending ? SortDirection::Descending : SortDirection::Ascending};
9467 });
9468 // A header click makes its column the single key: descending when it already is the first key ascending,
9469 // ascending otherwise. The table's own sort takes it when no key binds one, then `onSortChange` runs with
9470 // `event` the new sort.
9471 options.onSort = [this, ctx, element, &node, derivedCount,
9472 commands = node.event("onSortChange")](std::size_t index) {
9473 auto const parts = node.partList("columns");
9474 if (index < derivedCount || index - derivedCount >= parts.size() ||
9475 !parts.subspan(index - derivedCount).front()->flag("sortable")) {
9476 return;
9477 }
9478 std::string const& columnId = parts.subspan(index - derivedCount).front()->id;
9479 Value const current = runtime().untracked([&] { return tableSort(*element); });
9480 std::optional<std::vector<SortKey>> const keys = sortKeysOf(node, current);
9481 bool const descending =
9482 keys && !keys->empty() && keys->front().column->id == columnId && !keys->front().descending;
9483 ValueRecord key;
9484 key.insert_or_assign("column", Value{columnId});
9485 key.insert_or_assign("direction", Value{std::string{descending ? "desc" : "asc"}});
9486 Value const next{ValueList{Value{std::move(key)}}};
9487 runtime().batch([&] {
9488 if (element->sortBound == nullptr) {
9489 session.asUser([&] {
9490 session.noteWrite();
9491 element->sort.set(next);
9492 });
9493 }
9494 runEvent(commands, ctx, next);
9495 });
9496 };
9497 options.onActivate = [this, ctx, element, registry, commands = node.event("onActivate")](Key const& key) {
9498 Value const activated = valueOfKey(key);
9499 session.asUser([&] {
9500 session.noteWrite();
9501 element->activeKey.set(activated);
9502 });
9503 auto const found = registry->find(canonicalJson(activated));
9504 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> const scope = found == registry->end() ? nullptr : found->second.lock();
9505 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope ? scope : ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
9506 runEvent(commands, rowCtx, activated);
9507 };
9508 commonOf(node, ctx, element, options.common);
9509 std::span<DocNodePtr const> const empty = node.nodes("empty");
9510 if (empty.empty()) {
9511 return ui::table<Value>(std::move(columns), std::move(rows), std::move(keyFn), std::move(cellsOf),
9512 std::move(options));
9513 }
9514 // With `empty`, a column holds the table and the content shown in its place while `rows` is an empty list; a
9515 // `null` (a query not answered yet) shows the table. The column is placed as the table would be: it takes the
9516 // node's visibility and layout, and every other common property stays on the table, so its test id and the
9517 // element id `focus` finds name the table.
9518 auto const listed = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, rowsExpr] {
9519 ValueList const* const items = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), rowsExpr).asList();
9520 return items == nullptr || !items->empty();
9521 };
9522 Column wrapper;
9523 wrapper.common.visible = std::move(options.common.visible);
9524 wrapper.common.layout = options.common.layout;
9525 options.common.visible = slotProp<bool>(listed);
9526 Column content{.children = {lowerAll(empty, ctx)}};
9527 content.common.visible = slotProp<bool>([listed] { return !listed(); });
9528 wrapper.children.push_back(ui::table<Value>(std::move(columns), std::move(rows), std::move(keyFn),
9529 std::move(cellsOf), std::move(options)));
9530 wrapper.children.push_back(ui::column(std::move(content)));
9531 return ui::column(std::move(wrapper));
9532}
9533
9534inline TableRowView ScreenCore::headingRow(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx,
9535 reactive::Signal<Value> const& row, std::string key) {
9536 auto const heading = node.partList("group").front()->nodes("heading");
9537 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
9538 content.reserve(heading.size());
9539 for (DocNodePtr const& child : heading) {
9540 content.push_back(child.get());
9541 }
9542 auto scope = rowScope(node, ctx, row, content, std::move(key));
9543 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
9544 // The cell owns the heading's scope, for as long as the row's node lives, as a data row's first cell does.
9545 auto owner = std::make_shared<std::pair<Node, std::shared_ptr<RtScope>> const>(lowerAll(heading, rowCtx), scope);
9546 return TableRowView{.cells = {Node{owner, owner->first.get()}}, .tone = std::nullopt, .heading = true};
9547}
9548
9549inline Node ScreenCore::lowerChart(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
9550 Chart spec;
9551 spec.data = slotProp<ChartData>(
9552 [this, &node, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings] { return chartData(node, *scope, bindings.get()); });
9553 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
9554 return ui::chart(std::move(spec));
9555}
9556
9557inline std::optional<math::Rational> ScreenCore::chartMagnitude(Value const& value, std::string const& path,
9558 std::optional<std::string>& unit) {
9559 std::optional<Number> const number = numeric(value);
9560 if (!number) {
9561 report(path, "a chart value is a number or a quantity; this one is left out");
9562 return std::nullopt;
9563 }
9564 std::string const own = number->unit != nullptr ? *number->unit : std::string{};
9565 if (!unit) {
9566 unit = own;
9567 return number->value;
9568 }
9569 if (*unit == own) {
9570 return number->value;
9571 }
9572 std::optional<math::Rational> converted;
9573 if (!own.empty() && !unit->empty()) {
9574 converted = convertUnit(number->value, own, *unit, session.formatting().units);
9575 }
9576 if (!converted) {
9577 report(path, "a chart value does not convert to the unit of the chart's first value; it is left out");
9578 }
9579 return converted;
9580}
9581
9582inline std::optional<Tone> ScreenCore::chartToneOf(Value const& value, std::string const& path) {
9583 static constexpr std::array<std::pair<std::string_view, Tone>, 5> kTones = {{
9584 {"neutral", Tone::Neutral},
9585 {"info", Tone::Info},
9586 {"ok", Tone::Ok},
9587 {"warn", Tone::Warn},
9588 {"err", Tone::Err},
9589 }};
9590 if (value.isNull()) {
9591 return std::nullopt;
9592 }
9593 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
9594 for (auto const& [name, tone] : kTones) {
9595 if (name == *text) {
9596 return tone;
9597 }
9598 }
9599 }
9600 report(path, "a chart tone is neutral, info, ok, warn or err; this one marks nothing");
9601 return std::nullopt;
9602}
9603
9604inline std::optional<math::Rational> ScreenCore::chartPosition(Value const& value, std::string const& path,
9605 detail::ChartAxisKinds& kinds) {
9606 if (value.isNull()) {
9607 return std::nullopt;
9608 }
9609 if (std::optional<Number> const number = numeric(value)) {
9610 kinds.numbers = true;
9611 return number->value;
9612 }
9613 if (std::optional<time::DateTime> const instant =
9614 dateInstantOf(value, session.formatting().utcOffsetMinutes).instant) {
9615 kinds.instants = true;
9616 return math::Rational{instant->value.time_since_epoch().count(), math::DecimalPlaces{0}};
9617 }
9618 report(path, "a chart's `x` is a number, a date or an instant; this point is left out");
9619 return std::nullopt;
9620}
9621
9622inline std::vector<detail::ChartRawPoint> ScreenCore::chartPoints(DocNode const& series, RtScope const& scope,
9623 Bindings const* bindings,
9624 std::optional<std::string>& unit,
9625 detail::ChartAxisKinds& kinds) {
9626 // A chart is a picture of a few hundred values; a larger set is a table's.
9627 static constexpr std::size_t kMaxPoints = 1000;
9628 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
9629 ExprPtr const pointsExpr = series.prop("points");
9630 Value const listed = evalIn(scope, bindings, pointsExpr);
9631 ValueList const* const list = listed.asList();
9632 if (list == nullptr) {
9633 // `null` is a query still loading, and draws as empty without a word.
9634 if (!listed.isNull()) {
9635 report(pointsExpr->path, "`points` is a list; the series draws as empty");
9636 }
9637 return {};
9638 }
9639 std::size_t const first = list->size() > kMaxPoints ? list->size() - kMaxPoints : 0;
9640 if (first > 0) {
9641 report(pointsExpr->path, "a series draws its last 1000 points");
9642 }
9643 ExprPtr const yExpr = series.prop("y");
9644 ExprPtr const xExpr = series.prop("x");
9645 ExprPtr const labelExpr = series.prop("xLabel");
9646 ExprPtr const toneExpr = series.prop("tone");
9647 ExprPtr const noteExpr = series.prop("note");
9648 std::vector<detail::ChartRawPoint> points;
9649 for (std::size_t index = first; index < list->size(); ++index) {
9650 ScopeEnv const env{scope, bindings, &list->at(index)};
9651 detail::ChartRawPoint point{.index = index};
9652 if (xExpr) {
9653 point.x = chartPosition(evaluate(*xExpr, env), xExpr->path, kinds);
9654 if (!point.x) {
9655 continue;
9656 }
9657 }
9658 Value const value = evaluate(*yExpr, env);
9659 if (!value.isNull()) {
9660 point.y = chartMagnitude(value, yExpr->path, unit);
9661 if (!point.y) {
9662 continue;
9663 }
9664 }
9665 point.xLabel = labelExpr ? textOf(evaluate(*labelExpr, env), format) : std::string{};
9666 point.note = noteExpr ? textOf(evaluate(*noteExpr, env), format) : std::string{};
9667 point.tone = toneExpr ? chartToneOf(evaluate(*toneExpr, env), toneExpr->path) : std::nullopt;
9668 points.push_back(std::move(point));
9669 }
9670 return points;
9671}
9672
9673/// @brief A chart's exact value at @p places, as the active locale writes it.
9674/// @param value The value.
9675/// @param places The places, at most 18.
9676/// @param format The formatting facts.
9677/// @return The text; the exact JSON when the rounded value does not fit.
9678[[nodiscard]] inline std::string chartNumberText(math::Rational const& value, std::uint32_t places,
9679 FormatContext const& format) {
9680 std::optional<math::Rational> rounded =
9681 math::checkedRoundToDecimalPlaces(value, math::DecimalPlaces{places}, math::RoundingMode::HalfEven);
9682 if (!rounded) {
9683 return textOf(Value{Decimal{value}}, format);
9684 }
9685 rounded->decimalPlaces = math::DecimalPlaces{places};
9686 return textOf(Value{Decimal{*rounded}}, format);
9687}
9688
9689/// @brief A reference line's stroke by its document name.
9690/// @param name `solid`, `dashed`, `dotted`, or empty for solid; the loader refuses any other.
9691/// @return The stroke.
9692[[nodiscard]] inline ChartLineStyle chartLineStyle(std::string_view name) {
9693 if (name == "dashed") {
9694 return ChartLineStyle::Dashed;
9695 }
9696 return name == "dotted" ? ChartLineStyle::Dotted : ChartLineStyle::Solid;
9697}
9698
9699/// @brief Where a point sits along a value axis that a document may have fixed, and on which side it is clipped.
9700/// @param value The point's value.
9701/// @param range The axis.
9702/// @return The value drawn, the axis end for a value outside, and the side it lies beyond.
9703[[nodiscard]] inline std::pair<math::Rational, ChartClip> chartClipped(math::Rational const& value,
9704 ChartRange const& range) {
9705 if (value < range.low) {
9706 return {range.low, ChartClip::Below};
9707 }
9708 if (value > range.high) {
9709 return {range.high, ChartClip::Above};
9710 }
9711 return {value, ChartClip::None};
9712}
9713
9714inline std::vector<detail::ChartRawLine> ScreenCore::chartLines(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope,
9715 Bindings const* bindings,
9716 std::optional<std::string>& unit) {
9717 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
9718 std::vector<detail::ChartRawLine> lines;
9719 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("lines")) {
9720 ExprPtr const valueExpr = part->prop("value");
9721 Value const value = evalIn(scope, bindings, valueExpr);
9722 std::optional<math::Rational> const magnitude =
9723 value.isNull() ? std::nullopt : chartMagnitude(value, valueExpr->path, unit);
9724 if (!magnitude) {
9725 continue;
9726 }
9727 detail::ChartRawLine line{.value = *magnitude, .label = std::nullopt};
9728 if (ExprPtr const label = part->prop("label")) {
9729 line.label = textOf(evalIn(scope, bindings, label), format);
9730 }
9731 if (ExprPtr const tone = part->prop("tone")) {
9732 line.tone = chartToneOf(evalIn(scope, bindings, tone), tone->path).value_or(Tone::Neutral);
9733 }
9734 line.style = detail::chartLineStyle(part->name("style"));
9735 lines.push_back(std::move(line));
9736 }
9737 return lines;
9738}
9739
9740inline ChartRange ScreenCore::chartFixedRange(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings,
9741 std::optional<std::string>& unit, ChartRange const& range) {
9742 ChartRange fixed = range;
9743 for (auto const& [key, end] : {std::pair{"yMin", &fixed.low}, std::pair{"yMax", &fixed.high}}) {
9744 if (ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key)) {
9745 Value const value = evalIn(scope, bindings, expr);
9746 if (!value.isNull()) {
9747 *end = chartMagnitude(value, expr->path, unit).value_or(*end);
9748 }
9749 }
9750 }
9751 if (fixed.high > fixed.low) {
9752 return fixed;
9753 }
9754 report(pointerAppend(node.path, "yMin"), "`yMin` is not below `yMax`; the chart takes its range from its values");
9755 return range;
9756}
9757
9758inline void ScreenCore::chartSeries(ChartData& data, DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope,
9759 Bindings const* bindings, std::vector<std::vector<detail::ChartRawPoint>>& series,
9760 bool positioned, ChartRange const& range) const {
9761 auto const positionOf = [positioned](detail::ChartRawPoint const& point) {
9762 return positioned && point.x ? *point.x
9763 : math::Rational{static_cast<std::int64_t>(point.index), math::DecimalPlaces{0}};
9764 };
9765 std::vector<math::Rational> positions;
9766 for (auto const& points : series) {
9767 std::ranges::transform(points, std::back_inserter(positions), positionOf);
9768 }
9769 if (std::optional<ChartRange> const across = chartRange(positions, 0)) {
9770 data.xMin = realOf(across->low);
9771 data.xMax = realOf(across->high);
9772 }
9773 std::size_t index = 0;
9774 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("series")) {
9775 ChartSeries drawn;
9776 if (ExprPtr const label = part->prop("label")) {
9777 drawn.label = textOf(evalIn(scope, bindings, label), session.formatting());
9778 }
9779 drawn.joined = !part->flags.contains("joined") || part->flag("joined");
9780 for (detail::ChartRawPoint& point : series.at(index)) {
9781 ChartPoint out{.x = realOf(positionOf(point)),
9782 .y = std::nullopt,
9783 .clip = ChartClip::None,
9784 .xLabel = std::move(point.xLabel),
9785 .tone = point.tone,
9786 .note = std::move(point.note)};
9787 if (point.y) {
9788 auto const [shown, clip] = detail::chartClipped(*point.y, range);
9789 out.y = realOf(shown);
9790 out.clip = clip;
9791 }
9792 drawn.points.push_back(std::move(out));
9793 }
9794 data.series.push_back(std::move(drawn));
9795 ++index;
9796 }
9797}
9798
9799inline ChartData ScreenCore::chartData(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings) {
9800 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
9801 ChartData data;
9802 data.summary = textOf(evalIn(scope, bindings, node.prop("summary")), format);
9803 if (ExprPtr const label = node.prop("yLabel")) {
9804 data.yLabel = textOf(evalIn(scope, bindings, label), format);
9805 }
9806 std::optional<std::string> unit;
9807 detail::ChartAxisKinds kinds;
9808 std::vector<std::vector<detail::ChartRawPoint>> series;
9809 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("series")) {
9810 series.push_back(chartPoints(*part, scope, bindings, unit, kinds));
9811 }
9812 std::vector<detail::ChartRawLine> const lines = chartLines(node, scope, bindings, unit);
9813 // The values the axis must hold, and the places they are shown at.
9814 std::vector<math::Rational> values;
9815 for (auto const& points : series) {
9816 for (detail::ChartRawPoint const& point : points) {
9817 if (point.y) {
9818 values.push_back(*point.y);
9819 }
9820 }
9821 }
9822 std::ranges::transform(lines, std::back_inserter(values), &detail::ChartRawLine::value);
9823 std::uint32_t widest = 0;
9824 for (math::Rational const& value : values) {
9825 widest = std::max(widest, value.decimalPlaces.value);
9826 }
9827 ExprPtr const placesExpr = node.prop("yPlaces");
9828 std::int64_t const* const fixedPlaces = placesExpr ? placesExpr->literal.asInt() : nullptr;
9829 std::uint32_t const places = fixedPlaces != nullptr ? static_cast<std::uint32_t>(*fixedPlaces) : widest;
9830 std::optional<ChartRange> const computed = chartRange(values, places);
9831 if (!computed) {
9832 report(node.path, "the chart's values overflow its arithmetic; it draws nothing");
9833 return data;
9834 }
9835 ChartRange const range = chartFixedRange(node, scope, bindings, unit, *computed);
9836 data.yMin = realOf(range.low);
9837 data.yMax = realOf(range.high);
9838 // Three or more lines are the scale a reader reads the chart against; fewer leave the values without one.
9839 std::optional<ChartTicks> const ticks = lines.size() < 3 ? chartTicks(range) : std::nullopt;
9840 if (ticks) {
9841 std::uint32_t const tickPlaces = std::max(places, ticks->places);
9842 for (math::Rational const& tick : ticks->values) {
9843 data.yTicks.push_back(
9844 ChartTick{.value = realOf(tick), .text = detail::chartNumberText(tick, tickPlaces, format)});
9845 }
9846 }
9847 for (detail::ChartRawLine const& line : lines) {
9848 data.lines.push_back(
9849 ChartLine{.value = realOf(line.value),
9850 .label = line.label.value_or(detail::chartNumberText(line.value, places, format)),
9851 .tone = line.tone,
9852 .style = line.style});
9853 }
9854 if (kinds.numbers && kinds.instants) {
9855 report(pointerAppend(node.path, "series"),
9856 "a chart's `x` values are all numbers or all dates and instants; the points are spaced by index");
9857 }
9858 chartSeries(data, node, scope, bindings, series, kinds.numbers != kinds.instants, range);
9859 return data;
9860}
9861
9862inline std::optional<Tone> ScreenCore::rowToneOf(Value const& value, std::string const& path, bool& noted) {
9863 if (value.isNull()) {
9864 return std::nullopt;
9865 }
9866 if (std::optional<Tone> const tone = toneNamed(value)) {
9867 return tone;
9868 }
9869 if (!noted) {
9870 noted = true;
9871 report(path, "rowTone is " + canonicalJson(value) + "; a tone is neutral, info, ok, warn or err");
9872 }
9873 return std::nullopt;
9874}
9875
9876inline void ScreenCore::ownQueriesOf(ExprPtr const& expr, RtScope const& scope, BoundaryRuntime& boundary,
9877 std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& seen) {
9878 if (!expr) {
9879 return;
9880 }
9881 bool const control = expr->kind == ExprKind::Query || expr->kind == ExprKind::Pending ||
9882 expr->kind == ExprKind::Error || expr->kind == ExprKind::ErrorKind;
9883 if (control || expr->kind == ExprKind::Ref) {
9884 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(expr->name);
9885 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query && seen.insert(expr->name).second) {
9886 boundary.queries.push_back(found->query);
9887 }
9888 if (expr->kind == ExprKind::Ref && found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Let &&
9889 seen.insert("let:" + expr->name).second) {
9890 ownQueriesOf(found->letExpr, scope, boundary, seen);
9891 }
9892 }
9893 for (ExprPtr const& arg : expr->args) {
9894 ownQueriesOf(arg, scope, boundary, seen);
9895 }
9896 for (auto const& [name, field] : expr->fields) {
9897 static_cast<void>(name);
9898 ownQueriesOf(field, scope, boundary, seen);
9899 }
9900}
9901
9902inline void ScreenCore::ownQueries(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, BoundaryRuntime& boundary,
9903 std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& seen) {
9904 if (node.kind == "boundary") {
9905 return;
9906 }
9907 for (auto const& [key, expr] : node.props) {
9908 static_cast<void>(key);
9909 ownQueriesOf(expr, scope, boundary, seen);
9910 }
9911 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
9912 static_cast<void>(key);
9913 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
9914 ownQueries(*child, scope, boundary, seen);
9915 }
9916 }
9917 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
9918 static_cast<void>(key);
9919 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
9920 ownQueries(*part, scope, boundary, seen);
9921 }
9922 }
9923}
9924
9925inline Node ScreenCore::lowerBoundary(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
9926 auto boundary = std::make_shared<BoundaryRuntime>();
9927 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> seen;
9928 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
9929 ownQueries(*child, *ctx.scope, *boundary, seen);
9930 }
9931 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings);
9932 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "boundary", .read = [boundary] {
9933 for (QueryRuntime const* const query : boundary->queries) {
9934 Value const error = query->error();
9935 if (!error.isNull() && query->value().isNull()) {
9936 return Value{ValueRecord{{"error", error}}};
9937 }
9938 }
9939 return Value{ValueRecord{{"error", Value{}}}};
9940 }});
9941 LowerCtx const errorCtx{.scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = bindings, .boundary = boundary};
9942 LowerCtx const childCtx{.scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = boundary};
9943 auto group = [this](std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes, LowerCtx const& where) -> Node {
9944 return nodes.empty() ? ui::spacer() : lowerAll(nodes, where);
9945 };
9946 Switch spec;
9947 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{0}}, .node = group(node.nodes("loading"), childCtx)});
9948 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{1}}, .node = group(node.nodes("error"), errorCtx)});
9949 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{2}}, .node = group(node.nodes("children"), childCtx)});
9950 spec.selector = slotProp<Key>([boundary] {
9951 bool loading = false;
9952 for (QueryRuntime const* const query : boundary->queries) {
9953 if (!query->settled()) {
9954 loading = true;
9955 } else if (query->value().isNull() && !query->error().isNull()) {
9956 return Key{std::int64_t{1}};
9957 }
9958 }
9959 return Key{std::int64_t{loading ? 0 : 2}};
9960 });
9961 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, spec.common);
9962 return ui::switchOf(std::move(spec));
9963}
9964
9965inline Node ScreenCore::lowerCustom(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
9966 std::string const name{node.name("name")};
9967 // A loaded document's custom node names a declared component, and every component has a fallback.
9968 Component const& component = _doc->components.at(name);
9969 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, ExprPtr>> props;
9970 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("props")) {
9971 for (auto const& [key, expr] : record->props) {
9972 props.emplace_back(key, expr);
9973 }
9974 }
9975 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>();
9976 bindings->push_back(
9977 Binding{.name = "props", .read = [scope = ctx.scope, outer = ctx.bindings, props = std::move(props)] {
9978 ValueRecord record;
9979 for (auto const& [key, expr] : props) {
9980 record.insert_or_assign(key, evalIn(*scope, outer.get(), expr));
9981 }
9982 return Value{std::move(record)};
9983 }});
9984 auto scope = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, nullptr, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 1);
9985 scope->usePrefix = focusKeyOf(node.path, *ctx.scope) + ">";
9986 DocNode const& fallback = *component.fallback;
9987 declare(*scope, nullptr, {&fallback}, {});
9988 Node lowered = lower(fallback, LowerCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = bindings, .boundary = nullptr});
9989 Custom spec{.name = name,
9990 .fallback = std::move(lowered),
9991 .props = {},
9992 .minVersion =
9993 static_cast<int>(std::clamp<std::int64_t>(component.version, 0, std::numeric_limits<int>::max())),
9994 .onEvent = {}};
9995 // Every declared prop is given, a missing one as its type's empty value: a component lacking one is refused.
9996 for (auto const& [prop, type] : component.props) {
9997 ExprPtr expr;
9998 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("props")) {
9999 if (ExprPtr const given = record->prop(prop)) {
10000 expr = given;
10001 }
10002 }
10003 if (type == "bool") {
10004 spec.props.push_back(CustomProp{.name = prop, .value = bindProp<bool>(ctx, expr, false, boolOf)});
10005 } else if (type == "number") {
10006 spec.props.push_back(CustomProp{
10007 .name = prop, .value = bindProp<double>(ctx, expr, 0.0, [](Value const& value, FormatContext const&) {
10008 return componentNumber(value);
10009 })});
10010 } else {
10011 spec.props.push_back(
10012 CustomProp{.name = prop,
10013 .value = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, expr, std::string{},
10014 [type](Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
10015 return componentText(value, type, format);
10016 })});
10017 }
10018 }
10019 spec.onEvent = [this, ctx, site = &node, declared = &component](std::string const& event,
10020 std::string const& payload) {
10021 Commands const* const commands = site->event("on." + event);
10022 if (commands == nullptr) {
10023 return;
10024 }
10025 auto const type = declared->events.find(event);
10026 runEvent(commands, ctx, componentPayload(payload, type == declared->events.end() ? nullptr : &type->second));
10027 };
10028 return ui::custom(std::move(spec));
10029}

10031/// @brief One child of an arranged container, as the user's choice places it.
10032struct ArrangedChild {
10033 /// @brief The child's id.
10034 std::string id;
10035 /// @brief Whether the choice hides it.
10036 bool hidden = false;
10037};
10038
10039/// @brief A container's children in the order a stored `arrange` choice gives, each marked shown or hidden.
10040///
10041/// A child the choice does not name keeps its declared place after the named ones, shown, and an entry that names no
10042/// child, names one twice or is not a `{"id", "hidden"}` record is skipped, so a new document version survives an old
10043/// choice (spec 5 §12b). A choice that is not a list leaves the declared order. Only `"hidden": true` hides.
10044/// @param stored The point's current choice.
10045/// @param declared The container's children, in document order.
10046/// @return Every child, in order.
10047[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<ArrangedChild> arrangedChildren(Value const& stored,
10048 std::span<DocNode const* const> declared) {
10049 auto const isDeclared = [declared](std::string const& childId) {
10050 return std::ranges::find(declared, childId, &DocNode::id) != declared.end();
10051 };
10052 std::vector<ArrangedChild> out;
10053 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> placed;
10054 if (ValueList const* const entries = stored.asList()) {
10055 for (Value const& entry : *entries) {
10056 Value const* const named = entry.field("id");
10057 std::string const* const name = named == nullptr ? nullptr : named->asString();
10058 if (name == nullptr || !isDeclared(*name) || !placed.insert(*name).second) {
10059 continue;
10060 }
10061 Value const* const hidden = entry.field("hidden");
10062 bool const* const flag = hidden == nullptr ? nullptr : hidden->asBool();
10063 out.push_back(ArrangedChild{.id = *name, .hidden = flag != nullptr && *flag});
10064 }
10065 }
10066 for (DocNode const* const child : declared) {
10067 if (!placed.contains(child->id)) {
10068 out.push_back(ArrangedChild{.id = child->id});
10069 }
10070 }
10071 return out;
10072}
10073
10074/// @brief The ids of the children an `arrange` choice shows, in its order (`arrangedChildren`, without the hidden).
10075/// @param stored The point's current choice.
10076/// @param declared The container's children, in document order.
10077/// @return The ids to show, in order.
10078[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<Value> arrangedOrder(Value const& stored, std::span<DocNode const* const> declared) {
10079 std::vector<Value> order;
10080 for (ArrangedChild const& child : arrangedChildren(stored, declared)) {
10081 if (!child.hidden) {
10082 order.emplace_back(child.id);
10083 }
10084 }
10085 return order;
10086}
10087
10088/// @brief An arrangement as the choice an `arrange` point stores.
10089/// @param children Every child, in order.
10090/// @return `[{"id", "hidden"}, …]`.
10091[[nodiscard]] inline Value arrangementValue(std::vector<ArrangedChild> const& children) {
10092 ValueList entries;
10093 entries.reserve(children.size());
10094 for (ArrangedChild const& child : children) {
10095 entries.emplace_back(ValueRecord{{"id", Value{child.id}}, {"hidden", Value{child.hidden}}});
10096 }
10097 return Value{std::move(entries)};
10098}
10099
10100/// @brief The element of a document tree with @p elementId.
10101/// @param node The subtree.
10102/// @param elementId The element's id.
10103/// @return The element, or `nullptr` when the subtree has none with that id.
10104// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per level of the document tree.
10105[[nodiscard]] inline DocNode const* elementNode(DocNode const& node, std::string_view elementId) {
10106 if (node.id == elementId) {
10107 return &node;
10108 }
10109 for (auto const* const groups : {&node.children, &node.parts}) {
10110 for (auto const& [slot, nodes] : *groups) {
10111 static_cast<void>(slot);
10112 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
10113 if (DocNode const* const found = elementNode(*child, elementId)) {
10114 return found;
10115 }
10116 }
10117 }
10118 }
10119 return nullptr;
10120}

10122inline std::string ScreenCore::arrangedBy(std::string const& elementId) const {
10123 if (elementId.empty()) {
10124 return {};
10125 }
10126 for (auto const& [name, point] : _doc->customize) {
10127 if (point.kind == "arrange" && point.of == elementId) {
10128 return name;
10129 }
10130 }
10131 return {};

10134// A keyed list over the children's ids rather than a stack, so a new choice moves the shown widgets, keeping their
10135// state and focus, and mounts or unmounts only what it shows or hides. A child is lowered in the container's own
10136// scope: arranging changes where it is, not what it reads.
10137inline Node ScreenCore::lowerArranged(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element,
10138 std::string const& point, Axis axis, int gap) {
10139 std::vector<DocNode const*> declared;
10140 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
10141 declared.push_back(child.get());
10142 }
10143 auto order = [this, point, declared] { return arrangedOrder(prefs.get().at(point), declared); };
10144 auto key = [](Value const& childId) { return keyOf(childId); };
10145 LowerCtx childCtx = ctx;
10146 childCtx.listGap = axis == Axis::Vertical ? gap : 0;
10147 auto view = [this, childCtx, declared](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) -> Node {
10148 // The order lists only declared ids, so the lookup always finds the child.
10149 auto const found = std::ranges::find(declared, textOf(row.peek(), session.formatting()), &DocNode::id);
10150 return lower(**found, childCtx);
10151 };
10152 ForEach spec{
10153 .model = std::make_shared<TypedForEach<Value> const>(std::move(order), std::move(key), std::move(view)),
10154 .axis = axis,
10155 .gap = gap};
10156 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
10157 return makeNode(std::move(spec));
10158}
10159
10160// One row per child of the arranged container, hidden ones included: a checkbox shows or hides it, and two buttons
10161// move it a place. Each edit stores the whole arrangement, so the stored list always names every child.
10162inline Node ScreenCore::lowerArrangeEditor(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, std::string const& point,
10163 CustomizePoint const& spec, std::function<void(Value)> const& choose) {
10164 // The loader checked that `of` names a column or row of this screen.
10165 DocNode const* const container = elementNode(*_doc->view, spec.of);
10166 std::vector<DocNode const*> declared;
10167 for (DocNodePtr const& child : container->nodes("children")) {
10168 declared.push_back(child.get());
10169 }
10170 auto const current = [this, point, declared] { return arrangedChildren(prefs.get().at(point), declared); };
10171 auto const place = [current](std::string const& childId) {
10172 auto const children = current();
10173 return static_cast<std::size_t>(std::ranges::find(children, childId, &ArrangedChild::id) - children.begin());
10174 };
10175 // Applies an edit to the arrangement as it stands, read untracked: the edit is a transition, not a binding.
10176 auto const edit = [this, current, choose](std::string const& childId, auto const& change) {
10177 auto children = runtime().untracked(current);
10178 auto const found = std::ranges::find(children, childId, &ArrangedChild::id);
10179 change(children, static_cast<std::size_t>(found - children.begin()));
10180 choose(arrangementValue(children));
10181 };
10182 auto rows = [current] {
10183 std::vector<Value> ids;
10184 for (ArrangedChild const& child : current()) {
10185 ids.emplace_back(child.id);
10186 }
10187 return ids;
10188 };
10189 auto key = [](Value const& childId) { return keyOf(childId); };
10190 auto view = [this, current, place, edit](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) -> Node {
10191 std::string const childId = textOf(row.peek(), session.formatting());
10192 Checkbox shown{.label = childId};
10193 shown.checked = slotProp<bool>([current, childId] {
10194 auto const children = current();
10195 return !std::ranges::find(children, childId, &ArrangedChild::id)->hidden;
10196 });
10197 shown.onToggle = [edit, childId](bool checked) {
10198 edit(childId, [checked](std::vector<ArrangedChild>& children, std::size_t index) {
10199 children.at(index).hidden = !checked;
10200 });
10201 };
10202 Button moveUp{.label = std::string{"\xE2\x86\x91"}};
10203 moveUp.onClick = [edit, childId] {
10204 // Clamped rather than refused: at the edge the child swaps with itself, which stores the same order.
10205 edit(childId, [](std::vector<ArrangedChild>& children, std::size_t index) {
10206 std::swap(children.at(index), children.at(std::max(index, std::size_t{1}) - 1));
10207 });
10208 };
10209 moveUp.common.enabled = slotProp<bool>([place, childId] { return place(childId) > 0; });
10210 moveUp.common.a11y.name = "Move " + childId + " up";
10211 moveUp.common.testId = "arrange-up-" + childId;
10212 Button moveDown{.label = std::string{"\xE2\x86\x93"}};
10213 moveDown.onClick = [edit, childId] {
10214 edit(childId, [](std::vector<ArrangedChild>& children, std::size_t index) {
10215 std::swap(children.at(index), children.at(std::min(index + 1, children.size() - 1)));
10216 });
10217 };
10218 moveDown.common.enabled =
10219 slotProp<bool>([current, place, childId] { return place(childId) + 1 < current().size(); });
10220 moveDown.common.a11y.name = "Move " + childId + " down";
10221 moveDown.common.testId = "arrange-down-" + childId;
10222 shown.common.testId = "arrange-shown-" + childId;
10223 return ui::row(Row{.children = {ui::checkbox(std::move(shown)), ui::button(std::move(moveUp)),
10224 ui::button(std::move(moveDown))},
10225 .gap = 1});
10226 };
10227 ForEach editor{.model =
10228 std::make_shared<TypedForEach<Value> const>(std::move(rows), std::move(key), std::move(view))};
10229 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, editor.common);
10230 return makeNode(std::move(editor));
10231}

10233inline Node ScreenCore::lowerCustomize(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
10234 std::string const point{node.name("point")};
10235 // A loaded document's customize node names a declared point, and every point has a choice in `prefs`.
10236 CustomizePoint const& spec = _doc->customize.at(point);
10237 auto choose = [this, point](Value value) {
10238 session.asUser([&] {
10239 ValueRecord next = prefs.peek();
10240 next.insert_or_assign(point, value);
10241 prefs.set(std::move(next));
10242 });
10243 if (host != nullptr) {
10244 host->preferenceChanged(_doc->id, point, value);
10245 }
10246 };
10247 if (spec.kind == "arrange") {
10248 return lowerArrangeEditor(node, ctx, point, spec, choose);
10249 }
10250 if (spec.kind == "choice") {
10251 Select select;
10252 std::vector<SelectOption> options;
10253 options.reserve(spec.options.size());
10254 for (std::string const& option : spec.options) {
10255 options.push_back(SelectOption{.key = Key{option}, .label = option});
10256 }
10257 select.options = std::move(options);
10258 select.selected = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>([this, point]() -> std::optional<Key> {
10259 Value const& chosen = prefs.get().at(point);
10260 return chosen.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(chosen)};
10261 });
10262 select.onSelect = [choose](Key const& key) { choose(valueOfKey(key)); };
10263 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, select.common);
10264 return ui::select(std::move(select));
10265 }
10266 if (spec.kind == "value" && (spec.type.kind == TypeKind::String || spec.type.isAny())) {
10267 TextInput input;
10268 input.value =
10269 slotProp<std::string>([this, point] { return textOf(prefs.get().at(point), session.formatting()); });
10270 input.onChange = [choose](std::string text) { choose(Value{std::move(text)}); };
10271 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, input.common);
10272 return ui::textInput(std::move(input));
10273 }
10274 Text placeholder{.text = point, .role = TextRole::Muted};
10275 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, placeholder.common);
10276 return ui::text(std::move(placeholder));
10277}

10282inline std::vector<TextSpan> Screen::headSpans(ExprPtr const& expr) const {

10287 bool badTone = false;

10289 detail::spansOf(detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, expr), _core->session.formatting(), dropped, &badTone);

10299inline DocNode const* Screen::shownRoot() const {
10300 DocNode const* node = _core->doc().view.get();
10301 while (node != nullptr && node->kind == "switch") {
10302 Value const value = detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, node->prop("on"));
10303 std::span<DocNodePtr const> shown = node->nodes("default");
10304 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node->partList("cases")) {
10305 if (!(detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, part->prop("when")) == value)) {
10306 continue;
10307 }
10308 if (part->scope.has_value() && detail::declaresNames(*part->scope)) {
10309 return nullptr;
10310 }
10311 shown = part->nodes("children");
10312 break;
10313 }
10314 node = shown.size() == 1 ? shown.front().get() : nullptr;
10315 }
10316 return node;
10317}

10400inline std::expected<std::unique_ptr<Screen>, Refusal> Interpreter::mount(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc,
10401 ValueRecord const& params,
10402 IViewBackend& backend,
10403 MountOptions const& options) {
10404 auto refuse = [&](std::string path, std::string reason) {
10405 return std::unexpected(Refusal{.document = doc->id, .path = std::move(path), .reason = std::move(reason)});
10406 };
10407 if (!doc->view) {
10408 return refuse("", "the document has no view");
10409 }
10410 ValueRecord given;
10411 for (auto const& [name, type] : doc->params) {
10412 auto const found = params.find(name);
10413 Value value = found == params.end() ? Value{} : found->second;
10414 if (!type.admits(value)) {
10415 return refuse(pointerAppend("/params", name), value.isNull()
10416 ? "param `" + name + "` is missing"
10417 : "param `" + name + "` is not a " + type.name());
10418 }
10419 given.insert_or_assign(name, std::move(value));
10420 }
10421 for (ModelDecl const& model : doc->scope.models) {
10422 if (model.instance == InstanceMode::Borrowed && !options.borrowed.contains(model.name)) {
10423 return refuse(model.path, "alias `" + model.name + "` borrows a model its opener did not lend");
10424 }
10425 }
10426 reactive::Runtime& runtime = _session->runtime();
10427 std::unique_ptr<Screen> screen{new Screen{}};
10428 screen->_core = std::make_unique<detail::ScreenCore>(doc, *_session, *_dispatcher, _options, options);
10429 detail::ScreenCore& core = *screen->_core;
10430 if (options.keepStateOf != nullptr) {
10431 core.keptStates = options.keepStateOf->ownState();
10432 }
10433 screen->_scope = std::make_shared<detail::RtScope>(core, nullptr, nullptr, options.depth);
10434 core.rootScope = screen->_scope;
10435 detail::RtScope& scope = *screen->_scope;
10436 scope.submitted = &core.submitted;
10437 scope.showErrors = doc->showErrors;
10438 for (auto const& [name, value] : given) {
10439 detail::NameRef ref;
10440 ref.category = detail::NameCategory::Param;
10441 ref.param = value;
10442 scope.names.insert_or_assign(name, std::move(ref));
10443 }
10444 std::vector<Commands const*> lists;
10445 for (auto const& [key, commands] : doc->lifecycle) {
10446 static_cast<void>(key);
10447 lists.push_back(&commands);
10448 }
10449 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : doc->keys) {
10450 static_cast<void>(chord);
10451 lists.push_back(&commands);
10452 }
10453 detail::headCommandLists(*doc, lists);
10454 Node root = runtime.untracked([&] {
10455 core.declare(scope, &doc->scope, {doc->view.get()}, lists);
10456 detail::LowerCtx const ctx{
10457 .scope = screen->_scope, .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings const>(), .boundary = nullptr};
10458 Node lowered = core.lower(*doc->view, ctx);
10459 screen->_headStatus = core.lowerBadgeParts(doc->status, ctx);
10460 screen->_headActions = core.lowerActionParts(doc->actions, ctx);
10461 screen->_headMenu = core.lowerHeadMenu(doc->menu, ctx);
10462 screen->_headTools = core.lowerHeadTools(doc->tools, ctx);
10463 if (!doc->keys.empty()) {
10464 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys;
10465 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : doc->keys) {
10466 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{
10467 .chord = chord, .onPress = [&core, ctx, list = &commands] { core.runEvent(list, ctx, Value{}); }});
10468 }
10469 Column column{.children = {std::move(lowered)}};
10470 column.common.keys = std::move(keys);
10471 lowered = ui::column(std::move(column));
10472 }
10473 return lowered;
10474 });
10475 screen->_mounted.emplace(runtime, backend, std::move(root), options.parent, options.depth + 1);
10476 screen->_core->focusElement = [mounted = &*screen->_mounted](std::string_view element) {
10477 return mounted->focus(element);
10478 };
10479 screen->runLifecycle("onMount");
10480 return screen;
10481}

10483inline std::expected<std::unique_ptr<AppRoot>, Refusal> Interpreter::mountApp(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc) {
10484 if (doc->id != "app") {
10485 return std::unexpected(
10486 Refusal{.document = doc->id, .path = "/id", .reason = "the app document's id is `app`"});
10487 }
10488 if (_session->appScope() != nullptr) {
10489 return std::unexpected(
10490 Refusal{.document = doc->id, .path = {}, .reason = "an app document is already mounted on the session"});
10491 }
10492 std::unique_ptr<AppRoot> root{new AppRoot{}};
10493 root->_core = std::make_unique<detail::ScreenCore>(doc, *_session, *_dispatcher, _options, MountOptions{});
10494 detail::ScreenCore& core = *root->_core;
10495 root->_scope = std::make_shared<detail::RtScope>(core, nullptr, nullptr, 0);
10496 core.rootScope = root->_scope;
10497 std::vector<Commands const*> lists;
10498 for (auto const& [key, commands] : doc->lifecycle) {
10499 static_cast<void>(key);
10500 lists.push_back(&commands);
10501 }
10502 _session->runtime().untracked([&] {
10503 core.declare(*root->_scope, &doc->scope, {}, lists);
10504 detail::LowerCtx const ctx{
10505 .scope = root->_scope, .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings const>(), .boundary = nullptr};
10506 std::vector<detail::BadgeModel> badges = core.lowerBadgeParts(doc->navigation, ctx);
10507 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < badges.size(); ++index) {
10508 root->_navigation.push_back(
10509 AppRoot::PlacedBadge{.screen = std::string{doc->navigation.at(index)->name("screen")},
10510 .badge = std::move(badges.at(index))});
10511 }
10512 });
10513 root->_navigationBadges = std::make_unique<reactive::Computed<std::vector<NavigationBadge>>>(
10514 _session->runtime(), [placed = &root->_navigation] {
10515 std::vector<NavigationBadge> shown;
10516 for (AppRoot::PlacedBadge const& entry : *placed) {
10517 if (entry.badge.visible.evaluate()) {
10518 shown.push_back(NavigationBadge{.screen = entry.screen,
10519 .text = entry.badge.text.evaluate(),
10520 .tone = entry.badge.tone.evaluate()});
10521 }
10522 }
10523 return shown;
10524 });
10525 // The app document's date patterns are the application's: every screen of the bundle shows and reads dates so.
10526 if (!doc->datePattern.empty() || !doc->dateTimePattern.empty()) {
10527 _session->setDatePatterns(doc->datePattern, doc->dateTimePattern);
10528 }
10529 _session->setAppScope(root->_scope.get());
10530 if (auto const found = doc->lifecycle.find("onMount"); found != doc->lifecycle.end()) {
10531 root->runCommands(found->second);
10532 }
10533 return root;
10534}
